scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hm...?
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...？
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry I made you wait,
but I had some research to finish and it took longer than I expected. Now, before I tell you more about the job, I want to test your competency.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
抱歉让你久等了，
我手头有些研究没做完，花的时间比预想的要长。
现在，在告诉你更多关于任务的事情之前，
我想先测试一下你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I don't know if you realize
it, but I'm offering a golden
opportunity for the adventurer
who works for me. So don't
hesitate to see Arian.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你可能没意识到，
我正在为为我工作的冒险者
提供一个千载难逢的机会。
所以，不要犹豫，
去见阿里安吧。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Dearles...?
Ah yes, he's one
of my shadier friends.
He's difficult to find
and he's only truly kind
to a select few, so...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
迪尔莱斯...？
啊，是的，
他是我比较神秘的朋友之一。
他很难找到，
而且只对少数人真正友善，所以...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Congratulations~
You managed to pass
all of the tests! You seem
to be the perfect person
to carry out this special
assignment!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
恭喜~
你通过了所有的测试！
你看起来是执行这项特殊任务的
完美人选！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, you've come
just in the nick of time!
I just found someone who
may be capable of restoring
the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，你来得正是时候！
我刚刚找到了一位
可能能够修复星泪石的人。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Keep up the good work.
I'm sorry that I don't have
have much information for
you to follow, but someone
with your abilities should
be able to find a way.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
请继续努力。
抱歉我没有太多信息
供你参考，
但以你的能力，
应该能找到办法的。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Amazing...! You've
managed to restore
the Sobbing Starlight!
Now, I recently learned that
this stone can lead you to
an ancient place...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太棒了...！
你成功修复了星泪石！
最近我得知，
这块石头可以指引你
前往一个古老的地方...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now that the
Sobbing Starlight
is restored, we need
to find someone who can
break the seal on the
gem's message...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
既然星泪石
已经修复，
我们需要找到一个人
来解开宝石上的封印...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Great...!
You were able to get the
text in the gem printed on a
Record of Ancient Language?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太好了...！
你成功将宝石中的文字
印在了古代语言的文书上？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
弗兰克·富兰克林
一直隐居，
只有少数人知道他的技艺。
但我可以向你保证，
他在古代语言方面的知识
无人能及。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
So far, I've learned
from my research that
the gem's message has
details about a certain
location and an item that
serves as some kind of key...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
目前，
根据我的研究，
宝石上的信息
包含了一个特定地点的详细信息，
以及一件作为某种钥匙的物品...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I get it now!
The 'skyscraper'
in this text refers to
the Geffen Tower!
Alright, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我明白了！
这段文字中的“摩天大楼”
指的是吉芬塔！
好的，让我们看看...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Angrboda...?!
According to legend,
her soul was split into
pieces and placed behind
seals created by the gods!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
安格尔伯达...？！
根据传说，
她的灵魂被分裂成碎片，
并被放置在由众神创造的封印之后！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Fascinating...
This was made with
a material outside of
Midgard! See this
blue lens? That must be
its incredible power source!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
真令人着迷...
这是用米德加尔特之外的材料制成的！
看这个蓝色透镜？
那一定是它强大的能量来源！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, you're finally
here. I've been waiting
to speak with you. First,
let me thank you again
for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，你终于来了。
我一直在等你，想和你谈谈。
首先，
再次感谢你的所有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You failed?
It's disappointing,
but I know that you
did your best. Let
me thank you for
all your work.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你失败了？
这令人失望，
但我知道你已经尽力了。
让我感谢你的所有工作。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
back the Sobbing
Starlight from you.
Apparently, you weren't
worthy of the task...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很抱歉...
但我必须收回你的星泪石。
显然，你并不配胜任这项任务...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Thank you so much
for helping me make
my dream come true.
can work on another
project together.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
非常感谢你帮助我实现了梦想。
我们可以一起着手下一个项目了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although you need everlasting patience in an archaeological excavation, the feeling you get when you find something makes
all those long hours of study and research worth it.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
虽然考古发掘需要永恒的耐心，但当你发现宝物时的那种感觉，会让所有漫长的研究和探索都变得值得。

scripts.text: [Metz]
scripts.translation: [梅茨]

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hm...?
Shouldn't you leave
for Morocc to see Arian?
You better hurry in case
somebody else applies
for this little job.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...？
你不该去莫洛克见阿里安吗？
最好快点，万一有人抢先申请了这个小工作呢。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm impressed that
you managed to get
Arian's approval! Oh,
and how's Daewoon?
He's a character, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你能获得阿里安的认可，真让我印象深刻！
哦，对了，大云怎么样？
他真是个有个性的人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm not surprised
that Daewoon likes
you. Ah, but Jore is
always busy. Still, if you
know his schedule, you
should be alright.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
大云喜欢你，这并不让我惊讶。
啊，不过乔尔总是很忙。不过，如果你了解他的日程，应该就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Jesqurienne is
a brilliant woman.
Although I worry a
little bit about her
overconfidence, she's
a good friend of mine.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
杰斯库莉恩是一位杰出的女性。
虽然我有点担心她过于自信，但她是我的一位好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, Bakerlan~
I've heard that he's
been quite busy lately.
But that's how all big
businessmen are, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，贝克兰~
听说他最近很忙。
不过我想，所有大商人都是这样的吧。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although I've made
some progress, I still
haven't found an artisan
capable of restoring the
Sobbing Starlight. Please
give me a little more time.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
虽然我已经取得了一些进展，但我仍然没有找到能够修复星泪石的工匠。
请再给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
The Wizard we're looking
for isn't in Geffen? Hm, at least we know he's near Comodo. Now,
while you investigate that lead, I'll continue to gather more
information on this gem...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我们要找的巫师不在吉芬？嗯，至少我们知道他在克魔岛附近。
现在，当你调查这条线索时，我会继续收集关于这颗宝石的更多信息...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sure the town
where the rejected
live means something,
but I'm unable to figure
out the answer to this
little riddle...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想被拒绝者居住的城镇一定有什么含义，
但我无法解开这个小小的谜题...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I think you're
almost there. All
of our efforts will
soon come to fruition!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想你已经快成功了。
我们所有的努力很快就会结出硕果！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
This is it...!
You've brought me,
'The Sign!' I've finally
proven its existence!
Please let me handle
this and come back later~
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
就是这个...！
你带给我了“标示”！
我终于证明了它的存在！
请让我先处理一下，稍后再回来~

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry, but I'm
still examining the
artifact you've lent to
me. Would you please
give me some more time?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很抱歉，我还在检查你借给我的文物。
请再给我一点时间好吗？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
Sign's power for you...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你去见过恩格尔·霍华德了吗？
只有他能为你解锁标示的力量...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
the Sign's power for you...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你去见过恩格尔·霍华德了吗？
只有他能为你解锁标示的力量...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I guess I can't
really blame you
since I didn't provide
you with that much help...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想我确实不能怪你，
毕竟我没有给你提供太多帮助...

scripts.text: I've been following these signs and...
scripts.translation: 我一直在追踪这些标示...

scripts.text: I was just passing by...
scripts.translation: 我只是路过...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Great...!
Welcome to my
humble lodgings.
Hmm, let me see...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太好了...！
欢迎来到我简陋的住所。
嗯，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Uh, it pains me to say this, but I don't think you qualified to help me out. Once you gain enough experience though, I'll be happy to have you on board~
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
虽然很遗憾，但我觉得你目前还不足以胜任这份工作。
不过，等你积累足够的经验后，我会很乐意让你加入的~

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hey, I think you might
be well suited for the job!
But do you think you could come back later? I've got my hands full with some other business.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嘿，我觉得你很适合这份工作！
不过，你能稍后再来吗？我现在正忙着处理其他事务。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Oh right, would you tell
me your name? {0}?
Okay then, I'll remember that.
Talk to you later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
对了，能告诉我你的名字吗？{0}？
好的，我会记住的。
那下次再聊，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Oh really?
I see, I thought you
were an applicant for
the position I'm offering
to brave adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
哦，是吗？
原来如此，我还以为你是来应聘
我面向勇敢冒险者发布的职位呢。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
The job I'm offering is
pretty risky and not just
anybody can handle it.
You'll actually go through
a series of tests conducted
by my trusted friends.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我提供的这份工作风险很大，
并非任何人都能胜任。
你需要通过我几位可靠朋友
进行的一系列测试。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now, the first person
you must visit is ^FF0000Arian^000000
in Morocc. Please speak
to him and he'll give you
all the details about his
examination... I hope.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
首先，你必须去见^FF0000阿里安^000000，
他在莫洛奇。请与他对话，
他会告诉你关于他那场考试的所有细节...我希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Once you're finished with
the test, Arian will tell you
what to do next. Afterwards,
come back to me so that we
can finally talk business.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
当你完成测试后，阿里安会告诉你
接下来该做什么。之后，
请回到我这里，这样我们
终于可以谈正事了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, almost forgot.
Arian won't talk to anybody
unless he knows them or
receives a message from me.
So if he's snubbed you in the past, just understand that's his way.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，差点忘了。
除非阿里安认识对方，
或者收到我的消息，否则他不会跟任何人说话。
所以如果以前他对你爱答不理，请理解那是他的作风。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
And just so you know,
it's not a good idea to
judge Arian by his looks.
He's more than meets
the eye, you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
顺便告诉你，
不要以貌取人，尤其是阿里安。
他的实力远超外表给人的印象，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
It certainly doesn't
help that he's hopelessly
addicted to gambling...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
而且，他无可救药地沉迷于赌博...
这确实对他没什么帮助。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
By now, you must have
six Sobbing Starlight pieces.
I'm sure that you want to know
more about these fragments.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
到现在为止，你应该已经收集了六块星泪石碎片。
我相信你一定想知道更多关于这些碎片的事情。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I remember last summer,
I found the wholly formed
Sobbing Starlight north
of Mount Mjolnir during
one of my expeditions...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我记得去年夏天，
在一次探险中，我在雷神之锤山以北
发现了一块完整的星泪石...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although it was in perfect
shape, once it was exposed
to the air, it began to crack
and shattered into the pieces
you now hold in your hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
虽然它当时完好无损，
但一旦暴露在空气中，
它就开始出现裂纹，
最终碎裂成了你手中持有的这些碎片。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now, an ordinary artisan
can't put the Sobbing Starlight
back together. This mysterious stone has some strange properties. But it's imperative for me to get this stone reassembled.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
现在，普通的工匠无法将星泪石重新拼合。
这块神秘的石头有着奇特的属性。但我必须将这块石头重新组装起来。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Once restored, a strange
pattern can be seen within
the Sobbing Starlight. I guess
that the pattern is a message
written in an ancient language.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
一旦复原，就能看到星泪石内部
有一种奇怪的图案。我想，
那是一种用古代语言写成的信息。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Would you let me borrow
the pieces for a second?
I'll show you something
quite interesting...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
能把碎片借给我一下吗？
我要给你看一样非常有趣的东西...

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you hand the pieces
of the Sobbing Starlight to
Metz, he pulls out a seventh
piece. Once gathered, they
begin to emit a strange light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你把星泪石的碎片交给梅茨后，
他拿出了一块第七块碎片。当它们聚集在一起时，
开始散发出奇异的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Since the pieces still
respond to each other,
I believe that it's possible
for the Sobbing Starlight
to be restored to its
original form.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
既然碎片之间仍然能相互感应，
我相信星泪石有可能
被恢复到它原本的样子。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
We're still seeking
an artisan of great
skill for this task. Once
know right away. For now,
please hold on to these pieces.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我们仍在寻找一位技艺高超的工匠来完成这项任务。
一旦找到，我会立刻通知你。在此之前，
请保管好这些碎片。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
His name is
^FF0000Engel Howard^000000,
a legendary Blacksmith
in Midgard. I don't
know where he is, but maybe
his family in Geffen may know.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
他的名字是
^FF0000恩格尔·霍华德^000000，
米德加尔特的一位传奇铁匠。我不知道他在哪里，
但也许他在吉芬的家人会知道。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Unfortunately, that's all
the information that I have
to give you for now. You'll
have to investigate this lead
on your own, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很遗憾，目前我能提供的信息就只有这些了。
{0}，你得自己去调查这条线索。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
While you work things
out with Engel Howard
and his family in Geffen,
I'll continue my research
on the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
在你与恩格尔·霍华德及其在吉芬的家人商谈期间，
我会继续研究星泪石。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
That's why we need to
know what the message in
the Sobbing Starlight means.
First, we need a Wizard that
is skilled in unlocking the
messages stored in gems...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
这就是为什么我们需要知道星泪石中的信息意味着什么。
首先，我们需要一位擅长解读宝石中封存信息的巫师...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hmm. It would probably
be best to visit the Wizards
on the top floor of the Geffen
Tower. There's someone I know
there who might just be up for
this task...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯。
最好去拜访吉芬中央塔顶层的巫师。
我在那里认识一个人，他可能正好愿意接受这个任务...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
For now, please visit
the Wizards at the top
floor of the Geffen Tower.
I know that one of them is
capable of getting the gem's
text on to paper...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
现在，请去拜访吉芬中央塔顶层的巫师。
我知道其中一位有能力将宝石上的文字转录到纸张上...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Just as I thought.
This language isn't
one I recognize. It's
probably ^333333too^000000 ancient.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
正如我所料。
这种语言我不认识。
它可能^333333太^000000古老了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Fortunately, I know
one person who may
be able to translate this.
If he's not able to do it...
We'll have to give up.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
幸运的是，我认识一个人，他可能能翻译这个。
如果他也不行...
我们就只能放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Bring this Record
of Ancient Language
to a man named Frank.
I hope he'll be able to
understand what it says...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
把这份古代语言记录带给一个叫弗兰克的人。
希望他能读懂上面写的内容...

scripts.text: Who is Frank?
scripts.translation: 弗兰克是谁？

scripts.text: Where is he?
scripts.translation: 他在哪里？

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
弗兰克·富兰克林
一直隐居，
只有少数人知道他的技艺。
但我可以向你保证，
他在古代语言方面的知识
无人能及。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想，他对历史的兴趣是他工作的动力。
不过，我听说他不喜欢见人。
希望你能说服他帮助我们...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
It's said that
Frank Franklin lives
on the Alberta Sunken Ship
where he devotes his time
to his research. He may not
always be home though...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
据说弗兰克·富兰克林住在艾尔贝塔的沉船上，
他在那里专心致志地做研究。不过他可能并不总是在家...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Good luck, then.
I hope that you can
find a way to get Frank
Franklin to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
祝你好运。
希望你能找到办法让弗兰克·富兰克林帮助我们...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想，他对历史的兴趣是他工作的动力。
不过，我听说他不喜欢见人。
希望你能说服他帮助我们...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
While I investigate,
please try to have Frank
Franklin translate the
message in the Record of
Ancient Language. Keep up
the good work, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
在我调查期间，
请试着让弗兰克·富兰克林翻译古代语言记录中的信息。
继续加油，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hmm...
''The town where the
rejected are left behind.''
What does that mean
and where could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...
“被遗弃者留下的城镇。”
这是什么意思，又会在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You'll need a stout,
heavy or really sharp
weapon. Of course, I'm
told that such weapons
are truly rare...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你需要一把坚固、沉重或非常锋利的武器。
当然，我听说这种武器非常稀有...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Supposedly, normal
Blacksmiths can't even
forge those kinds of rare
weapons. But if you manage
to get one, you might have a
chance of breaking the seals.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
据说普通的铁匠甚至无法锻造这种稀有武器。
但如果你能弄到一把，你就有可能打破封印。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Of course, I'm worried
that may be violating the
will of the gods by releasing
Angrboda, but we've already
gone this far...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
当然，我担心释放安格尔伯达可能会违背神的意志，
但我们已经走到这一步了...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I've found that the runes
around the lens control some
kind of seals placed at the Geffen Tower and Geffen Fountain. But with this in your hands, the seals should be broken...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我发现透镜周围的符文控制着放置在吉芬中央塔和吉芬喷泉上的某种封印。
但只要你拿着这个，封印应该就能被打破...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I... I think
you can even use this
to enter Valhalla. There
may be even other applications
using the power of this item...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我...我觉得你甚至可以用这个进入英灵殿。
利用这件物品的力量，可能还有其他用途...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I can only think of
one person who can
handle working with
this: Engel Howard,
Midgard's best
Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我只想到一个人能处理这个：
恩格尔·霍华德，米德加尔特最好的铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Thanks to you, my wish
of proving the existence
of the Sign has finally been
fulfilled. Its power is now
yours to do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
多亏了你，我证明“标示”存在的愿望终于实现了。
它的力量现在归你所有，随你处置。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You may have had your doubts,
but I'm happy enough to confirm that the Sign really exists. Thanks again, and I hope you stop by and chat from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你或许曾心存疑虑，
但我很高兴能确认“标示”确实存在。
再次感谢，希望你有空常来坐坐，聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although I need to
take back the Sobbing
Starlight, I hope you
accept this as a token
of my gratitude. Good luck
on your travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
虽然我要收回“哭泣星光”，
但请收下这份礼物，以表我的谢意。
旅途愉快，冒险者。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Metz]
......
Farewell.

[Metz]
Well then...
Good luck on
your journeys,
brave {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
那么...
祝旅途愉快，
勇敢的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Welcome to the
Brayde Estate. How
may I be of service?
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
欢迎来到布雷德庄园。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah, Master {0}.
Welcome. How may I be
of service today?
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
啊，{0}大人。
欢迎。今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
I recall that
Master Arian visited
the master a while ago.
They spent all night
discussing something
related to the master's work.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
我记得阿里安大人
不久前曾拜访过主人。
他们彻夜长谈，
似乎在讨论与主人工作相关的事情。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Sometimes I worry
about Mistress Elle.
She's one of the most
beautiful girls in Prontera,
but does not have a boyfriend.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
我有时会担心艾勒小姐。
她是普隆德拉最美的女孩之一，
却还没有男朋友。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Many travellers have
begun to visit the master
lastly. Apparently, they've
been led here by the sign
boards we've posted.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
最近有很多旅行者
开始拜访主人。
听说他们是看到我们张贴的告示才来的。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
It's most curious,
but Elle seems to
consider that unrefined
Jesqurienne as her rival.
Women are truly difficult
for me to understand...
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
真是奇怪，
艾勒小姐似乎把那个粗鲁的杰斯库莉恩
视为自己的对手。
女人真是让我难以理解...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Avarice knows no bounds.
The pastime of gambling
seems to best represent
mankind's greed.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
贪婪是没有止境的。
赌博这种消遣，
似乎最能体现人类的贪婪。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Bakerlan is a young,
brilliant man. Although
he inherited his company,
it takes talent to continue
his father's successes.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
贝克兰是个年轻有为的杰出人物。
虽然他是继承家业，
但要延续父亲的辉煌，也需要非凡的才华。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Oh, congratulations~
You finally passed all
of the tests. I know they
must have been incredibly
taxing and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
哦，恭喜~
你终于通过了所有测试。
我知道那一定非常辛苦且充满挑战。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Although humans make
mistakes, there are those
times when failing cannot
be an option.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
虽然人类会犯错，
但有些时候，失败是不被允许的。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
总会有一些情况，
让你没有第二次机会。
无论如何，请记住这一点。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: I'm here to see Metz.
scripts.translation: 我要见梅茨。

scripts.text: Gimmie your cash!
scripts.translation: 快把钱交出来！

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
If you do not have
any business to conduct
with Master Metz, please
leave immediately.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
如果您没有要见梅茨大人的正事，
请立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Very good, {0}
Please wait a moment
while I consult with
the master in his study.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
非常好，{0}。
请稍候，我去书房请示一下梅茨大人。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
My apologies,
but I insist that
you leave the premises
^FF0000immediately^000000.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
非常抱歉，
但我坚持要求您
^FF0000立刻^000000离开这里。

scripts.text: Who is Arian?
scripts.translation: 阿里安是谁？

scripts.text: What is Metz doing?
scripts.translation: 梅茨在做什么？

scripts.text: How is Elle?
scripts.translation: 艾勒怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah yes, Arian.
I consider him to be
a man of few words. The
words he does choose to
use are rather harsh and
brutish, you might say.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
啊，是的，阿里安。
我觉得他是个沉默寡言的人。
他偶尔说出的话，
往往相当严厉和粗暴。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Although I've served
the Brayde family for years,
I'm unfamiliar with Master
Metz's work. My apologies, but
I simply cannot even begin to fathom his research...
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
虽然我侍奉布雷德家族多年，
但并不熟悉梅茨大人的工作。
很抱歉，
我甚至无法想象他的研究内容...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah, Mistress Elle
has been working here
since she was a very young
girl. She is almost like
a granddaughter to me.
Ha ha-^333333*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
啊，艾勒小姐
从小就在这里工作了。
她对我来说就像孙女一样。
哈哈——^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Goodness, it sounded
dreadfully serious. The
term, 'ancient power' is
usually not mentioned
quite often in conversation.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
天哪，听起来
非常严肃。
“古代力量”这个词，
通常很少在对话中被提及。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Many men have given her
a great deal of attention, but
she always manages to reject
every single suitor...
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
许多男士都对她
给予了极大的关注，
但她总是能拒绝
每一位追求者...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Take heed and
do not let anyone
else take the opportunity
the master has presented
away from you.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
请留心，
不要让任何人夺走
梅茨大人给予您的机会。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Winning or losing, some
gamblers always seem to find
some reason to continue when
it's smarter to stop. Then again, the mind usually doesn't take precedence over the heart...
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
无论输赢，
有些赌徒总会在该停手的时候
找到继续的理由。
不过，理智通常无法战胜情感...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
It's amazing that Bakerlan
is also managing to expand
his business even further.
Of course, Master Metz has
had a role in Bakerlan's
success...
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
令人惊讶的是，
贝克兰的生意
竟然还在进一步扩大。
当然，梅茨大人
在贝克兰的成功中
也起到了作用...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Master Metz has informed
me that he wishes for you
to restore find someone
to restore the Sobbing
Starlight. I wish you luck
in that endeavor.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
梅茨大人通知我，
他希望您找到人
来恢复哭泣的星光。
祝您在那项任务中好运。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.
scripts.translation:
[范德斯]
总会有一些情况，
让你没有第二次机会。
无论如何，请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Wh-what are you
doing in Master Metz's
room? Please leave
immediately!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
你...你在梅茨大人的房间里
做什么？
请立刻离开！

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh...?
{0}?
Is there anything that
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦...？
{0}？
有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I'm not so busy
nowadays, but I was
working hard for a while
so my body aches. Oh, what
am I saying? Please ignore
that--! Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我现在不太忙，
但之前工作很努力，
所以浑身酸痛。哎呀，
我在说什么呢？请忽略刚才的话——！呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Guys never understand
what a girl really wants!
They're always too afraid
of showing their interest~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
男生永远不懂
女生真正想要什么！
他们总是太害怕
表现出自己的兴趣~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
^333333*Phew....*^000000
I'm so tired, even
though I didn't work
that much today. Some
days I feel exhausted
for no reason at all...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*呼....*^000000
我好累，
虽然今天并没有
做很多工作。有些日子
我会无缘无故地感到疲惫...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Jesqurienne?
Well, she's beautiful
and talented. She's actually
really great. That's why...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
杰斯库莉恩？
嗯，她美丽又有才华。
她其实真的很棒。正因为如此...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Have you been
in Comodo before?
It's such a beautiful
place with so many
things to do!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
你以前去过克魔岛吗？
那里风景优美，
有很多有趣的事情可以做！

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I remember that
there was a lady
working for Master
Bakerlan named Seylin.
I hear she's from some
distant country...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我记得有一位叫赛琳恩的女士，
她在贝克兰师父那里工作。
听说她来自一个遥远的国家...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
La la la~~
Oh, hello.
Long time no see.
La la la~~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啦啦啦~~
哦，你好。
好久不见。
啦啦啦~~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Ah~ Hello!
Nice to see
you again~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啊~ 你好！
很高兴再次见到你~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Lately, there've
been too many guests
visiting Master Metz.
Why can't they leave their
dirt outside of the manor?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
最近，
来拜访梅茨师父的客人太多了。
为什么他们不能把外面的灰尘
留在宅邸外面呢？

scripts.text: You wanna have coffee sometime?
scripts.translation: 有空一起喝杯咖啡吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about Metz.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于梅茨的事。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
...?
*Blush~*
Oh~ A-are you
asking me out
on a date?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
...？
*脸红~*
哦~ 你...你是在
约我出去约会吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Weeeell~
Do I have the time
to go out with you or
not? Hm, maybe if
you're really nice
to me, , {0}.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯~
我有没有时间
和你出去呢？嗯，
如果你对我很好的话，
{0}，也许我会考虑。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
I don't know
what to say?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
我不知该说什么？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
He's my employer and
I have an opinion of him,
but if I told you, it might
look unprofessional. But
if you have time later, I just
might tell you. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
他是我的雇主，
我对他有一些看法，
但如果我告诉你，
可能会显得不专业。不过，
如果你以后有空，
我可能会告诉你。呵呵~

scripts.text: You have nice skin, Miss Elle.
scripts.translation: 艾勒小姐，你的皮肤真好。

scripts.text: Tell me about Metz.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于梅茨的事。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Eh...?
Why, thank you!
Maybe it's because
I don't go out too
often. You have nice
I don't go out too, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
诶...？
哎呀，谢谢夸奖！
也许是因为我
不太常出门吧。你也是，
{0}，不太常出门~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
I don't know
what to say?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
我不知该说什么？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
He's my employer and
I have an opinion of him,
but if I told you, it might
look unprofessional. But
if you have time later, I just
might tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
他是我的雇主，
我对他有一些看法，
但如果我告诉你，
可能会显得不专业。不过，
如果你以后有空，
我可能会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Well, even when they
do ask me on dates, I never
accept their proposals that
easily. Hmph, there's not
too many boys I like out
there, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯，即使有人
约我出去，我也不会
轻易答应他们的提议。哼，
反正我也没遇到几个
让我喜欢的男生。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I should take
the day off and
rest. If I had some
refreshment, that
would be perfect...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我应该请个假
休息一下。如果能喝点
提神的东西，
那就完美了...

scripts.text: Why don't you take this?
scripts.translation: 不如你喝这个？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh, you didn't
need to do this,
but that you soooo
much! Ahhhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，你不用
这么做的，
但你真是太好了！啊~~~~~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I consider her
my rival! She might
be smarter than me,
but maybe I can become
more beautiful than her...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我把她
视为我的对手！她可能
比我聪明，
但我也许可以
变得比她更漂亮...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I like gambling in
Comodo, but I think
it's a little addictive.
I've even seen people
who seem to live for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我喜欢在克魔岛赌博，
但我觉得这有点
让人上瘾。
我甚至见过
似乎以此为生的人...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I've seen her
once and I think
she has a unique
style of beauty. Well,
different than mine or
Jesquienne's anyway...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我见过她一次，
我觉得她有一种
独特的美。嗯，
反正和我或者
杰斯奎恩都不一样...

scripts.text: What's up?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh...?
Oops...!
Do I really
look that excited?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦...？
哎呀...！
我看起来
真的很兴奋吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I just started
going out with someone!
He's a tall handsome boy
and I'm so in love with
him and he's so....
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我刚开始和一个人约会！
他是个高个子帅哥，
我超级喜欢他，
他那么...

scripts.text:
^3355FFElle continued
talking about how
much she loves her
new boyfriend, even
after you leave the room.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾勒继续
谈论她有多爱
她的新男友，
即使你离开了房间。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
Yes, something
very good happened
to me. Ho ho ho ho!
But it's a secret~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
是的，发生了一件
非常好的事。呵呵呵呵！
但是这是个秘密~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Er, I'm sorry, but I heard that something bad happened to you. But don't worry, maybe you'll have better luck next time~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
呃，对不起，我听说你遇到了一些不好的事。但别担心，也许下次你的运气会好一些~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Who the hell
are you, jerkface?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
你他妈是谁，混蛋？

scripts.text: Metz sent me here.
scripts.translation: 梅茨派我来的。

scripts.text: Who are you then?
scripts.translation: 那你又是谁？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Oh yeah...?
Well, I'm sending you
back! No way I'm fallin'
for that trick, chump!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
哦是吗...？
我要把你送回去！
我才不会上你的当，蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Wha...?
^0000FF{0}^000000?
Yeah, okay. Metz did
mention something about
about you. You're here
for the test, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
什...？
^0000FF{0}^000000？
好吧。梅茨确实
提到过你。你是来
参加测试的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Alright, this
test is simple.
I tell you to bring me
a bunch of items and
you go get them.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
好了，这个
测试很简单。
我让你去拿一堆物品，
你就去拿。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I know you jerkward adventurers
are always talking and you share the answers for any test some dude is givin' out. 'Course, it doesn't help that I use the same test
every frickin' time...
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我知道你们这些混蛋冒险者
总是在聊天，而且你们会分享
任何测试的答案。当然，
这也没用，因为我每次都用
同样的测试...

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Now, you gotta bring and only
have the item I ask you for when you come to me. If you know that I'll be asking for something later and you happen to have it, I'll straight up ^FF0000jack it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
现在，你来的时候必须只带着
我让你拿的物品。如果你知道
我稍后会要什么，而你恰好有，
我会直接^FF0000抢走它^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
The first item?
Gimme ^FF0000100 Fluff^000000.
Bring that and I'll
tell you what to
bring next.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
第一个物品？
给我^FF0000100个绒毛^000000。
带着它来，我会
告诉你接下来
要拿什么。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
......
Your mom.
Now get the
hell outta here!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
......
你妈的。
现在给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Hey. What the hell's wrong
with you? Hurry and get me
^FF0000100 Fluff^000000, ya slacker.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
嘿。你他妈怎么了？
快点给我弄^FF0000100个绒毛^000000，你这懒鬼。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright, that looks like
enough Fluff. Now, go and
get me ^FF000050 Poison Spores^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了，绒毛够了。
现在去给我弄^FF000050个毒魔菇芽孢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Hey. What part of 'Get me
^FF000050 Poison Spores^000000 or I'll
kick your ass,' don't
you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
嘿。哪部分没听懂？
“给我弄^FF000050个毒魔菇芽孢^000000，
不然我揍你。”

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
It's about time you
got here with those
Poison Spores. Now, go
and get ^FF000030 Scorpion Tails^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
你总算带着毒魔菇芽孢来了。
现在去给我弄^FF000030条蝎子尾巴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
What, your mom drop you on the
head right after you were born?
Stop bein' stupid and get me
^FF000030 Scorpion Tails^000000, nimrod.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
怎么，你妈生你的时候
把你头摔地上了？
别犯傻了，去给我弄
^FF000030条蝎子尾巴^000000，蠢货。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Damn, you sure took your
sweet time bringing over this
over this crap. Okay, now bring
^FF000020 Rotten Bandages^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
该死，你磨蹭这么久
才把这破玩意儿拿来。
行，现在去弄
^FF000020个腐烂绷带^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Is it really that hard to get
^FF000020 Rotten Bandages^000000? Cuz if it
is, then you must really blow.
Now hustle it up, punk!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
弄^FF000020个腐烂绷带^000000
有那么难吗？
要是难，那你肯定
是个废物。
快点，朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
You brought the bandages.
Okay short stuff, go and get
me ^FF000015 Little Evil Horn^000000. What
are you waiting for, a memo?
Get outta here~!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
绷带带来了。
好吧，矮子，去给我弄
^FF000015个小恶魔角^000000。
怎么，等备忘吗？
滚出去~！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
I don't get it.
You don't have the
^FF000015 Little Evil Horn^000000
I told you to get.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
我不明白。
你没带我说过的
^FF000015个小恶魔角^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
My grandma coulda grown
out her beard in the time
it tookyou to come back.
Now hurry it up and get
me ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
等你回来的这段时间，
我奶奶都能把胡子留长了。
快点去给我弄
^FF000010个珊瑚^000000！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I see, so it's my
fault for not telling you
not to bring your crap face
back without 'em. ^333333*A-hem*^000000
Don't bring your crap face here without 15 Little Evil Horns!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我明白了，是我没告诉你
没带东西就别把那张
臭脸带回来。^333333*咳*^000000
没带15个小恶魔角就别把那张臭脸带回来！！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I don't care how pretty
they are or if you're ruining
the ecosystem! When I say
''bring ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000,'' you
better have them! All the
fish can die for all I care.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我不管它们多漂亮，
也不管你是不是在破坏生态！
我说“弄^FF000010个珊瑚^000000”，
你就得给我弄来！
鱼死光了我也无所谓。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Finally you're back.
Gimme a sec to count
all this stuff so I can make
sure you're not trying to
cheat. God help you if you
try to pull a fast one on me...!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
你终于回来了。
给我点时间数一下
这些东西，确保你没想
作弊。你要是敢耍我...
上帝保佑你...！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了。去跟我左边
那个人说话。
柜台后面的那个家伙。
叫什么来着，加南。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了。去跟我左边
那个人说话。
柜台后面的那个家伙。
叫什么来着，加南。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
You wanna leave me
alone now and gimme
a little personal space?!
I need a break from looking
at your ugly mug, you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
你现在能不能
让我一个人待会儿，
给我点私人空间？！
我需要休息一下，
不想再看你那张丑脸了，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Let's see...
I'm looking at your
answers and they totally
suck. Take the test again
and do it right this time!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
让我看看...
我看你的答案，
简直烂透了。重新考一次，
这次给我答对！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Geez...
You're givin' Ganaan
a hard time. You hear
me? That's my job!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
天哪...
你在给加南
找麻烦。你听到了吗？
那是我的工作！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Alright. The answers
you gave Ganaan tell me
you're not a total dumbass.
Now you're supposed to go see Daewoon in Payon. And don't forget to show him this Star thingee.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
好了。你给加南的答案
告诉我你不是个
彻底的白痴。
现在你应该去斐扬找大云。
别忘了给他看这个星星东西。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...........
Payon...?
Daewoon?
Any of it ring a bell?
Cuz it really oughtta!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...........
斐扬...？
大云？
这些名字有印象吗？
你应该有的！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Shaddup and
lemme alone!
I'm thinking about
solving world hunger
here! Or somethin' like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
闭嘴，
让我一个人待会儿！
我正在思考
如何解决世界饥饿问题！
或者类似的事情。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The weather here in
Morocc is too hot for me.
I'm having a hard time just
trying to live here. Do you
know a nice and cool place
where I can work?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
这里摩洛哥的天气
对我来说太热了。
我很难在这里生活。
你知道哪里
又凉快又能工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Oh, Arian sent you to me,
right? I'm sorry, but he takes
a little getting used to. Even
though I still have to get used
to his... mannerisms.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
哦，是阿里安派你来的吧？
抱歉，他这人有点难相处。
虽然我也还在适应他的...举止。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Hm...?
Arian is the one
who's grading your
test. But I understand.
If you failed, I'd want
to avoid him too...
scripts.translation:
[加南]
嗯...？
阿里安是负责批改你试卷的人。
但我理解你的心情。
如果我不及格，我也想躲着他...

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wish the weather'd
cool down, even just a little.
While I'm asking for miracles,
I may as well wish for a billion kajillion zeny. And maybe a yacht.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
真希望天气能凉快一点，哪怕只是一点点也好。
既然都在许愿了，不如顺便许个愿，想要亿万Zeny。再要一艘游艇也不错。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Anyway, since he thinks it's
boring, Arian put me in charge
of the quiz portion of your test. Please carefully choose an
answer when I ask you a
question. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
总之，因为阿里安觉得无聊，
所以让我负责你考试的问答部分。
当我提问时，请仔细选择一个答案。
准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Now, the first question.
Let's say that you just
found yourself on a deserted
island. What is the very first
thing that you should do?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
现在，第一题。
假设你发现自己被困在了一座荒岛上。
你首先应该做什么？

scripts.text: Look for fresh water.
scripts.translation: 寻找淡水

scripts.text: Just wait for rescue.
scripts.translation: 等待救援

scripts.text: Forage for food.
scripts.translation: 寻找食物

scripts.text: Explore the island.
scripts.translation: 探索岛屿

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The second question is...
You happen to be stuck in
a narrow place inside some
collapsed building. What
do you plan to do first?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
第二题是...
你被困在一栋倒塌建筑的狭窄缝隙里。
你打算先做什么？

scripts.text: Scream for help.
scripts.translation: 大声呼救

scripts.text: Stay quiet.
scripts.translation: 保持安静

scripts.text: Wait for death to come.
scripts.translation: 等待死亡降临

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 寻找出路

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Now, the third question.
You're on some dungeon
expedition with your friends,
but you got lost somehow.
How do you handle it?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
现在，第三题。
你和朋友们正在探索地下城，
但不知怎么迷路了。
你会怎么处理？

scripts.text: Try to find my friends.
scripts.translation: 尝试寻找朋友

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 寻找出路

scripts.text: Stay put.
scripts.translation: 留在原地

scripts.text: Continue exploring the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 继续探索地下城

scripts.text:
[Ganaan]
Here's the fourth question.
You're with your friends inside
a mansion with no exit. What do
you do first when a murder happens inside the mansion?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
这是第四题。
你和朋友们在一座没有出口的豪宅里。
当豪宅里发生谋杀案时，你首先会做什么？

scripts.text: Wait for the case to get solved.
scripts.translation: 等待案件侦破

scripts.text: Try to find my friends first.
scripts.translation: 先尝试寻找朋友

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 寻找出路

scripts.text: Solve the murder case on my own.
scripts.translation: 独自解决谋杀案

scripts.text: Kill the others before they kill me.
scripts.translation: 在他们杀我之前先杀了他们

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The fifth question is...
You hear that the end of
the world is in one week.
So what do you do during
this final week?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
第五题是...
你听说世界将在一周后终结。
那么在这最后一周里，你会做什么？

scripts.text: Wait to see the end.
scripts.translation: 等待结局的到来

scripts.text: Plant an apple tree.
scripts.translation: 种一棵苹果树

scripts.text: Look to move to a different world.
scripts.translation: 寻找前往其他世界的方法

scripts.text: What else? Save the world.
scripts.translation: 还能做什么？拯救世界

scripts.text: What else? Go on a crime spree.
scripts.translation: 还能做什么？大肆犯罪

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Oh! We're done!
Okay, let me give
these answers to Arian.
Sooo... Talk to him and
he'll let you know how
you did.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
哦！我们问完了！
好了，让我把这些答案交给阿里安。
那么...去和他谈谈，
他会告诉你你的表现如何。

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Have you heard?
Payon's most eligible
bachelor is back home!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
你听说了吗？
斐扬最抢手的单身汉
回家了！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
He was a little brat
back when he was a kid,
but now he's grown up to
be the manliest of men!
No wonder all the ladies
just can't resist him!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
他小时候还是个调皮捣蛋的小鬼，
但现在他成长为一个
最有男子气概的男人！
难怪所有的女士们
都对他无法抗拒！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Heh heh...
With this beautiful
face and charming figure...
I'm gonna seduce him.
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
嘿嘿...
有着这张英俊的脸庞
和迷人的身材...
我要去勾引他。

scripts.text: Who are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说谁？

scripts.text: You're freaking me out!
scripts.translation: 你吓到我了！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
You don't know
Daewoon, the most
beautiful man in all
of Payon and maybe
even the world?
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
你不知道大云吗？
他是整个斐扬，
甚至可能是全世界
最英俊的男人？

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
He left home to become stronger
when he was just a boy. I had no idea he would come back as such 
a fine specimen of a man...
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
他小时候就离家去变强了。
我没想到他会以如此
完美的男人形象回来...

scripts.text: I'd like to meet this Daewoon.
scripts.translation: 我想见见这位大云

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Oh, I see~
You plan to ask him
to show you some fighting
pointers, do you? You men
are all the same: not as
cool or tough as Daewoon!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
哦，我明白了~
你打算让他
教你一些战斗技巧，是吗？
你们男人都一样：
都不如大云帅气和强悍！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Oh, I see~
Interested, are you?
Well, you'll have to get
in line. So many women
and only one Daewoon...
^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
哦，我明白了~
你感兴趣了？
那你得排队了。这么多女人，
却只有一个大云...
^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Anyway, Daewoon
is staying in the annex
to the Payon Castle. If you
want to see him for yourself,
why don't you go there?
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
总之，大云
住在斐扬城堡的附属建筑里。
如果你想亲自见见他，
不妨去那里看看？

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Freaking you out?
Excuuuuse me~!
I'll have you know that
a flower's life is brief.
I better snag Daewoon
while I still can~
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
吓到你了？
对不起了啦~！
要知道，花儿的寿命是很短暂的。
我得趁现在赶紧把大云追到手~

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome to the
Payon Castle annex
where Master Daewoon
is staying.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
欢迎光临斐扬城堡附属建筑，
大云师父就住在这里。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome.
Are you another
visitor for Master
Daewoon?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
欢迎光临。
您也是来拜访
大云师父的客人吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Greetings.
Welcome to the
Annex to Payon Castle.
Have you come here to
see Master Daewoon?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
您好。
欢迎来到斐扬城堡附属建筑。
您是来见大云师父的吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome to the
Payon Castle Annex.
Master Daewoon is
currently lodging here.
Have you come to see him?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
欢迎光临斐扬城堡附属建筑。
大云师父目前住在这里。
您是来见他的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Please refrain
from attacking
the servants.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
请不要攻击仆人。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Although you may recognize
us as monsters, we have
all been properly hired and
faithfully serve our master,
Daewoon. So there's no
need to feel uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
虽然你们可能把我们看作魔物，
但我们都是正式受雇的，
并且忠实地侍奉着大云师父。
所以不必感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Master Daewoon~!
Please try this too!
It's Tiger Foot Skin soup,
boiled with nine kinds of
exotic, potent herbs.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
大云师父~！
请尝尝这个！
这是虎皮汤，
用九种珍稀强效草药熬制而成。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
It's famous for easing
sores and fatigure, preventing
cold and ^333333*Ahem*^000000 enhancing male vigor. Now, open wide, master~
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
它以缓解疼痛和疲劳、预防感冒以及^333333*咳咳*^000000增强男性活力而闻名。来，张嘴，师父~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah!
Feasting and merriment,
wine, women and song!
I could ask for nothing more!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哇哈哈！
美酒佳肴，歌舞升平！
我还能奢求什么呢！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
The most scrumptious
delicacies are all mine to
taste! And I'm not just talking about the food. Mwah ah hah!
I'm the king of the world!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
最美味的珍馐都归我品尝！
而且我说的可不只是食物。哇哈哈！
我才是世界之王！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
You'll have to forgive me
if I wish to spend my time with maidens as opposed to men.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦，有客人？
抱歉，我想你是不请自来的吧~
请原谅我，比起男人，
我更愿意把时间花在美女身上。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
No matter, a beauty is a beauty, whether or not I know her name.
Come and drink with me~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦，有客人？
抱歉，我想你是不请自来的吧~
没关系，美人就是美人，
不管我认不认识她。
来，陪我喝一杯~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure...
But first, would you
take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...
不过首先，你能看看这个吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully take
out the small, lucid
jewel that Arian gave
you and reveal it to
Daewoon's roving eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地拿出阿里安给你的那颗晶莹剔透的小宝石，
展示在大云四处游移的目光前。^000000

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Eh? Why that's...
I see now, Arian must
have sent you! Oh you
should have said so
at the very beginning~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
咦？那是...
我明白了，阿里安派你来的！
你一开始就该说清楚嘛~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
My apologies~
Lately I've been attracting
all sorts of strange attention like some kind of teen celebrity. I've gotten used to being too careful in screening out the dangerous sort.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
抱歉~
最近我像某些青少年明星一样，
总是吸引各种奇怪的关注。
我已经习惯了小心翼翼地筛选掉那些危险的人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now then.
Do you have any
idea what that jewel
you're holding actually is?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
那么。
你知道你手里拿的
那颗宝石到底是什么吗？

scripts.text: Kind of?
scripts.translation: 有点印象？

scripts.text: How the hell would I know?
scripts.translation: 我怎么会知道？

scripts.text: No, but would you tell me?
scripts.translation: 不，但你能告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh...!
You must be much
smarter than I expected.
So tell me, what do you
understand about this jewel?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
噢...！
看来你比我想象的聪明多了。
那么告诉我，
你对这颗宝石有什么了解？

scripts.text: It's handy.
scripts.translation: 挺方便的。

scripts.text: I actually don't know...
scripts.translation: 其实我不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mmm...?
Handy? If you truly
understood, I don't
think you'd describe this
jewel as merely 'handy.'
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯...？
方便？如果你真的了解它，
我想你不会只用“方便”
来形容这颗宝石。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Really?
Mm. At least you
admit it. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[大云]
真的吗？
嗯。至少你还承认了。*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
...
A rather crass way
of speaking, but perhaps
you picked it up from Arian.
In any case, let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
...
说话虽然有点粗鲁，
但也许你是跟阿里安学的。
不管怎样，让我解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Didn't Arian tell you
anything? I appreciate
your honesty. And I don't
mind chatting a while, I much
prefer speaking to honest people rather than foolish know-it-alls.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
阿里安没告诉你什么吗？
我很欣赏你的诚实。
我不介意聊一会儿，
比起那些愚蠢的自以为是的人，
我更喜欢和诚实的人交谈。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
That ^31009CSobbing Starlight^000000
is no mere jewel. It is a key
item for unlocking some incredible power. I believe Metz happened to obtain a piece, though I am
unsure how...
scripts.translation:
[大云]
那颗^31009C星泪石^000000
并不是普通的宝石。
它是解锁某种惊人力量的关键物品。
我相信梅茨恰好获得了一块碎片，
虽然我不确定是怎么得到的...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Metz has asked me and
some other friends who
hold the fragments of the
Sobbing Starlight to entrust
them to someone worthy of
finding the power it leads to.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
梅茨请求我和其他持有星泪石碎片的朋友，
将碎片托付给一个有资格找到其背后力量的人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Of course, we all agreed
and now you're here for me
to judge whether or not you're
qualified for this task. Now,
are you ready for my test?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
当然，我们都同意了，
现在你在这里，
我要判断你是否具备完成这项任务的资格。
那么，
你准备好接受我的测试了吗？

scripts.text: I'M READY! YEEAH!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了！耶！

scripts.text: I'll do my best!
scripts.translation: 我会尽力的！

scripts.text: To hell with this!
scripts.translation: 去他的！

scripts.text: Fine. Let's get it over with.
scripts.translation: 好吧。快点结束吧。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ooh~
Such unbridled
enthusiasm usually
does more good than harm.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
噢~
这种毫无保留的热情，
通常利大于弊。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah!
That's exactly what
I wanted to hear! That
kind of quiet and careful
confidence will help you
in the future, you'll see~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哇哈哈！
这正是我想听到的！
这种安静而谨慎的自信，
将来会帮到你，你会看到的~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
E...
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
呃...
抱歉？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
How can you be
so ridiculous at
at time like this?
Either mind your manners
or don't take this test at
all! ^333333*SLAP--!!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[大云]
在这种时候，
你怎么能这么荒唐？
要么注意你的礼仪，
要么就别参加这个测试了！^333333*啪--！！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. That kind of half-hearted
attitude won't get you very far on your adventures. Still, so long as you don't get overly negative, you should have a decent chance of surviving your challenges.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯。这种半心半意的态度，
在冒险中走不远。不过，
只要你不变得过于消极，
你应该有不错的机会应对挑战。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, Metz expects me to ask
some rather serious questions,
but that really isn't my style. For this test, why don't we just talk?
Just answer me honestly and
light heartedly, alright?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
梅茨希望我提出一些相当严肃的问题，
但这真的不是我的风格。
这次测试，我们不如就随便聊聊吧？
只要诚实地、轻松地回答我就好，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
So...
Do you have a lot
of friends that you can
constantly party with?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
那么...
你有许多可以经常一起组队的
朋友吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: I prefer soloing.
scripts.translation: 我更喜欢单刷。

scripts.text: I am lonely.
scripts.translation: 我很孤独。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, that's great~!
To have many friends
is a priceless blessing.
Friends bring us joy and
aid when we find ourselves
suffering from difficulties.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
噢，那太棒了~！
拥有许多朋友是无价的福分。
当我们陷入困境时，
朋友会带给我们快乐和援助。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Wouldn't you
agree that being
really close friends
with someone can be
a life long benefit?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
你不觉得与某人成为非常亲密的朋友，
是一辈子的受益吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, everybody
needs to be alone once
in a while. And there are
some battles you must
fight all on your own.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯，每个人偶尔都需要独处。
而且有些战斗，
你必须独自面对。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Also, if you never
deal with other people,
you may grow selfish or
needy. It's better to go
out and meet people,
don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
另外，如果你从不与人打交道，
可能会变得自私或依赖他人。
我觉得走出去多认识人会更好，
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
You don't have any
friends at all? Well,
you better learn how
to get along with others
as soon as you can...!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
你完全没有朋友吗？好吧，
你最好尽快学会如何与他人相处...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, what's your opinion
on purposely getting lots
of monsters to follow you
around. I believe this is
called ''Mob Training...''
scripts.translation:
[大云]
那么，你对故意引来大量魔物
跟着自己这件事有什么看法？
我想这被称为“刷怪训练...”

scripts.text: Awesome~!
scripts.translation: 太酷了~！

scripts.text: I hate people who do that.
scripts.translation: 我讨厌那样做的人。

scripts.text: I do it sometimes...
scripts.translation: 我有时候会这样做...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But...
Wouldn't that be really
rude to anyone else hunting
on that same map? I think
it would even interfere with
someone else's gameplay...
scripts.translation:
[大云]
但是...
这对在同一张地图上打怪的其他人
来说不是很没礼貌吗？
我觉得这甚至会干扰
其他人的游戏体验...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Perhaps you should try
to consider other people's
feelings. Mob Training seems
to only be good at getting other
people angry with you...
scripts.translation:
[大云]
也许你应该试着体谅他人的感受。
刷怪训练似乎只会让其他人对你生气...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Really?
I do too!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
真的吗？
我也一样！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Just the other day, I've
heard some ruffians boasting
of their mob training activities. But personally, I feel they were compensating for their own shortcomings.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
就在前几天，我听到一些恶棍
吹嘘他们的刷怪训练活动。
但就我个人而言，我觉得他们是在
掩饰自己的不足。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Such behavior truly
bothers me. Although I have
spent years in developing an
unflappable personality, I find
myself irked when encountering
such troublemakers.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
这种行为真的让我很困扰。虽然我已经
花了很多年培养自己沉稳的性格，
但遇到这种捣乱者时，
我还是会感到恼火。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
When you face obstacles
in your own training, never give in to weakness. Assert yourself and find the determination to overcome your tribulations with honor!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
当你在训练中遇到障碍时，
绝不要向软弱屈服。坚定自己，
找到克服苦难的决心，
并以荣誉战胜它们！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
At least you're honest.
But let me say that I cannot
condone that sort of weak willed behavior. True strength can only
be found through honor.
Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
至少你很诚实。
但我要说，我无法容忍
那种意志薄弱的行为。真正的力量
只能通过荣誉获得。
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
In the face of overwhelming
odds, do not despair. After all, what is achievement if it is not earned without difficulty? The greater the challenge, the
greater the glory.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
面对压倒性的劣势，不要绝望。毕竟，若没有艰辛的付出，何谈成就？挑战越大，荣耀便越辉煌。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Even if you are having hard time,
try to take a firm stand.
One day, you will realise how strong you have become.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
即使你正身处困境，也要努力站稳脚跟。
终有一天，你会意识到自己变得多么强大。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
And...
Don't ever partake in
mob training again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
还有...
以后绝对不要再进行刷怪训练了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Anyway, I'm sure you're
aware of the War of Emperium
in which mighty guilds all across Midgard battle for guild castle dominion. It's actually quite popular, really.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
总之，我相信你一定听说过攻城战。
那是米德加尔特各地强大的公会为了争夺公会城堡控制权而进行的战斗。
实际上，这项活动非常受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now imagine that both of us
are in the midst of a heated guild war. The sounds of explosions and earth shaking magic spells are all we can hear. At any time, we can
be lost in that mindless chaos.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
现在想象一下，我们正处于激烈的公会战之中。
耳边只有爆炸声和撼动大地的魔法咒语声。
随时都可能迷失在那片混乱之中。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Finally, through incredible
good fortune, we manage to
infiltrate the enemy guild castle and reach their Emperium. If we destroy that Emperium, that castle will belong to our guild.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
最终，凭借不可思议的好运，我们成功渗透进敌方公会城堡，并抵达了华丽金属所在地。
如果我们摧毁那个华丽金属，这座城堡就将归属我们的公会。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
However...! This is
no ordinary Emperium!
It is a masterful sculpture
of a gorgeous Priestess!
Answer me, adventurer!
Would you still destroy it?!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
然而...！
这可不是普通的华丽金属！
它是一座精美绝伦的女祭司雕像！
回答我，冒险者！
你还会摧毁它吗？！

scripts.text: Destroy it!
scripts.translation: 摧毁它！

scripts.text: I can't destroy such beauty...
scripts.translation: 我无法摧毁如此美丽的东西...

scripts.text: I'd close my eyes, then destroy it.
scripts.translation: 我会闭上眼睛，然后摧毁它。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you lack a true
appreciation for beauty.
Even in Emperium form, how
could you harm a Priestess?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯。你有着非常坚定的意志。
不过，也许你缺乏对美的真正鉴赏力。
即使是华丽金属形态，你怎能伤害一位女祭司呢？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you cannot appreciate
a Priestess's beauty in the
way that a man would.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯。你有着非常坚定的意志。
不过，也许你无法像男子那样欣赏女祭司的美。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah yes! I felt you would answer that way! We must cherish and protect what is beautiful in this world. I would never be able to harm a Priestess, even in
statue form...
scripts.translation:
[大云]
啊，没错！我就知道你会这样回答！
我们必须珍惜并保护这个世界上的美好事物。
即使是雕像形态，我也绝不会伤害一位女祭司...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Interesting...!
Although you cherish
the beauty of the Priestess,
your loyalty to your guild
proves stronger. A most
admirable attitude!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
有趣...！
虽然你珍视女祭司的美，
但你对公会的忠诚更为强烈。
这是一种非常令人钦佩的态度！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But yes, if it were
me, I would protect that
Priestess shaped Emperium
until the end of the guild war.
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
不过，如果是我的话，我会保护那座女祭司形态的华丽金属，直到公会战结束。
哇哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
While we're on the topic
of guilds, let me present
another guild related scenario. Let's say that you joined a very popular guild with many allies,
as well as formidable enemies.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
既然提到了公会，让我再给你讲一个与公会相关的场景。
假设你加入了一个非常受欢迎的公会，那里有许多盟友，
也有强大的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, during one of your.
hunts, you happen to meet
a member of one of your enemy guilds. The two of you are the only people on that map. Suddenly, he finds himself in mortal danger!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
现在，在一次狩猎中，你恰好遇到了敌方公会的一名成员。
那张地图上只有你们两个人。突然，他陷入了致命的危险！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
This enemy guild member
begins to yell for help. Now,
would you give your enemy
the help that he needs?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
这名敌方公会成员开始大声呼救。
那么，你会向你的敌人伸出援手吗？

scripts.text: Yes, of course!
scripts.translation: 是的，当然！

scripts.text: I'd pretend not to hear anything.
scripts.translation: 我会假装没听到。

scripts.text: I'd make fun of him, then run off.
scripts.translation: 我会嘲笑他，然后跑开。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, you would help him!
Good, good. I'm glad to see
that you understand that such pettiness should not get in the way of doing what is good and right.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
啊，你愿意帮助他！
很好，很好。很高兴看到你能明白，
这种小气不该妨碍你去做正确的事。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
True, you're not really
obligated to help your
enemy. Besides, you may
hurt his feelings once he
realizes that he's had to
depend on his rival for help.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
确实，你并没有义务帮助你的敌人。
而且，当他意识到自己不得不依赖对手的帮助时，
他的自尊心可能会受到打击。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Even though he is
your enemy, I still
believe it's important
that you treat him with
respect. Where is your honor?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
尽管他是你的敌人，但我认为尊重他依然很重要。
你的荣誉感在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, there's one
last thing I want to
know about you. It's the
most important question
in the world once you
think about it.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
好了，关于你，我还有最后一件事想知道。
一旦你仔细想想，这就是世界上最重要的问题。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
...
......
Do you enjoy life?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
...
......
你热爱生活吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I'm glad.
When you don't live
with zeal, it's easy to
forget your goals and your
purpose for living. Don't have
any? Then make some up.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
很好。
如果你不充满热情地生活，很容易忘记你的目标和生存的意义。
没有目标吗？那就去创造一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I hope you always enjoy
life as much as you can.
As for me, I'm always happy
with my wine, women and song~
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
我希望你能尽可能享受人生。
至于我，只要有美酒、美女和歌声，我就很快乐~
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I understand.
People cannot be happy
all the time. Sometimes
it's easy to forget your
goals and purpose in life.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
我理解。
人不可能一直快乐。
有时候，很容易忘记人生的目标和意义。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But you know what? If you
have just one dream, one goal
to strive towards, things shall get better. If you think you don't have dreams, look back to your past. What you remember may surprise you.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
但你知道吗？如果你有一个梦想，一个值得奋斗的目标，一切都会好起来的。
如果你觉得自己没有梦想，那就回顾一下过去。你回忆起的往事可能会让你惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It's important to look forward,
but first you must find what is truly precious to you before you can define your happiness. That's why I think it's good to experience new things as well as reflect.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
向前看很重要，但首先你必须找到对你真正珍贵的东西，才能定义你的幸福。
所以我认为，体验新事物和反思同样重要。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, what's precious to me?
Three things, actually...
Wine. Women. And song!
Though, if I had to rank them,
women would top that list.
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
那么，对我来说什么是珍贵的呢？
其实是三样东西...
美酒、美女和歌声！
不过，如果非要排个名，美女可是排在第一位的。
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, I must say that I've
grown quite fond of you. Of
course, it helps that we have so much in common. Mwah ah hah~!
It was an honor to meet you~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯，我得说，我对你挺有好感的。
当然，这也得益于我们有这么多共同点。Mwah ah hah~!
很高兴认识你~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦对了！你的下一位考官是^CE0000乔尔爵士^000000，
也被称为艾尔帕兰的幽灵。虽然他总是病恹恹的，但他对研究有着极大的热情。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
好了，那么。
祝你在艾尔帕兰好运~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
说这话让我很痛心，
但我觉得你不配持有我这块星泪石碎片。
不过，我愿意再给你一次机会~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
You know, after talking with
you for a while, I now feel fairly comfortable with leaving you this piece of the Sobbing Starlight. Somehow, I think you're strong enough to get all the pieces.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
你知道吗，和你聊了一会儿后，我现在觉得把这块星泪石碎片交给你挺放心的。
不知为何，我觉得你足够强大，能够集齐所有碎片。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I hope you will pass the rest of the test
and acquire the power.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
希望你能通过剩下的测试，并获得那份力量。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦对了！你的下一位考官是^CE0000乔尔爵士^000000，
也被称为艾尔帕兰的幽灵。虽然他总是病恹恹的，但他对研究有着极大的热情。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
好了，那么。
祝你在艾尔帕兰好运~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
说这话让我很痛心，
但我觉得你不配持有我这块星泪石碎片。
不过，我愿意再给你一次机会~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I wonder...
Someone should have
passed Arian's test by now.
I can't wait to see who was
actually able to impress him...
scripts.translation:
[大云]
我在想...
现在应该有人通过阿里安的测试了吧。
我迫不及待想看看，究竟是谁能让他印象深刻...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah~!
I couldn't be happier!
What more do I need?
Gourmet food, fine wine,
nubile women...!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
Mwah ah hah~!
我再快乐不过了！
我还需要什么？
美食、美酒、美女...!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I'm sorry, but 
no price can make
me change my mind.
You... You've failed.
I'm sorry, friend.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
很抱歉，
无论出多少钱，我都不会改变主意。
你...你失败了。
抱歉，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh~! It's you!
It has been a while since
we last conversed. Now that
you've accessed the power
behind the Sobbing Starlight,
do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦~！是你啊！
我们好久没聊过了。
既然你已经获得了星泪石背后的力量，
感觉如何？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, how great~!
Just remember that
power can be addictive.
Even if you don't agree,
it's still wise to avoid
greedy tendencies, yes?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
啊，真棒~！
不过要记住，
力量是会让人上瘾的。
即使你不认同，
保持克制、避免贪婪也是明智之举，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Please make good use of
the power you have obtained.
I am counting on you to be
responsbile and to never lose
that smile on your face, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
请善用你获得的力量。
我指望你能负责任，
并且永远保持脸上的笑容，好吗？
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Eh...?
That's quite a surprise.
Perhaps Metz didn't know
enough about it? Still, I'm
sorry to hear you don't like it.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
诶...？
真是令人惊讶。
也许梅茨对它的了解还不够？
不过，听到你不喜欢它，我还是很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But in the end, keep in mind
that you must have learned some great lesson from this experience. Anyway, please do your best to use the power responsibly, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大云]
但归根结底，请记住，
你肯定从这次经历中学到了重要的教训。
总之，请负责任地使用力量，好吗？
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hm...?
Weren't you on
your way to find
^CE0000Sir Jore^000000 in Al de Baran?
scripts.translation:
[大云]
嗯...？
你不是正要去艾尔帕兰找^CE0000乔尔爵士^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, having trouble
finding him, are you?
Well, he's fairly shy, but
I'm sure he's hiding some
place in that town.
scripts.translation:
[大云]
哦，找不到他吗？
嗯，他有点害羞，
但我确信他正躲在镇上的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, I feel so...
Satiated. The food was 
stupendous and the women
have been even more so.
Servants! Fan me please~
scripts.translation:
[大云]
啊，我感觉好...
饱了。食物美味极了，
女人们更是如此。
仆人们！给我扇扇子~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Uwah~!
Stop reading my
research monograph!
Put that back now!
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
哇~！
别读我的研究手稿！
马上放回去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

[Sir Jore]
...
......
...No!
Look what
you made me do!
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
...
......
...不！
看你把我逼成什么样了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I've been fiddling
with this sample for
five hours. And now
it's ruined! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
我花了五个小时摆弄这个样本。
现在全毁了！^333333*呜咽*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
^333333*Sob*^000000
I came to this town
so I could focus on
my research without
any interruptions. So
why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
^333333*呜咽*^000000
我来这个城镇是为了能专心研究，
不受打扰。那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Daewoon sent me.
scripts.translation: 大云派我来的。

scripts.text: Oops, sorry. Later~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，抱歉。回头见~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
O-oh!
That's right.
You're here to be
tested for the piece
of the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
哦-哦！
对啊。
你是来接受星泪石碎片测试的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
So...
Er. Then, what...
W-what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
那么...
呃。那么，你...
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text: {0}, thanks.

[Sir Jore]
N-nice to meet you.
My name is Jore. Just
a normal person who loves
research. S-sorry if I seem
a little nervous! I'm actually
quite... shy around people.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
幸...幸会。
我叫乔尔。只是一个热爱研究的普通人。
抱歉...我看起来有点紧张！其实我...在人前很害羞。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Oh no...!
If you were able to
find me, there will be
others! When would I get
the time to do my research?!
N-no! I h-h-hate people!!
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
糟糕...！
既然你能找到我，肯定还会有别人！
我什么时候才能专心做研究啊？！
不...不！我...我讨厌人类！！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Still, I did promise
M-M-Metz and he is my
friend. So I must accept
some guests. Even if hundreds
of them knock on my door...
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
不过，我答应过梅茨，他是我的朋友。
所以我必须接待一些客人。
哪怕有几百个人来敲门...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
But first of all,
I'm going to need
a new research sample.
I think it's only fair that
you get it for me since you
made me ruin the last one.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
但首先，
我需要一个新的研究样本。
既然你弄坏了上一个，
我觉得让你去弄一个新的才公平。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
N-now, d-don't worry.
The items are actually
quite easy to get. It's
five hours part that's
hard. Now, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
现...现在，别担心。
这些材料其实很容易获取。
难的是那五个小时。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Just bring me
10 Empty Test Tubes,
10 Green Herbs and
2 Yggdrasil Leafs.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
请给我带来
10个空试管，
10株绿色药草和
2片天地树叶子。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
You see, l-lately I've
been studying Biology. 
I think the secret to life
can be found in the Leaf of
Yggdrasil. They can be used
to revive the dead, after all.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
你看，最近我
一直在研究生物学。
我觉得生命的秘密
就藏在天地树叶子中。
毕竟，它们可以用来复活死者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Oh, and make sure to
bring those things to me
me before I go to bed at
precisely 10:00 PM PST.
I do have a regular sleeping
schedule, you know.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
哦，还有，记得在
晚上10点整我睡觉之前
把这些东西带给我。
你知道的，我有固定的作息。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I spent five hours
observing the changes
in that research sample.
All of that hard work lost!
^333333*Wah~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
我花了五个小时
观察那个研究样本的变化。
所有的辛苦都白费了！
^333333*哇~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Ah! Th-thank you for
bringing what I need.
Now I can continue my
research. Oh, and see if
you're worthy of obtaining
the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
啊！谢...谢谢你
带来了需要的东西。
现在我可以继续研究了。
哦，顺便看看你是否
有资格获得星泪石。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Now, for your assignment.
Have you ever heard about
the ^CE3131Stone of Sage^000000? Rumors about
it have been spreading around, but no one has confirmed the truth about it, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
现在，关于你的任务。
你听说过^CE3131贤者之石^000000吗？
关于它的传闻四处流传，
但没人证实过真相，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Although I have no clue
what the Stone of S-S-age
may actually be, I have a gut
feeling that I need it to bring
my Biology research to the next step. This is how you'll help me.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
虽然我不知道贤者之石
到底是什么，但我有一种直觉，
我需要它来让我的生物学研究
更进一步。这就是你需要帮我的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I need you to investigate
this Stone of Sage by finding
a father and daughter who were
famous for being great Alchemists. They vanished deep into a forest, but I believe they know something.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
我需要你调查这块贤者之石，
去找一对著名的炼金术士父女。
他们消失在了森林深处，
但我相信他们知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Please bring m-me
10 Empty Test Tube,
10 Green Herb and
2 Leaf of Yggdrasil
so that I can make a
new research sample.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
请给我带来
10个空试管，
10株绿色药草和
2片天地树叶子，
这样我才能制作新的研究样本。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I want you to find two
Alchemists, a father and
daughter, who have gone into
seclusion deep in some forest
so that I can learn more about
the Stone of Sage.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
我要你找到两位炼金术士，
一对父女，他们隐居在森林深处，
这样我才能了解更多关于贤者之石的事。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Of course, this will
possibly further my
research, but it's also
how I'll judge whether or
not you're qualified for my
piece of the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
当然，这可能会
推进我的研究，
但这也是我判断你是否
有资格获得星泪石碎片的方式。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
The mystery of life.
The desire to discover its
secrets drives me through
all the research and sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
生命的奥秘。
想要揭开其秘密的渴望
驱使我进行所有的研究和牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I-I'm not that confident in
my abilities, but I do believe that everything in this world is created by certain rules. Still, would I be punished by God for trying to create life he did not intend?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
我...我对自己的能力并不自信，
但我相信这个世界的一切都是由特定的规则创造的。
不过，如果我试图创造上帝未曾打算的生命，我会受到惩罚吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
But I can't stop now.
One of these days, someone
will reveal the secret of life.
Why not me? That knowledge
would make humans greater
than any other race...
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
但我现在不能停下。
总有一天，有人会揭示生命的秘密。
为什么不能是我？
那种知识会让人类超越其他任何种族...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Ah, you've returned.
So, did you learn what
exactly is the Stone of Sage?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
啊，你回来了。
那么，你弄清楚贤者之石
到底是什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'm not sure,
but I was told that it's
red and can cure people.
But it might be something
we're already familiar with.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我不太确定，
但有人告诉我它是红色的，
而且能治疗人。
不过它可能只是
我们熟悉的东西。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
That's all...?
Maybe it was nothing
but a rumor after all.
A-anyway, please tell me
what you think it might be.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
就这些...？
也许那只是
一个谣言罢了。
不...不管怎样，请告诉我
你觉得那可能是什么。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
What...! Huh.
Perhaps I should just
forget about the Stone of
Sage and just research.
Still, I'm so ashamed of
relying on a rumor...
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
什...！啊。
也许我应该
忘掉贤者之石，
专心做研究。
但我还是很羞愧，
竟然依赖一个谣言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Thank you very much
for helping me. Now I can
go back to my studies and
hope that nobody bothers me.
But that'll never happen.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
非常感谢你的帮助。
现在我可以回去研究，
希望没人打扰我。
但这永远不会发生。
^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
W-well, you've earned this
piece of the Sobbing Starlight.
For the next piece, you must visit ^0063FFLady Jesqurienne^000000 in Geffen, the city of magic. Since she travels often, she's probably in the Inn.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
那...那么，你赢得了
这块星泪石碎片。
下一块碎片，你需要去吉芬，
那座魔法之城，拜访^0063FF杰斯库莉恩女士^000000。
因为她经常旅行，所以可能在旅店内。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
O-o-okay then.
Good luck getting
all the pieces of 
Sobbing Starlight,
{0}. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
好...好吧。
祝你在收集星泪石碎片时
好运，{0}。再见~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Err...?
I don't think
I quite understood
you. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
呃...？
我觉得我
没太听懂。
你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Now you must visit
^0063FFLady Jesqurienne^000000 in
Geffen. Good luck
passing her test.
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
现在你必须去吉芬，
拜访^0063FF杰斯库莉恩女士^000000。
祝你在她的测试中
好运。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
H-how is this supposed
to work? Like this? No!
No, that's not right!
Think, Jore, think...
What's the answer?!
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
这...这该怎么运作？
像这样吗？不！
不对，不是这样！
想想，乔尔，想想...
答案是什么？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a tense man
holding test tubes between
his fingers, standing in a pile
of books. He seems to be in
agony for some reason.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现一名神情紧绷的男子，
手指间夹着试管，站在书堆之中。
不知为何，他似乎正饱受痛苦。

scripts.text: Speak to him.
scripts.translation: 对话

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

^3355FFToo preoccupied with
his thoughts, this strange
man is unable to hear you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个奇怪的男子
太专注于思考，
听不见你的话。^000000

scripts.text: Try again.
scripts.translation: 再试一次

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
EXCUSE ME!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
...!
Oh, h-h-hello.
Sorry, but I'm kind of
busy right now. Yes, yes,
would you come back at
precisely 5:00 PM PST?
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
...！
哦，你...你好。
抱歉，我现在有点忙。
是的，是的，
你能在下午5点整
再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Let's see...
Now if I recalibrated
the faust exhaust, then
the bioneutron analyzer
would need to be adjusted
for cytoplasmic balance...
scripts.translation:
[乔尔爵士]
让我看看...
如果我重新校准了
排气装置，
那么生物中子分析仪
就需要调整
细胞质平衡...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
him alone and let him
continue mumbling to
himself and playing
with his test tubes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定让他一个人待着，
让他继续自言自语
并摆弄他的试管。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
him alone and let him
continue mumbling to
himself and playing
with his test tubes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定让他一个人待着，
让他继续自言自语
并摆弄他的试管。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
...z...z...Z

[Piru Piru]
Oh, I'm sooo tired~
But we can't sleep yet.
*Sob* Master, can't we
just call it a day already?
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
啊，我好累~
但我们还不能睡。
*抽泣* 师父，我们
能不能今天就结束？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Everyday we study and
take notes and test and
experiment and record
results and... Horrible!
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
每天我们都在学习、
做笔记、测试、
实验、记录结果...太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
....Zzz...Zzz...
Zzz....Zzz......
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
...Zzz...Zzz...
Zzz....Zzz......

scripts.text: What do you do in here?
scripts.translation: 你们在这里做什么？

scripts.text: About vanished Alchemists
scripts.translation: 关于失踪的炼金术士

scripts.text: What is the Stone of Sage?
scripts.translation: 什么是贤者之石？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
My master, Sir Jore,
is researching a way to
create artificial life! Still,
it's not easy and we haven't
accomplished anything yet...
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
我的师父，乔尔爵士，
正在研究创造人工生命的方法！
不过，这并不容易，
我们目前还没有取得任何成果...

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
It doesn't help that my
master spends all of his
time on research. He hasn't
been taking care of himself
and is losing a lot of weight.
I'm really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
更糟糕的是，
师父把所有时间都花在了研究上。
他完全不顾自己的身体，
体重掉得很厉害。
我真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Oh, the father and daughter
who were both Alchemists, right? Did you know they vanished because they invented the monster potion summoning skill?
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
哦，你是说那对
都是炼金术士的父女吧？
你知道他们是因为
发明了召唤魔物的药剂技能
才失踪的吗？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Their discovery caused
such great hysteria in the
scientific community. In the
end they had no choice but
to live in seclusion deep
in the ^CE3131forest to the south^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
他们的发现
在科学界引起了巨大的恐慌。
最终，他们别无选择，
只能隐居在^CE3131南方的森林深处^000000。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
They devoted their lives
to their research, just like
my master. If he makes a major
breakthrough, we'll have to
disappear like they did...
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
他们像我的师父一样，
将生命奉献给了研究。
如果师父取得了重大突破，
我们就得像他们一样
消失得无影无踪了...

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Hmm? Well, I wouldn't
know anything about that.
In fact, I'm always staying
in this lab, so I never hear
any rumors or news outside.
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
嗯？
关于那个，我什么都不知道。
事实上，我一直待在这个实验室里，
所以从来没听说过
外面的传闻或新闻。

scripts.text: What do you do in here?
scripts.translation: 你们在这里做什么？

scripts.text:

My master, Sir Jore,
is researching a way to
create artificial life! Still,
it's not easy and we haven't
accomplished anything yet...
scripts.translation:

我真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Although my master and I are the only ones who use this lab, we do have a set working schedule. We work from 10 AM to 5 PM and have our free time from 5 PM to 10 PM, which is when Master goes to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
虽然只有我和师父
使用这个实验室，
但我们还是有固定的工作日程的。
我们从上午10点工作到下午5点，
下午5点到晚上10点是休息时间，
师父通常在这个时候睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Of course, Master
is happy if he can
just do more research.
In any case, please visit
us after 5 PM if you have
any business with us.
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
当然，如果师父能
继续做研究，他会很高兴。
总之，如果您有事情要找我们，
请在下午5点之后再来。

scripts.text: Wake her up
scripts.translation: 叫醒她

scripts.text: Leave her sleep
scripts.translation: 让她继续睡

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Wh-wha...?
Why do you gotta
wake me up? Come back
after 10:00 AM tomorrow, kay?
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
什...什么...？
为什么要叫醒我？
明天上午10点以后再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Zzzz.....Zzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[皮鲁皮鲁]
Zzzz.....Zzzzz...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a glimpse
of a girl heading directly
into a deep forest. You decide
to follow her and see if you can
learn more.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你瞥见一个女孩
径直走进了森林深处。
你决定跟着她，
看看能否了解更多。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a glimpse
of a girl heading directly
into a deep forest. You decide
to follow her and see if you can
learn more.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你瞥见一个女孩
径直走进了森林深处。
你决定跟着她，
