scripts.text:
[Pleur]
La la la~
La la la~
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
啦啦啦~
啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Hmmm...?
The Stone of Sage...
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
嗯...？
贤者之石...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Hello darling.
What did you do today?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
你好，亲爱的。
你今天做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Oh...!
You scared us!
Roaring like some
animal! What do you
think you were doing?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
噢...！
你吓到我们了！
像野兽一样咆哮！
你在干什么？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Sometimes I miss
being an alchemist.
But then again, a man
of my brilliance and genius
would put all those newbie
scientists to shame~
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
有时候我会怀念
当炼金术士的日子。
不过话说回来，
像我这样才华横溢的天才，
肯定会让那些新手
科学家自愧不如~

scripts.text: [Gordon]
scripts.translation: [戈登]

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
I played Hide-and-Seek
with a white bear and a
blue bear, father.
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
我和一只白熊
还有一只蓝熊
玩了捉迷藏，爸爸。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Darling...
Aren't you tired
of playing with the
animals? We've lived
in this forest for so long...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
亲爱的...
你不觉得
和动物玩腻了吗？
我们在这片森林里
已经住很久了...

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Don't worry father, I understand. For now, this is the only place where we can relax and live inpeace. I think we deserve to rest after accomplishing our goals...
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
别担心，爸爸，我懂。
至少现在，这里是
我们唯一能放松
和平生活的地方。
我想在达成目标后，
我们值得休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Thank you, Pluer.
I have no regrets about
our work, but sometimes
I do wish for a more
carefree life for you...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
谢谢你，普勒尔。
我对我们的工作
没有遗憾，但有时候
我也希望能让你
过上更轻松的生活...

scripts.text: Roar~!
Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
No no no!
Summon Flora!
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
不不不！
生物调拨！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Great Schott!
Summon... Marine Sphere!
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
伟大的肖特！
生物调拨...气泡虫！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Eh?! Don't you know
how dangerous this place
is? What are you doing
here in the middle of
this forest?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
咦？！你不知道
这里有多危险吗？
你在这森林深处
做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I think
I've been looking for
you. I've been sent on
an errand to find these
two famous Alchemists.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我一直在
找你们。我受命
寻找这两位
著名的炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Mm...?
Well, we're retired
now, but I suppose it'd
do no harm if you had
something to ask us...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
嗯...？
好吧，我们现在
已经退休了，但如果你
有什么想问的，
问我们也无妨...

scripts.text: Ask about Stone of Sage
scripts.translation: 询问贤者之石

scripts.text: Ask about Alchemy
scripts.translation: 询问融合试验

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Stone of Sage?
Huh. To be honest,
I don't know anything
about it at all. I guess
its existence is pretty
much just a rumor, really.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
贤者之石？
嗯。说实话，
我对此一无所知。
我想它的存在
基本上只是个传说。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
All I've heard is that
the Stone of Sage might
be a catylst to transmute
materials into gold. If it
really existed, it would be
the ultimate alchemic item.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
我只听说贤者之石
可能是将材料
转化为金的催化剂。
如果它真的存在，
那将是终极的
炼金物品。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
However, I've also heard
it's red, can make humans
immortal and can cure any
sort of disease or ailment.
Just where do these rumors
come from? It's crazy...
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
不过，我也听说
它是红色的，能让人
长生不老，还能治愈
任何疾病。
这些传闻是从哪来的？
太疯狂了...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Now, I even hear that some
people are working on trying
to create the stone themselves.
If they succeed, it'll have a huge effect on the entire world!
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
现在，我甚至听说
有些人正在尝试
自己制造这块石头。
如果他们成功了，
将对整个世界
产生巨大影响！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
I'm sorry that you've gone
through the trouble of finding
us for this kind of information. We're retired after all, so we
may be out of the loop.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
很抱歉你费心
来找我们打听这些。
毕竟我们已经退休了，
可能消息不太灵通。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Although we're retired, we
would be much interested in
knowing if someone does manage
to create such a stone. If that
happens, would you tell us?
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
虽然我们退休了，
但如果有人真的
制造出了这样的石头，
我们还是很想知道的。
如果发生了这样的事，
你会告诉我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Now let me guide you
on a safe path back out
of this maze. I've lived here
quite a while, so I can find
the exit with my eyes closed.
Farewell, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
现在让我指引你
一条安全的路离开这个迷宫。
我在这里住了很久了，
闭着眼睛都能找到出口。
再见了，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
I hope you understand that
my father and I devoted and sacrificed so much for our work. Finally, we discovered a way to summon monsters using potions.
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
我希望你能理解，
我和我父亲为我们的工作
付出了巨大的心血和牺牲。
最终，我们发现了
一种使用药水召唤魔物的方法。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
However, too many Alchemists
hounded us for our information
once we announced the results
of our research. It was more
than we could handle...
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
然而，当我们公布
研究成果后，
太多的炼金术士
为了获取信息而纠缠我们。
这超出了我们的承受能力...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
I'm sorry, but if you have any
questions about Alchemy, there
are many qualified researchers and practitioners out there. We came to this forest to find peace...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
很抱歉，如果你对融合试验
有任何问题，
外面有很多合格的研究员
和从业者。我们来到这片森林
是为了寻找平静...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Hah hah hah~
Did you forget
what you were
going to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
哈哈~
你忘了
你要问什么了吗？

Hah hah hah~
Did you forget
what you were
going to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
哈哈~
你忘了
你要问什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
D...
D...Daddy!!
scripts.translation:
[普勒尔]
爸...
爸...爸爸！！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Heh heh~
Am I being
too arrogant?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
嘿嘿~
我是不是
太傲慢了？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bartender~?
Give me another drink.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
调酒师~？
再给我来一杯。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
It amuses me that
you think that you'd
stand a chance against
me in a Quiz Challenge.
Ho ho ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
你觉得你能在问答挑战中
赢过我，
这让我觉得很有趣。
呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bwahahahaha!
You should have known
from the beginning that you
never had a chance! Of course,
I did, but you know, I guess you had to learn for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
你一开始就该知道
你根本没有机会！当然，
我有机会，但你知道，
我想你得自己体会一下。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
What...?
I... I...
I don't b-believe it.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
什...？
我...我...
我...我不相信。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ooooh...
My head...
Oh...! It's you...!
So did you find Dearles?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
噢...
我的头...
噢...！是你...！
那么，你找到迪尔莱斯了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
OoOooOhh~
Sooooo dizzy.
Maybe I drank
too much again~
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
噢噢噢~
好...好晕。
也许我又
喝太多了~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ahhhhhh~
Hm? Why hello there,
you fine speciman of a man~
I'm Jesqurienne. You've heard
of me, haven't you? Aren't you surprised to see me?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
啊~
嗯？你好呀，
你这位优秀的男士~
我是杰斯库莉恩。你听说过
我，对吧？见到我是不是很惊讶？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ahhhhhh~
Hm? Why hello there,
you precious, adorable girl~
I'm Jesqurienne. You've heard

[Jesqurienne]
Ho ho ho~!
Surely you
must be joking~

[杰斯库莉恩]

scripts.text: You got me, you got me.

scripts.text: Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.

[Jesqurienne]

I knew it! I knew it!
Then again, there's little
that a famous genius like

[杰斯库莉恩]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~！

......

......

就算见到了著名的
天才，

scripts.text:

[杰斯库莉恩]
总之，我为自己
超凡的智慧感到自豪！
我可能对研究有点
痴迷，但这正是
值得你崇拜我的理由~

[Jesqurienne]
The Wizard and Sage

Even the Alchemist test

I haven't met anyone
smarter than me~

[杰斯库莉恩]
巫师和贤者的
考试？小菜一碟~
连炼金术士的
测试也相当简单。到目前为止，
我还没遇到过
比我更聪明的人~

scripts.text: ^333333Stuck-up chick.^000000
Take it easy on the drinks...
scripts.translation: 少喝点酒吧...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
What...?
What did you say?
No one has ever
said anything like
that to me before!
H-how dare you...

[杰斯库莉恩]
什...？
你说什么？
从来没有人
对我说过
这种话！
你...你怎么敢...

[Jesqurienne]
Prove that you can
hold a candle to my
superior intellect and
I'll be willing to accept
your little insult! It's time

[杰斯库莉恩]

能与我相提并论，
我就愿意接受
你的小小侮辱！

问答挑战了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Quiz... Challenge?
Like a trivia game?
But who's going to
ask us the questions?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
问答...挑战？
就像知识问答游戏？
但是谁
来出题呢？

[Aaron]
Did someone say
''Quiz Challenge?''

scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
有人提到

我想我可以
帮上忙。

Professor Aaron?

the questions, it looks
like your chances of
beating me are zero!

[杰斯库莉恩]
亚伦智者？

出题，
看来你打败我的

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ho ho ho~
Plenty of people have
told me not to drink so
much. But once I start
I can't stop. I love to
drink that much!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
呵呵呵~
很多人
都劝我少喝点。但一旦开始
我就停不下来。我这么
爱喝酒！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
And...
Sometimes I'd rather
look at the world through
these hazy eyes. See things
the way I want to see them...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
而且...
有时候我宁愿
透过这朦胧的双眼
看世界。以我
想要的方式看...

[Jesqurienne]
Professor Aaron

to ask him to begin.
And I'm waiting for the
moment when you realize
you have no hope of winning!

[杰斯库莉恩]
亚伦智者
正等着你
邀请他开始。
而我在等待
你意识到
自己毫无胜算的那一刻！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I'd insult you if it weren't for the fact that you embarassed yourself enough during the Quiz Challenge. As a matter of fact, I'll even forgive you for wounding my pride earlier.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
要不是你在问答挑战中
已经出够了丑，
我早就侮辱你了。事实上，
我甚至原谅你
之前伤害了我的自尊。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Can you believe it?
Even drunk I can beat
you in a test of intelligence!
Bwahaha! I can't believe how
simple minded you are...!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
你能相信吗？
即使喝醉了，
我也可以在智力测试中
打败你！
哇哈哈！我真不敢相信
你有多笨...

scripts.text: I can't let you win!
scripts.translation: 我不能让你赢！

scripts.text: Darn it...
scripts.translation: 该死...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
You're a slow learner,

your ''challenge'' anytime!

scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]

[Jesqurienne]

able to beat me in

[杰斯库莉恩]
你是唯一
能在智力对决中

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
{0}...
I will remember that.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
{0}...
我会记住这个名字的。

让我把这个交给
一个值得的人。

但我想，你才是它真正的主人...

就知道答案了。
你还在想吗？
我觉得你应该不知道才对！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I...
Hold on,
I know this one...
(Oh craaaaaap!)
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我...
等一下，
这个我知道...
(糟糕了！)

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Oh? What a surprise.
I'm in the lead. I know
the suspense must be
killing you, but I'm pretty
sure who the winner will
be. Me me me meee~
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哦？真是令人惊讶。
我领先了。我知道这种悬念
一定让你抓心挠肝，
但我相当确定赢家是谁。
是我，是我，是我，是我~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Are you copying
my answers? Because
there's no way we can
be tied right now...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
你在抄我的答案吗？
因为现在不可能
出现平局的情况...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I...
I must be more
drunk than I thought
if I'm losing right now...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我...
看来我喝得比我以为的
还要醉，
居然现在落后了...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
6. What is the
correct weight
for 1 Empty Bottle?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
6. 1个“空瓶”的
正确重量是多少？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
6. Choose the
correct DEF for
the Indian Filet item.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
6. 选出“印度牛排”
物品正确的防御力。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
6. What is the
city closest to
Turtle Island?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
6. 距离“海龟岛”
最近的城市是哪个？

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Comodo
scripts.translation: 克魔岛

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Simple questions,
simple answers.
Did you get it?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
简单的问题，
简单的答案。
你答对了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
W-wait...!
I know the
answer to this
one! Just let me
th-think...!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
等...等一下！
这道题我知道答案！
让我...让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Oh, look at that.
I have more points
than you. I know, it
must be frustrating
trying to keep up.
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哎呀，你看。
我的分数比你高。
我知道，
想要追上我肯定很让人沮丧吧。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Mmm...?
How are you cheating?!
You having the same score
as me must be impossible!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
嗯...？
你作弊了？！
你的分数竟然和我一样，
这绝对不可能！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I don't understand.
You have a higher sco--
I don't-- How can yo--
Why is this happening?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我不明白。
你的分数比我还高...--
我不...你怎么...--
为什么会这样？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
7. Fifty-one multiplied
by fifteen, divided by three,
plus five is equal to...?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
7. 五十一乘以十五，
除以三，
再加五，等于...？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
7. Four thousand five hundred sixty divided by four, divided by two, plus three is equal to...?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
7. 四千五百六十除以四，
再除以二，
再加三，等于...？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
7. Three thousand one hundred
two added to five hundred, plus four, divided by six equals...
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
7. 三千一百零二
加上五百，
再加四，
除以六，等于...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Math?
My mind is
a veritable
calculator!
Ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
数学？
我的大脑
简直就是一台
计算器！
呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
What the--?!
Why is all the math
written out in words
instead of the traditional
numerics and symbols?!
A-answer me--!!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
这...？！
为什么所有的数学题
都是用文字写出来的，
而不是传统的数字和符号？！
回...回答我--！！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ah. Did I tell you
I was in the lead
right now? Well, let
me remind you, in case
I forget. Ho ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
啊。我是不是说过
我现在领先？
让我提醒你一下，
免得我忘了。呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
That's it.
I don't understand
how your score is
equal to mine. Are
you getting bonus
points somehow?!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
真是的。
我不明白
为什么你的分数
和我一样。
你是在偷偷
加分吗？！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
There's no other
explanation! You've
got to be using some
sort of crib sheet! But
where are you hiding it?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
没有别的
解释了！
你肯定是在用
什么小抄！
但你把它藏在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
8. Choose the building
that is the closest to the
Item Upgrade Place in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
8. 选择距离朱诺的
物品强化处
最近的建筑。

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Monster Library
scripts.translation: 魔物图书馆

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
8. Choose the Hunter's
Trap skill which does not
inflict Property Damage.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
8. 选择猎人
陷阱技能中
不造成
属性伤害的
那一个。

scripts.text: Claymore Trap
scripts.translation: 爆散陷阱

scripts.text: Freezing Trap
scripts.translation: 霜冻陷阱

scripts.text: Shockwave Trap
scripts.translation: 魔耗陷阱

scripts.text: Land Mine
scripts.translation: 地雷陷阱

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Hah hah~!
That was a
piece of cake!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哈哈~！
这简直是
小菜一碟！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Grrr...
Why don't
I know this one?!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
呜...
为什么
我不知道
这道题？！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I know, you're wondering
how such an intelligent
person can exist. Well,
I guess my intellect sort
of balances the stupidity
of the rest of the world...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我知道，你在想
怎么会有
这么聪明的人。
嗯，我想我的智慧
大概平衡了
这个世界的愚蠢吧...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
How can our scores
be equal? No... No...
Think, Jesqurienne...
Time travel isn't possible.
But why would you time travel
for the answers to a quiz?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我们的分数
怎么会一样？
不...不...
想想看，杰斯库莉恩...
时间旅行是不可能的。
但你为什么要
为了测验答案
进行时间旅行呢？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I... I don't
get it. H-how are
you w-winning? M-my
whole perception of
reality is starting t-to...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我...我不明白。
你...你怎么
赢...赢了？
我对现实的
认知开始...开始...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
9. Which monster would
receive the most damage
from a Fire Property Dagger?
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
9. 哪种魔物
会受到
火属性短剑
最多的伤害？

scripts.text: Dagger Goblin
scripts.translation: 刺刀哥布灵

scripts.text: Mace Goblin
scripts.translation: 钝器哥布灵

scripts.text: Morning Star Goblin
scripts.translation: 日星锤哥布灵

scripts.text: Hammer Goblin
scripts.translation: 锤子哥布灵

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
9. Choose the monster
on which the Mage skill,
''Stone Curse,'' is ineffective. ^FFFFFFaaaaaa aaaaaaa aaaaaa aaaaaaa aaaaaaaaa^000000
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
9. 选择魔法师
技能
“石化术”
对其无效的魔物。 ^FFFFFFaaaaaa aaaaaaa aaaaaa aaaaaaa aaaaaaaaa^000000

scripts.text: Elder Willow
scripts.translation: 长老树精

scripts.text: Evil Druid
scripts.translation: 暗神官

scripts.text: Magnolia
scripts.translation: 魔锅蛋

scripts.text: Marc
scripts.translation: 马克

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ahhh...
I'm just breezing
through this Quiz Challenge!
Aren't you having a hard time?
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
啊哈...
我简直是在
轻松通过
这次测验挑战！
你难道不觉得
很难吗？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Huh...?
I don't understand
why I don't know this...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
咦...？
我不明白
为什么
我不知道
这道题...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bwahahaha!
Only one question
left! You have to get
this one right or I'll
call you stupid forever!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哇哈哈哈！
只剩最后一题了！
你必须答对这一题，
否则我会永远
叫你笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
We're tied?!
Oh no... I better
get this last question
right. (And I hope that
you get it wrong!)
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我们打平？！
糟糕...我最好
答对最后一题。
（希望你答错！）

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I'm losing?!
And we're at the
last question already?!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
我要输了？！
而且已经是
最后一题了？！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
10. Choose the NPC
that looks different
than all the others.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
10. 选出与其他NPC
外观不同的那一个。

scripts.text: Prontera Hollgrehenn
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉 霍尔格雷恩

scripts.text: Prontera Doll Merchant
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉 玩偶商人

scripts.text: Izlude Meat Merchant
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛 肉类商人

scripts.text: Morocc Meat Merchant
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇 肉类商人

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
10. Choose the item
that cannot be equipped
by Novice class characters.
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
10. 选出初心者
无法装备的物品。

scripts.text: Funeral Hat
scripts.translation: 葬礼帽

scripts.text: Shackles
scripts.translation: 脚炼

scripts.text: Wooden Mail
scripts.translation: 木制盔甲

scripts.text: Pantie
scripts.translation: 内裤

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
As usual, I got
the last question
absolutely right~
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
照例，最后一题
我答得完全正确~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Huh...
Wh-what was
the question again?
Nooo, I missed it!
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
咦...
那...刚才
题目是什么来着？
不...我错过了！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Okay, the quiz
is over! Now, I'll
reveal the results
of the competitors...
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
好了，测验
结束了！现在，
我要公布
选手们的成绩...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Umm...
{0}:
{1} points!

[Aaron]
Jesqurienne...
{0} points!
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
杰斯库莉恩...
{0}分！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bwahahaha!
I win! I knew it!
Ho ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
哇哈哈哈！
我赢了！我就知道！
呵呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Tied?! 
Alright, I'm impressed.
I'll admit, you're much
smarter than I thought...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
打平？！
好吧，我有点惊讶。
我承认，你比我
想象中聪明多了...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
No...!
I can't...
Believe this...
scripts.translation:
[杰斯库莉恩]
不...！
我不...
敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Thank you
for playing!
.......................
...........................
Alright, back to drinking!
Um, I'm a dude...
scripts.translation: 呃，我是男的...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
N-no...!
M-maybe I should
take it easy on the
alcohol. I do have classes
to teach tomorrow anyway...
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
不...！
也许我
应该少喝点酒。
反正明天
还要上课...

scripts.text: Why, thank you~
scripts.translation: 谢谢夸奖~

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Ah, yes. Your
sense of style, your
magnificent body. Everything
about you is beautiful! Not just that, but you're also intelligent!
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
啊，是的。你的品味，你那完美的身材。你的一切都那么迷人！不仅如此，你还很有智慧！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
I should know!
Not only do I teach
classes, but I'm also
a Quiz Challenge moderater
master in my spare time~
You're truly a jewel...
scripts.translation:
[亚伦]
我可是很清楚的！
我不仅教书，
业余时间还是问答挑战的
主持人兼大师~
你真是颗瑰宝...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
No...! Damn it,
not again! When's
my lucky streak
gonna start?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
不...！
该死，
又来了！
我的好运
什么时候才能开始？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Eh heh heh~
Soooooo, did you
bring the money?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿嘿嘿~
那么，
你带钱了吗？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Nice, you're here
just in time. Well,
all that matters is that
you come during the night.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
不错，你来得
正是时候。反正，
重要的是
你在晚上来。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey... When I say
''tomorrow night,'' I mean,
come and talk to me at nighttime! Don't you know anything about shady dealings?! Pfft! Adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿... 我说
“明天晚上”，
意思是晚上来找我！
你连做黑市交易的基本常识都不懂吗？
哼！冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright! I want you to
bring me a bunch of items!
Yeah, I know, you're a real
pro at this, but let me set
you straight before you blow
this off as a piece of cake...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好吧！我要你
给我带一堆东西！
没错，我知道
你很擅长这个，
但在我把它当成
小蛋糕之前，
让我先给你讲讲规矩...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ah, so is this
the stuff you brought?
Lemme take a look-see...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
啊，这就是
你带来的东西？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you gotta
finish Part Two of
my test. I'm gonna send
you to Lamadin now...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你得
完成我测试的
第二部分。我现在
要派你去拉马丁那里...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
You failed Part Two,
the rhythm portion of
my freakin' test?! If you
wanna try again, you're
welcome to another chance...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
你竟然没通过
我测试的第二部分，
节奏部分？！
如果你想再试一次，
我允许你再给一次机会...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, Lamadin
tells me you passed.
Not the best performance,
but it's good enough.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好吧，拉马丁
告诉我你通过了。
表现不算最好，
但足够了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Lamadin tells me
you passed. Since you
did so good, I'm gonna
give you ^333333some^000000 of your money
back. Not all, but most of it.
Isn't that reward enough?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
拉马丁告诉我
你通过了。既然你
表现这么好，我会
还给你^333333一些^000000钱。
不是全部，但大部分。
这个奖励还不够吗？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Whaaaaaaaaaat are
you doing back here?
Fine, since we know each
other, I'm borrowing some
cash. You know, for old
time's sake. ^FF0000Yoink!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
哇啊啊啊
你回这里干什么？
好吧，既然我们
认识，我借点
现金。你知道的，
为了旧情。^FF0000拿走！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Whaaaaaaaaaat are
you doing back here?
I got nothin' for you and
you obviously have nothing
for me! Now lemme gamble!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
哇啊啊啊
你回这里干什么？
我没什么给你的，
你显然也没东西给我！
现在让我去赌博！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, why are you
still talkin' to me?
You finished my test.
It's over. Not get outta
here before I jack some
more of your cash!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你为什么
还跟我说话？
你完成了我的测试。
结束了。趁我
再抢你点钱之前
赶紧滚！

scripts.text: [Dearles]
scripts.translation: [迪尔莱斯]

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. Hah! You are poor!
It also looks like you're low on cash~! Well, this is what guys like me to do to shameless
moochers like you!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你看起来
像是有事求我。
哈！你很穷！
看起来你现金也不多了~！
这就是像我这样的人
对待像你这种
厚脸皮乞讨者的方式！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you got zeny to spare! I think I'll help myself and borrow some of your cash!
^FF0000Yoink!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你看起来
像是有事求我。
看起来你还有富余的Zeny！
我想我会
借点你的现金！
^FF0000拿走！^000000

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text: Just pass by.
scripts.translation: 只是路过

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What is it?!
I'm not in the mood
for chatting with complete
and total strangers, so
get to the point~!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
什么事？！
我可没心情
跟完全陌生的家伙
闲聊，所以
有话快说~！

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么。

scripts.text: I'm here for Metz...?
scripts.translation: 我是来找梅茨的...？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Wha...? You bother
me and make lose this
game for nothing? For that,
I'll freakin' beat you to near
freakin' death! Bam bam bam!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
什...？你打扰我
让我白白输掉这局？
为此，我非把你
揍个半死不可！
砰！砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Oh. You're here for
the Sobbing Starlight, huh? If you wanna take my test, there's *ahem* a fee of 30,000 zeny. So take it or leave it, capish?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
哦。你是来找
星泪石的，是吧？
如果你想参加我的测试，
有*咳*一笔30,000 Zeny的费用。
所以要么接受，要么走人，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I'll have nothing
to do with you if you
can't pay up. Just think
of the fee as a preliminary
for my test. You know, to
weed out the riffraff.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
如果你付不起钱，
我就跟你没关系了。
就把这笔费用当作
我测试的预付款吧。
你知道，为了
筛掉那些杂鱼。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Crap...!
I'm almost broke!
But I gotta win all
my cash back! How can
I raise more money fast
without actually working...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
该死...！
我快破产了！
但我必须
赢回我所有的钱！
怎么才能在不动用
劳动力的情况下
快速搞到更多钱...

scripts.text: Here you are...
scripts.translation: 给你...

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 还没...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ummm.......
When I say 30,000 zeny,
I mean 30,000 zeny! I'll let
you off on account of you looking like you're not smart enough to know how to count. But pull this
on me again and I'll...!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嗯......
我说30,000 Zeny，
就是30,000 Zeny！
看在你看起来
不够聪明，不知道
怎么数数的份上，
我就放过你一次。
但如果你再敢
这样对我...！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ummm.......
Heh heh~
That's thirty grand,
alright! Okay, come back
to me tomorrow night and
we'll start your test...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嗯......
嘿嘿~
那是三万块，
没错！好吧，明天晚上
再来找我，
我们就开始你的测试...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Huh...?
Alright, but you
better hurry. I can
change my mind at
any time, you know!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嗯...？
好吧，但你
最好快点。
我随时
都可能改变主意，
你知道的！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
You're wondering how
a guy like me is pals with
Metz, but that's none of your
business. I guess I gotta keep
this promise to him, so when
you're ready, say the word.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
你在想像我这样的
家伙怎么跟梅茨
是朋友，但这
不是你的事。
我想我得
遵守对他的承诺，
所以当你准备好了，
说一声就行。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I'm not gonna give you an
exact list of items I want. Oh
no, what you gotta do is bring
me artsy crafts. This test is
gonna judge your appreciation
for... Craftsmanship~
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
我不会给你
一份确切的物品清单。
哦不，你要做的是
给我带来艺术品。
这个测试
将评判你对...工艺的鉴赏力~

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Since I'm seeing whether
or not you got good taste,
variety is the important thing
here. So don't bring freakin'
a hundred of the same object.
Just one of each kind'll do.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
既然我在看
你有没有好的品味，
多样性是这里
最重要的。所以别带来
一百个同样的东西。
每种只要一个就够了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What are you
standin' around
waiting for? Bring
those collection items!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
你站在那里
等什么？
带来那些
收藏品！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Nice, nice~
These'll sell for--
Er, I'm glad to say
that you pass for now.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
不错，不错~
这些能卖到--
呃，我很高兴
说你暂时通过了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I think you're ready
for the next step. Now,
I'm gonna send you to
Lamadin for Part Two
of my test. Yeah, I know...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
我觉得你准备好
进入下一步了。现在，
我要派你去
找拉马丁进行
我测试的第二部分。
是的，我知道...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hmm... Some of this
stuff looks good, but
there isn't enough variety
here that proves your eye for
craftsmanship. Come back
with more stuff, alright?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嗯... 这些东西
有些看起来不错，但
这里的多样性不足以
证明你对工艺的鉴赏力。
带更多东西回来，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hmm...
All the stuff you're
carrying? Worthless junk!
Go and find stuff that was
skillfully crafted, okay?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嗯...
你携带的所有东西？
都是无用的垃圾！
去找到那些
精心制作的东西，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
And by crafts I don't mean
potions, weapons, equipment,
none of that. Just think of, well, stuff you'd show off in your rooom and you'll be on the right track. Remember, variety!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
而且我说的工艺
不是指药水、武器、装备，
都不是。想想，嗯，
你会在房间里展示的东西，
你就在正确的轨道上了。
记住，多样性！

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Okay...
Just keep in mind
that Part Two was 
supposed to be
the easy part...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好吧...
只要记住
第二部分
本来应该是
简单的那部分...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What...?
Alright, but you
really shouldn't give
up. I mean, Part Two is
supposed to be ridiculously
easy. I made it that way...
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
什...？
好吧，但你真的
不应该放弃。
我是说，第二部分
本来应该是
简单到离谱的。
是我把它设计成那样的...

scripts.text:
Alright, Lamadin
tells me you passed.
Not the best performance,
but it's good enough.
scripts.translation:
拉马丁告诉我你通过了。
表现不算最好，
但已经足够好了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, take this chunk
of Sobbing Starlight and
go find someone named,
um, ''Bakerlan'' in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好了，拿着这块
星泪石，
去找艾尔贝塔
一个叫
“贝克兰”的人。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Well, that's it.
There's no reason
for you to ever see
me again. But yeah,
good luck with that
Sobbing Starlight business.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好了，就这样。
你再也没有理由
见到我了。不过嘛，
祝你在星泪石
的事情上好运。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, take this chunk
of Sobbing Starlight and
go find someone named,
um, ''Bakerlan'' in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好了，拿着这块
星泪石，
去找艾尔贝塔
一个叫
“贝克兰”的人。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Well, that's it.
There's no reason
for you to ever see
me again. But yeah,
good luck with that
Sobbing Starlight business.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
好了，就这样。
你再也没有理由
见到我了。不过嘛，
祝你在星泪石
的事情上好运。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you're low on cash~! Well, this is what guys like me to do to shameless
moochers like you!
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你那个表情
看起来像是想从我这
得到什么。而且看起来
你手头也不宽裕~！
哼，像我这样的人
就是专门对付
像你这种厚脸皮
白吃白喝的人的！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you got zeny to spare! I think I'll help myself and borrow some of your cash!
^FF0000Yoink!^000000
Giggle giggle..
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
嘿，你那个表情
看起来像是想从我这
得到什么。而且看起来
你还有不少Zeny！
我想我就
借一点你的钱吧！
^FF0000拿走！^000000
嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: I want to take Part Two again.
scripts.translation: 我想再考一次第二部分。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Fine, fine.
Geez, why do
these guys always
come and bother me?
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
行吧，行吧。
天哪，为什么
这些人总是
来打扰我？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Wha...?
Part Two
was really
that fun? Fine,
knock yourself out.
scripts.translation:
[迪尔莱斯]
什...？
第二部分
真的那么
有趣吗？好吧，
尽管去考吧。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Welcome to
Part Two of Dearles'
exam where your sense
of rhythm will be tested~
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
欢迎来到迪尔莱斯
考试的第二部分，
这里将考验你的
节奏感~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Please click on the
Chat Room to enter the
Standby Room. When it's
your turn, the test will begin!
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
请点击
聊天室进入
候考室。轮到你的时候，
测试就会开始！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Oh, what a shame!
You failed this time.
But don't you worry...
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
让我看看...
你是{0}？
哎呀，真遗憾！
你这次没通过。
不过别担心...

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Congratulations!
You passed the test!
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
让我看看...
你是{0}？
恭喜！
你通过了测试！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Congratulations!
You got a perfect
score on this test!
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
让我看看...
你是{0}？
恭喜！
你在这项测试中
获得了满分！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
H-how did you
find your way here?
This is private property,
owned by Mister Dearles.
Please leave immediately!
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
你...你是怎么
找到这里的？
这是迪尔莱斯先生
的私人领地。
请立刻离开！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Please click on the
Chat Room to enter the
Standby Room. When it's
your turn, the test will begin!
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
请点击
聊天室进入
候考室。轮到你的时候，
测试就会开始！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
The top left pole
means 'Up,' and there
are a total of four marks
designated as Upper, Lower
Left and Right. Hitting each
mark will produce a sound.
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
左上角的杆
代表“上”，
总共有四个标记，
分别指定为上、下、
左和右。击中每个
标记都会发出声音。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
During the test,
you must hit the marks
according to the given
instructions in order to
play music. Nifty, huh?
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
在测试过程中，
你必须按照给定的
指令击中标记，
以演奏音乐。很巧妙，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'm in charge of grading
your performance and determining your qualification. Please do your best and come back to me when
you finish the test. Good luck~
Please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
我负责评分
并决定你是否合格。请尽力
完成测试，结束后
回来找我。祝你好运~
请尽力表现。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
The top left pole
means 'Up,' and there
are a total of four marks
designated as Upper, Lower
Left and Right. Hitting each
mark will produce a sound.
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
左上角的杆
代表“上”，
总共有四个标记，
分别指定为上、下、
左和右。击中每个
标记都会发出声音。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
During the test,
you must hit the marks
according to the given
instructions in order to
play music. Nifty, huh?
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
在测试过程中，
你必须按照给定的
指令击中标记，
以演奏音乐。很巧妙，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'm in charge of grading
your performance and determining your qualification. Please do your best and come back to me when
you finish the test. Good luck~
Please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
我负责评分
并决定你是否合格。请尽力
完成测试，结束后
回来找我。祝你好运~
请尽力表现。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
You're welcome to
try again whenever
you want, alright?
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
你随时都可以
再试一次，好吗？
谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'll send a message to
Mister Dearles right away,
so please go speak to him
again. Once again, great job~
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
我会立刻
给迪尔莱斯先生
发消息，
所以请再去和他
对话一次。再次，
干得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'll send a message to
Mister Dearles right away,
so please go speak to him
again. He may even give
you a reward since you
did such a great job~
scripts.translation:
[拉马丁]
我会立刻给迪尔莱斯先生发消息，
所以请再去和他对话一次。
既然你表现得这么出色，
他说不定还会给你奖励呢~

scripts.text:
[Exit]
Would you like to go out?
scripts.translation:
[出口]
您想要离开吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Exit]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[出口]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Umm...well then...
I shall take the action for Prontera...
And for Juno...
Awww....
Gosh, this is such a pain in the ass...
Mumble mumble...
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯...那么...
我将为普隆德拉采取行动...
还有朱诺...
哎呀...
真是让人头疼...
嘟嘟囔囔...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Gosh.....
I do not know what I should do about Juno...
?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
真是的.....
我不知道该拿朱诺怎么办...
？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm...? You've
finished all of the
tests up until Dearle's
challenge? Prove it to me
with your pieces of the
Sobbing Starlight...
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯...？你已经
完成了直到迪尔莱斯
挑战之前的所有测试？
用你的星泪石碎片
向我证明吧...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Please speak to my
steward for all matters
related to the delivery
that you must complete
for my test.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
关于你必须为我的测试
完成的送货事宜，
请去和我的管家对话。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah yes, Mahatra tells
me that you've completed
the delivery. Well, um, he now
has another assignment for
for you to complete. So
please talk to him again.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
啊，是的，玛哈特拉告诉我
你已经完成了送货。嗯，
他现在还有另一个任务
要交给你完成。所以
请再和他对话一次。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
You have not finished yet.
Why don't you go finish them first?
I am a busy businessman.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
你还没完成呢。
为什么不去先完成它们？
我是个忙碌的商人。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah, I was informed about you.
Well, although you have your goal,
that does not necessarily mean to help that kid.
Metz must have an eye for a right person, I assume.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
啊，我已经收到关于你的消息了。
嗯，虽然你有你的目标，
但这并不意味着要帮助那个小孩。
我想梅茨一定看人很准。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Umm....
Did I see you wrong? Or did Metz do?
...I do not have any more business with you.
Take care now.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯....
是我看错你了？还是梅茨看错了？
...我和你再没什么事要谈了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
How is it going?
In fact, we want to do it on our own...
but we are too preoccupied with our works...
I hope you will keep up the good work.
I am also curious what that stone is.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
进展如何？
其实，我们想自己去做...
但我们太忙于工作...
希望你能继续保持好的表现。
我也很好奇那块石头是什么。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Mr. Metz sent me.
scripts.translation: 梅茨先生派我来的

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm...
I am pretty busy at this moment. So please do not interrupt me any further.
If you are looking for a job,
please inquire of my steward.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯...
我现在很忙。所以请不要再打扰我了。
如果你在找工作，
请去问我的管家。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah....
He did?....Hmmm..
Unfortunately I am kind of busy...
will you please come back later?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
啊....
他说了吗？....嗯...
不幸的是，我有点忙...
请你稍后再来好吗？
谢谢。

scripts.text: Give me a minute...
scripts.translation: 给我一分钟...

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 给你...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Well, you better
come back soon. I'm
a busy businessman, so
my time is quite precious.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯，你最好快点回来。我是个
忙碌的商人，所以我的时间
非常宝贵。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm, I suppose you
still haven't completed
all the tests. These aren't
enough pieces of the Sobbing
Starlight, you know...
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯，我想你
还没完成所有的测试。这些
星泪石的碎片还不够，你知道吗...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah, now I see that
you speak the truth.
Alright, we can begin my test.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
啊，现在我看出来
你说的是实话了。
好吧，我们可以开始我的测试了。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
First, I wish for you to make
a delivery. The object I want you to deliver is expensive and must be handled with care. Don't lose it or you will fail. Now, speak to my steward for more information.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
首先，我希望你
完成一次送货。我要你送的东西
很贵重，必须小心处理。弄丢了你就
会失败。现在，去和我的管家对话
以获取更多信息。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hm? It's not possible for
you to have this many pieces
of the Sobbing Starlight!
These must be fakes. How
dare you! Leave me!
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
哼？你不可能拥有这么多星泪石的碎片！
这些肯定是赝品。你竟敢如此！
给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Well, I wanted to assign you some various tasks
on my own plan, but recently I am very busy
to take care of tradings with Kunlun and Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
嗯，我原本想按照自己的计划
给你安排各种任务，
但最近我忙于处理与昆仑和樱花城的贸易事务。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
I found Seyling while I was trading with Amatsu few years ago.
I introduced her brother to the royal family of Prontera, too.
But anyways,
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
几年前我在与樱花城进行贸易时发现了赛琳恩。
我也把她哥哥介绍给了普隆德拉的皇室。
不过话说回来，

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
I want to test you longer, but
I am too busy for that. Also I don't think it is good for you.
Let's finish the test now.
You are qualified enough already.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
我想继续对你进行更长时间的测试，
但我实在太忙了。而且我觉得这样对你也不好。
我们就此结束测试吧。
你已经足够合格了。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
There you go.
I am the last one who tested your qualification.
Now bring all of the stone pieces to Metz.
He will tell you what you need to do next.
scripts.translation:
[贝克兰]
去吧。
我是最后一个测试你资格的人。
现在，把所有石头碎片交给梅茨。
他会告诉你接下来该做什么。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I'm
busy cleaning the manor
right now so I don't have
time to talk. Oh, and would
you please wipe your shoes
on the mat before coming in?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，我现在正忙着打扫宅邸，
没时间聊天。哦，对了，
进来之前请记得在垫子上擦擦鞋。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Leibech...?
I remember that he's
a regular customer who
orders the strangest things.
Last I heard, he was traveling
near Mount Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
莱贝赫...？
我记得他是个常客，
总是订购一些奇怪的东西。
我最后听说他正在雷神之锤山附近旅行。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Ooooh...
What am I going
to do?! Oh-- You
startled me!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢噢噢...
我该怎么办啊？！
噢——你吓我一跳！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh dear...
What can I do
about this...?

[Seylin]
Hello there~
Oh, have you
changed your mind
about helping me?
I'll repay you,
of course.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
你好呀~
噢，你改变主意
愿意帮我了吗？
当然，我会报答你的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Hello there~
So have you decided
yet? If you help me,
I'll be sure to pay
you back somehow.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
你好呀~
那你决定了吗？如果你帮我，
我一定会想办法报答你的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I know that you might
be able to find Vigorgra
in the Alchemist's Guild
in Al de Baran. Aside from
that, I don't know much...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
我知道你可能能在艾尔帕兰的炼金术士公会
找到加油药水。除此之外，
我就不知道了...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, you know where
you can get Vigorgra?
That's great news!
Oh, when you have it,
bring to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，你知道哪里能买到加油药水？
真是个好消息！
噢，等你拿到后，
记得带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Hurray~!
You brought the
Vigorgra! I hope
my brother will
be happy with this!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
万岁~！
你带加油药水来了！
希望我哥哥会喜欢这个！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Would you please
deliver the Vigorgra
and my letter to my brother
Maruin in the Prontera Castle?
And wish him 'Happy Birthday~'
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
请帮我把加油药水和我的信件
送到普隆德拉王宫，
交给我哥哥马鲁因。
并祝他“生日快乐~”

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Thanks so much
for your help again!
I want you to have this
as a token of my gratitude.
You really are a kind person~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
非常感谢你的再次帮助！
我想把这个送给你，
作为我的一点心意。
你真是个善良的人~

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh no~!
Please don't
drag your muddy
feet over the carpet!
Would you please leave?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢不~！
请不要拖着沾满泥巴的脚
踩在地毯上！
请你离开好吗？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Although the master isn't
a messy person, he's pretty
unorganized. I wish he'd make
it easier for me to tell which
papers are documents and 
which ones are trash...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
虽然主人不是个邋遢的人，
但他挺不讲究整理的。我真希望他能
让我更容易分辨哪些是文件，
哪些是废纸...

scripts.text: [Seylin]
scripts.translation: [赛琳恩]

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Yes, that was where
his last order was sent
to. Hm, I wonder. Do you
think he could have been
heading towards the
Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
是的，他最后的订单就是寄往那里的。
嗯，我在想。你觉得他
是不是正前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but
I was just thinking
about something. I hope
I didn't bother you. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，
我刚才只是在想事情。
希望没有打扰到您。^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but
I was just thinking
about something. I hope
I didn't bother you. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，
我刚才只是在想事情。
希望没有打扰到您。^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text: Ignore her.
scripts.translation: 无视她

scripts.text: Excuse me, but Mahatra sent me...
scripts.translation: 打扰了，是玛哈特拉派我来的...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, it's no use
worrying about
something I can do
nothing about. I better
get back to work...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，
担心我也帮不了忙的事
是没用的。我还是
回去工作吧...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Mister Mahatra
sent you to me?
Hm? Does he need
me for anything?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
玛哈特拉先生
派您来的？
嗯？他有什么
需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Actually, he wants me to help you.
scripts.translation: 其实，他想让我来帮您。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, how very kind!
Yes, yes, I could use
some help right now!
You see, it'll be my brother's
birthday, but I'm so busy with
work that I can't see him.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，真是太好了！
是的，是的，我现在
正需要帮忙呢！
您看，我哥哥的生日快到了，
但我工作太忙，
没法去看他。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
The last time I saw him,
he looked so tired and weak
so it's worrying me. Now, I've
heard there's some new medicine
called ^FF0000Vigorgra^000000. I don't know much about it, but it should help him!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
上次见他时，
他看起来又累又虚弱，
这让我很担心。我听说
有一种叫^FF0000加油药水^000000的新药。
我不太了解它，
但它应该对他有帮助！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Do you think you could
find that medicine and
bring it to me? If you don't
want to, I understand. Plus,
I don't know if the master
would approve of this...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
您能帮我
找到那种药，
然后带给我吗？如果您
不愿意，我也理解。而且，
我也不确定主人
会不会同意...

scripts.text: I can't do it.
scripts.translation: 我做不到。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, really?
Alright, I can
understand. I'm
very sorry to bother
you with my problems.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，是吗？
好的，我
理解。很抱歉
用我的麻烦事
打扰您了。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh okay.
Take your time.
If you can help
me, I'd really
appreciate it~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，好的。
您慢慢考虑。
如果您能
帮帮我，
我会非常感激的~

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，太感谢您了！
我记得听说
可以在艾尔帕兰
找到加油药水。
好像是炼金术士公会
里的某个人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，我对这种药
了解不多。
嗯，除了它能让男人
重获青春这一点。
那肯定很好，对吧？
再次感谢您的帮助~

scripts.text:
Hello there~
Oh, have you
changed your mind
about helping me?
I'll repay you,
of course.
scripts.translation:
您好~
噢，您改变主意
愿意帮我了吗？
当然，我会
报答您的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh really?
I'm sorry, I...
I just thought
that maybe...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，是吗？
抱歉，我...
我只是觉得
也许...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，太感谢您了！
我记得听说
可以在艾尔帕兰
找到加油药水。
好像是炼金术士公会
里的某个人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，我对这种药
了解不多。
嗯，除了它能让男人
重获青春这一点。
那肯定很好，对吧？
再次感谢您的帮助~

scripts.text:
Hello there~
So have you decided
yet? If you help me,
I'll be sure to pay
you back somehow.
scripts.translation:
您好~
您决定好了吗？如果您
帮帮我，
我一定会想办法
报答您的。

scripts.text: Um, I'm still thinking.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我还在考虑。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh okay.
But please hurry~
My brother's birthday
is coming up soon!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，好的。
但请快点~
我哥哥的生日
快到了！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢，太感谢您了！
我记得听说
可以在艾尔帕兰
找到加油药水。
好像是炼金术士公会
里的某个人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
抱歉，我对这种药
了解不多。
嗯，除了它能让男人
重获青春这一点。
那肯定很好，对吧？
再次感谢您的帮助~

scripts.text:
I know that you might
be able to find Vigorgra
in the Alchemist's Guild
in Al de Baran. Aside from
that, I don't know much...
scripts.translation:
我知道您可能
能在艾尔帕兰的
炼金术士公会
找到加油药水。
除此之外，我
不太了解...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Once you get it,
would you bring
the Vigorgra to me?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
拿到之后，
能把加油药水
带给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh! Would you please
bring this Vigorgra to my
brother? His name is Maruin
and he's working over at
the Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
噢！能麻烦您
把这瓶加油药水
带给我哥哥吗？
他叫马鲁因，
正在普隆德拉王宫
工作。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Ah, I almost forgot!
I just finished writing
him this letter, so would
you also make sure he gets
this? Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
啊，我差点忘了！
我刚给他写了
这封信，所以
也请确保他
收到好吗？
太感谢您了！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
So how have you been?
Is everything okay with you?
I hope you have a lot of good
experiences in your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳恩]
最近过得怎么样？
一切都还好吗？
希望您在冒险中
能有很多美好的
经历~

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Welcome to
Prontera Castle.
Please be careful
and avoid getting lost.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
欢迎来到
普隆德拉王宫。
请小心，
别迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Welcome to
Prontera Castle.
Please be careful
and avoid getting los--
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
欢迎来到
普隆德拉王宫。
请小心，
别迷--

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh hey, how's
it going? Thanks
again for helping
out my sister, we
really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
嘿，最近
怎么样？再次
感谢帮助
我妹妹，我们
真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
天哪...
我好累~！
简直精疲力竭~
要是能有点
什么提神的东西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
天哪...
我好累~！
简直精疲力竭~
要是能有点
什么提神的东西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
What's that?
You're here for
my sister? Um, did
something happen...?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
那是？
你是来找我
妹妹的？嗯，
发生什么事了...？

scripts.text: Oh no, she sent you a birthday gift.
scripts.translation: 不，她让你送生日礼物。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Birthday...?
What are you sm--
OH. It is my birthday.
Ha! I completely forgot!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
生日...？
你在说什么--
噢。今天是我的生日。
哈！我完全忘了！

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Thanks for coming
all the way out here
to deliver my present!
Wow, I wonder what she
got for me this year?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
谢谢你大老远
跑来送我的礼物！
哇，不知道她
今年给我买了
什么？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Th-this is--!
Oh. Snap. That's right.
She's been worried about
me being tired lately. But
does she even know what
Vigorgra is supposed to...?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
这...这是--！
噢。糟糕，我想起来了。
她最近一直担心
我太累了。但她
知道加油药水
是用来...什么的吗？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Never mind. It's the
thought that counts.
But for the record, it's
not like I need this stuff.
I mean, I have, you know,
a girlfr--you know what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
算了。心意
最重要。
不过说实话，
我并不需要这种东西。
我是说，我有，你知道，
女朋--你知道我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
I'd like to pay you
back, but since I'm
on duty, all I can do
is replenish your health.
I'm not really supposed to,
but no one will say anything.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
我想报答你，
但因为我正在
值班，我只能
恢复你的生命值。
按规定我不该这么做，
但没人会说闲话。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Well, thanks for
the letter and the
male supplement, I guess.
I'll send a message to my
sister. Good luck on your
travels, alright?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
好了，谢谢你的
信和男性补剂。
我会给我妹妹
发消息的。
祝你旅途顺利，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
天哪...
我好累~！
简直精疲力竭~
要是能有点
什么提神的东西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh...
And just between you
and me, that Vigorgra
really came in handy!
That stuff's amazing!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁因]
噢...
还有，就我们
俩之间说，那瓶
加油药水
真的很有用！
那东西太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Most Alchemists seek out the
Stone of Sage, but in my opinion, their goals are too short sighted. There are more important studies
to be conducted in the name of science for the good of mankind...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
大多数炼金术士
都在寻找贤者之石，
但在我看来，他们的
目标太短视了。
为了人类的福祉，
还有更重要的
科学研究
需要开展...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Eh...?
What do you need?
If it's not important,
please leave my
laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯...？
你需要什么？
如果不重要，
请离开我的
实验室！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Hmmm...
So did you
bring everything
you need for the
Vigorgra...?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯...
那么，你
带齐了制作
加油药水
所需的一切
材料吗...？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Vigorgra is
a miracle of
modern science,
but it can do more
harm than good if
you're not careful!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
加油药水
是现代科学的
奇迹，
但如果你不小心的话，
它造成的危害
可能比好处更多！

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什么？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the 
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
到头来，贤者之石
可能只是一个
简单的谣言。
毕竟，成千上万的
炼金术士
都已经
尝试失败了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
我在研究什么？
嗯，我的专长
有点...
不同。如果你非要
知道的话，那是个秘密~
如果哪个男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text: Vigorgra?
scripts.translation: 加油药水？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 哦，对不起。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What?! Who told you
that I could make that?!
Oh, no matter. I suppose
you want me to get some
ready for you. Now tell me...
Why do you want it?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
什么？！谁告诉你的
我能做那个？！
哦，算了。我想
你是想让我
给你准备一些。现在告诉我...
你为什么想要它？

scripts.text: No, I don't want it!
scripts.translation: 不，我不想要！

scripts.text: I need Vigorgra for... a friend.
scripts.translation: 我需要加油药水... 为了一个朋友。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
You immature--!
You come all this
way to bother me?
Don't bring your
shame into my lab!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
你这个不成熟的人--！
你大老远跑来
打扰我？
别把你的
羞耻心
带进我的实验室！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Oh right.
Your friend.
I understand you.
Crystal clear.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
哦，对了。
你的朋友。
我理解你。
一清二楚。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Well, since you know
about my secret research,
I'll do you a favor so long as
you don't tell anyone else!
Of course, I can't just give
you Vigorgra for free...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯，既然你知道
我的秘密研究，
只要你不告诉
其他人，
我就帮你这个忙！
当然，我不能
白白送你
加油药水...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Now, write this
down. These are the
ingredients I need to
make a bottle of Vigorgra.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
现在，把这些
记下来。这些是
制作一瓶
加油药水
所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂胶
30 熊掌
1 西纳雷叶子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Alright.
Now go and
bring all those
items to me. I'll
be seeing you later.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
好了。
现在去
把这些材料
都带给我。我
稍后见。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
There's no need
to apologize. But
I'd appreciate it if
you'd let me work
in peace.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
不用道歉。但
如果你能
让我安静地
工作，
我会很感激的。

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 还没...

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Well, let me
remind you of
what you need to
bring to me in case
you forgot already...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯，让我
提醒你一下
你需要带给我
什么，以防
你已经忘了...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂胶
30 熊掌
1 西纳雷叶子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Take your time...
In the end, you're
the one who's got
the need for it, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
慢慢来...
毕竟，
是你自己
需要它。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Great...!
Now let me check
to see if you have
everything ready...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
太好了...！
现在让我检查一下
你是否
准备好了
所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Hmm, you're still
missing some of the
ingredients. Now, listen
carefully. I need you to get...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯，你还
缺少一些
材料。现在，仔细听。我需要你去弄...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Good work.
Everything's here.
Alright, just this once
I'll make you a bottle
of Vigorgra.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
干得好。
材料都齐了。
好了，就这一次
我会给你做一瓶
加油药水。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂胶
30 熊掌
1 西纳雷叶子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
If you ask me again,
I won't speak to you!
And I'll need to charge
you 10,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
如果你再问一次，
我就不跟你对话了！
而且我还得向你收取
10,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Alright, I'll be
taking my fee from
you now. It's not that
expensive when you
consider Vigorgra's
numerous benefits.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
好的，我现在
要收取你的费用了。
考虑到加油药水
众多的功效，
这并不算贵。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Huh...
It doesn't look like
you have enough zeny
right now. No matter,
I can wait until you
bring it all to me.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯...
看来你现在
Zeny不够。没关系，
我可以等你
把钱都带来。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMelkaba placed
all the ingredients
into a test tube and
began processing it
through some strange
electronic equipment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF梅尔卡巴
将所有材料
放入试管中，
并开始通过某种
奇怪的电子设备
进行处理。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Ah! Success!
A lifetime's supply
of Vigorgra! I know it's
just one bottle, but this
stuff is extremely potent!
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
啊！成功了！
一辈子的加油药水！
我知道只有一瓶，
但这东西
效力极强！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
It failed?!
Of course, the mixture
was too vigorous, even
for the machinery! I'm sorry,
but would you bring the things
we need to make Vigorgra again?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
失败了？！
当然，混合物
太剧烈了，
连机器都承受不住！
抱歉，
你能把制作加油药水
需要的东西再带来吗？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Um, just remember
not to take too much
at one time. Can't have
you getting crazy high
blood pressure~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
嗯，请记住
一次不要喝太多。
可别让你
血压飙升~

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什么？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
到头来，
贤者之石
可能只是个简单的谣言。
毕竟，成千上万的
炼金术士
都已经失败了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
我在研究什么？
嗯，我的专长
有点...
不同。如果你非要
知道的话，那是个秘密~
如果哪个男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什么？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
到头来，
贤者之石
可能只是个简单的谣言。
毕竟，成千上万的
炼金术士
都已经失败了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔卡巴]
我在研究什么？
嗯，我的专长
有点...
不同。如果你非要
知道的话，那是个秘密~
如果哪个男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
The Alcheshs are the
most esteemed family
in all of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
欢迎来到
阿尔切什庄园。
阿尔切什家族是
整个艾尔贝塔
最受尊敬的家族。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Ah yes, the master informed
me that you would be taking
care of an urgent delivery for
him. Please take this to a
man named ^3355FFLeibech^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
啊，是的，主人
告诉我你要为他
处理一个紧急的送货任务。
请把这个交给
一位名叫^3355FF莱贝赫^000000的男子。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
You haven't delivered
the Stone yet? Please take
good care of it since it's very
rare. Don't use it or lose it.
before it's delivered!
Take care, now...
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
你还没把石头送出去？
请妥善保管，因为它非常稀有。
在送达之前
不要使用或丢失它！
请小心...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Ah, you've returned.
And I see you already
delivered the Stone. Great,
well done. Let me send a
message to the master, so
please visit him later.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
啊，你回来了。
看来你已经
把石头送出去了。很好，
干得好。让我给主人
发个消息，
请稍后再去拜访他。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Thank you very
much for the trouble
you've gone through
on our behalf.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
非常感谢你
为我们所付出的
辛劳。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Greetings. Hm?
Did the master ask
you to perform another
task for him already?
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
你好。嗯？
主人已经
让你为他执行
另一个任务了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Although you may only
be doing it for the Sobbing
Starlight, I really appreciate
all your help. Seylin's a very
nice girl and doesn't deserve
to feel down...
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
虽然你可能只是
为了哭泣的星光，
但我真的很感激
你的所有帮助。赛琳恩是个
很好的女孩，
不应该感到沮丧...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Yes.
I heard from Seylin.
I did not know she was worried about her brother.
Ahem ahem...
Thank you for helping her.
I will send a message to my master.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
是的。
我从赛琳恩那里听说了。
我不知道她
在担心她的哥哥。
咳咳...
谢谢你帮助她。
我会给主人发消息。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I'm very disappointed
in you. We put our trust
in you and you really
let us down.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
我对你很失望。
我们信任你，
而你真的
让我们失望了。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I hope the master listens
to me and dresses more like
a man in his position. Even if
he thinks he's just a merchant,
he's the master of this estate!
But please don't tell him that~
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
我希望主人能听我的，
穿得更像个
符合他地位的人。即使
他认为自己只是个商人，
他也是这个庄园的主人！
但请不要告诉他~

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I am Mahatra Mornen,
steward of this family.
Feel free to ask me if
you need anything and
I shall do my best
to assist you.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
我是玛哈特拉·莫恩，
这个家族的管家。
如果你需要任何帮助，
请随时问我，
我会尽力协助你。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
It may be difficult
to find him since he
travels around the world.
Ah yes, I have heard that
he was in some other country...
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
因为他
周游世界，
所以可能很难找到他。
啊，是的，我听说
他在另一个国家...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Now, the item I am
about to give you is
one of a kind. Don't lose
it or you will fall out of favor with the master...
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
接下来我要交给你的物品
是独一无二的。
千万别弄丢了，
否则主人会对你失望的...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMahatra gives you
a unique stone that has
your name attached to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF玛哈特拉给了你
一块刻有你名字的
独特石头。^000000

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: You have another assignment for me.
scripts.translation: 你还有别的任务给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Very well.
Then we shall
converse later~
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
好的。
那我们改天再聊~

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I... I do...?
The master didn't
leave me any instructions.
Hmmm. Oh, I know what you can
do! Why don't you help ^FF0000Seylin^000000? She seems bothered by something...
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
我...我有...？
主人并没有
给我留下任何指示。
嗯...啊，我知道你可以做什么了！
你为什么不帮帮^FF0000赛琳恩^000000呢？她看起来心事重重...

scripts.text:
Mahatra]
If there is anything else, he will let you pass the test.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
玛哈特拉]
如果还有其他问题，他会让你通过测试的。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Well, I suppose
that's the nature
of the testing. They're
designed so that only
the best of the best
can pass them.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈特拉]
嗯，我想
这就是测试的本质吧。
它们的设计初衷
就是只有最优秀的人
才能通过。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
If you have any business
with the master, please
let me know.
scripts.translation:
[胡鲁布]
欢迎来到
阿尔切什庄园。
如果您有要事
需要见主人，
请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
Please leave if
you do not have
any business here.
scripts.translation:
[胡鲁布]
欢迎来到
阿尔切什庄园。
如果您没有要事，
请离开。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
Lately, it seems that
the master is in a good
mood. I believe that we
have you to thank for that.
scripts.translation:
[胡鲁布]
欢迎来到
阿尔切什庄园。
最近，主人似乎
心情不错。我想
这应该归功于你。

scripts.text: I'd like to see Mr. Bakerlan.
scripts.translation: 我想见贝克兰先生。

scripts.text: Have a nice day.
scripts.translation: 祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Ah, you've
come to speak
to the master?
He's not out on
business, so you
can probably see him.
scripts.translation:
[胡鲁布]
啊，你是
来见主人的吗？
他并没有外出
经商，所以
你应该能见到他。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Ah...
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[胡鲁布]
啊...
祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Why...?
How did my
family's wealth
and prestige just
go down the drain?
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
为什么...？
我们家族的财富
和威信
怎么就付诸东流了？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
How did it happen?
How did the Alcheshs
become so rich so quickly?
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
这是怎么发生的？
阿尔切什家族
怎么这么快就
变得如此富有？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
You know, if the Alcheshs
were greedy, they actually
wouldn't be as big as they
are today. They've contributed
to a lot of social causes and
that won them a lot of support.
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
你知道吗，如果阿尔切什家族
贪婪的话，他们实际上
不会像今天这样庞大。
他们为许多社会事业
做出了贡献，
这为他们赢得了很多支持。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Ever since the
Alcheshs came to Alberta,
they quickly took our place
as the biggest business owners
here. It's our biggest shame...
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
自从阿尔切什家族
来到艾尔贝塔以来，
他们很快就取代了我们的位置，
成为了这里最大的商业巨头。
这是我们最大的耻辱...

scripts.text: Alchesh family?
scripts.translation: 阿尔切什家族？

scripts.text: Do you know where Mr. Bakerlan is?
scripts.translation: 你知道贝克兰先生在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
My family, the Tudas,
used to run the biggest
trading company in Alberta.
But when the Alcheshs came
fifty years ago, they started
to outdo us in everything...
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
我的家族，图达斯家族，
曾经是艾尔贝塔最大的贸易公司。
但五十年前阿尔切什家族到来后，
他们在各方面都超越了我们...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
It's like they're financial
geniuses or something!
Under Bakerlan's guidance,
their estate has grown to be
one of the richest in Alberta,
if not all of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
他们简直像是金融天才！
在贝克兰的指导下，
他们的资产增长到成为艾尔贝塔，
甚至整个卢恩·米德加兹最富有的家族之一...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Bakerlan...?
Oh, he's probably
in his ten story money
vault, swimming in his
money by now. You
know rich people.
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
贝克兰...？
哦，他大概现在
正在他那十层楼高的金库里，
泡在钱堆里吧。你知道有钱人都是这样的。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
It-was-a-joke!
You see that big
mansion to the north?
That's the Alchesh Estate.
He should be home now.
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
我开玩笑的！
你看到北边那栋大宅子了吗？
那就是阿尔切什庄园。
他现在应该在家。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
He usually travels
a lot on business,
but if you're lucky you
should be able to catch him.
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
他通常因为生意
经常出差，
但如果你运气好，
应该能碰到他。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Ever since the
Alcheshs came to Alberta,
they quickly took our place
as the biggest business owners
here. It's our biggest shame...
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
自从阿尔切什家族
来到艾尔贝塔以来，
他们很快就取代了我们的位置，
成为了这里最大的商业巨头。
这是我们最大的耻辱...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
I gotta admit...
The whole family
is a bunch of financial
geniuses, alright.
scripts.translation:
[马兴]
我得承认...
他们全家
确实是一群金融天才。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I have a great
interest in collecting
unique and uncommon
goods. You know, things
that most people see just
once in their lifetimes.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我对收集独特
且稀有的物品
很感兴趣。你知道，
那些大多数人
一辈子只能看到一次的东西。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Excuse me...
Are you from the Alchesh
Trading Company? I've been
waiting for my order and they
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
打扰一下...
你是阿尔切什贸易公司的吗？
我一直在等我的订单，他们...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Hm...?
There must be some
mistake. This isn't what
I ordered. Well, I can wait...
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
嗯...？
一定是搞错了。
这不是我订的东西。
好吧，我可以再等等...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Finally, it's here!
Yes, this is what I ordered.
Thanks for the delivery!
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
终于到了！
是的，这就是我订的东西。
谢谢你的配送！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I am interested in collecting uncommon stuffs.
For that, I need to find something that I cannot see around here.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我对收集稀有物品很感兴趣。
为此，我需要找到一些
在这里看不到的东西。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Hey, thanks for
delivering my order
for me. It was a great
addition to my collection!
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
嘿，谢谢你
帮我送来了订单。
它是我收藏中
很棒的新增！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I usually use the
Alchesh Trading Company
to help add to my collection.
Their prices aren't the cheapest, but their service is very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我通常使用
阿尔切什贸易公司
来扩充我的收藏。
他们的价格不是最便宜的，
但服务非常可靠。

scripts.text: No, I'm not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是。

scripts.text: They must be busy.
scripts.translation: 他们一定很忙。

scripts.text: Yes, I have your order.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有你的订单。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, I'm sorry.
My mistake. Well
then, be safe in
your travels.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
哦，对不起。
是我搞错了。
那么，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I suppose you're
right. I mean, Juno
is pretty far from
Alberta. Maybe I'm
just overly excited
about my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我想你说得对。
我是说，朱诺
离艾尔贝塔挺远的。
也许我只是
对我的配送太兴奋了...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Really?!
That's great!
Do you have the
item I ordered?
Where is it?
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
真的吗？！
太好了！
你有我订的物品吗？
它在哪里？

scripts.text: I put it somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我把它放在某个地方了。

scripts.text: Sorry, I lost it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, alright. 
So long as you didn't
lose it, that's fine. I'll wait
here, so would you bring it
to me as soon as you can?
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
哦，好的。
只要没弄丢就没关系。
我会在这里等，
你能尽快把它带给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
What...?
Hey, man.
That's not funny!
You're joking, right?
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
什...？
喂，伙计。
这不好笑！
你在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text: No. I'm not joking.
scripts.translation: 不。我没开玩笑。

scripts.text: Okay, you got me~
scripts.translation: 好吧，你赢了~

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I don't believe it!
I think I'm going to
write a letter to your
boss, Mister Bakerlan.
What do you think 
about that?
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我不信！
我想我会写封信给你的老板，贝克兰先生。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, thank goodness!
I thought you might have
really lost it! Say, would you
bring it to me as soon as
can? I'll wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
哦，谢天谢地！
我还以为你真的弄丢了！
喂，你能尽快把它带给我吗？
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Just come back and
bring me what I actually
ordered, alright? And this
time, don't make any mistakes.
Thanks, I appreciate it~
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
回来时记得带上我真正订的东西，好吗？
这次别再出错了。
谢谢，我很感激~

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Well, here's your
receipt. Please take
this to Mister Bakerlan
so he knows you did
a good job for me.
Thanks again!
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
好了，这是你的收据。
请把它交给贝克兰先生，
让他知道你为我做了一件好事。
再次感谢！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I usually use the
Alchesh Trading Company
to help add to my collection.
Their prices aren't the cheapest, but their service is very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
我通常使用
阿尔切什贸易公司
来扩充我的收藏。
他们的价格不是最便宜的，
但服务非常可靠。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Usually, I am using Alchesh Trading Company for that.
Although the price is little bit higher than I wish,
they are very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
通常，我会使用阿尔切什贸易公司。
虽然价格比我期望的要高一点，
但他们非常可靠。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
It's really tough to
find unique and oddball
items, but I find great pride
in expanding my collection~
scripts.translation:
[莱贝赫]
找到独特且古怪的物品真的很难，
但我以扩展我的收藏而感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hmm...
What should I make for
dinner today? Pickled cabbage?
I learned how to make it a while ago, but I've never gotten the chance to make it yet...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
嗯...
今天晚餐做什么好呢？腌卷心菜？
我很久以前就学会了怎么做，但一直没机会做...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hey, who are you anyhow?
Don't you know it's rude to
enter someone's house without
being invited? Besides, I don't have the time to help strangers while I'm busy making dinner...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
嘿，你是谁？
你不知道未经邀请就进入别人家是不礼貌的吗？
而且，我正忙着做晚饭，没时间理会陌生人...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ho-ho~!
Crisp and delicious pickled
cabbage~ My kid loves this stuff and finished it all by herself the last time I made it.
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
呵呵~！
脆脆的、美味的腌卷心菜~
我的小孩很喜欢这个，上次我做的时候她一个人全吃光了。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ah...
So you've seen my husband.
How is he doing? I worry about
whether or not he's taking care
of himself enough...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
啊...
原来你见过我丈夫。
他过得怎么样？我担心他是否照顾自己...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Thank you so much for bringing
this to me. I'm so happy to hear that he's fine and doing well.
Although he's not here often enough, it's good to know
that he loves his job.
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
非常感谢你把这个带给我。
听到他没事且过得很好，我很高兴。
虽然他不在家的时间不够多，但知道他热爱他的工作，这就很好了。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Liana's daddy needs to come home more often. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Even though he's away for long periods of time, I suppose it's for the best...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
莉安娜的爸爸需要更常回家。^333333*叹气*^000000 虽然他在外时间很长，但我想这样最好...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
So how have you been?
So how have you been?
As usual, Liana misses
her daddy, but I suppose
it can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
你最近怎么样？
你最近怎么样？
一如既往，莉安娜想念她的爸爸，但我想没办法...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Try to cherish your
family, especially through the
hard times. Even when you're angry with them, try to be more understanding. I know it's hard...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
试着珍惜你的家人，尤其是在困难时期。
即使你对他们生气，也要试着多理解。我知道这很难...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait!
I'm here to see...

[Brenda Howard]
Huh?
What are you
talking about?
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
嗯？
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hmm...
I wonder
how my pickled
cabbage will turn out?
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
嗯...
不知道我腌的白菜会做成什么样呢？

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ah... I see.
You're looking for my husband.
My husband, my daughter and
I just moved to Geffen from
Prontera a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
啊...我明白了。
你在找我丈夫。
我丈夫、女儿和我
不久前刚从普隆德拉
搬到了吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
We moved to Geffen for the sake of my husband's business. Apparently, this town is closest to something he really seems to need. Whatever it is, it must be really important to his smithing work.
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
我们搬到吉芬是为了我丈夫的事业。听说这个城镇离他非常需要的某种东西最近。无论那是什么，对他的铁匠工作一定非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Oh, and if you're going to look
for my husband, please talk to my daughter before you go. I think she has something that she wants to give to her father...
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
哦，如果你要去找我丈夫，
请先和我女儿谈谈再走。
我想她有些话
想对父亲说...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Oh, I can't help but worry!
Thank you for letting me know
how he's doing. Still, he should
be doing a better job of keeping
in touch with us. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
哎呀，真让人担心！
谢谢你告诉我他的近况。
不过，他应该更勤快地
和我们联系才对。^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Even so, I should start letting
him know that I want him to spend
a little more time at home. Oh, and why don't you talk to Liana? She's been waiting to tell you something.
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
即便如此，我也该让他知道，
我希望他多花点时间在家。
哦，还有，你去和莉安娜谈谈吧？
她一直在等你，有话想对你说。

scripts.text:
I may be no expert, but I'm
certain that my husband is
the best blacksmith in the world! Did you know Hollgrehenn and Aragham used to be his apprentices? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation: 我虽然不是行家，但我确信我丈夫是世界上最棒的铁匠！你知道吗？霍尔格雷恩和阿拉甘以前都是他的学徒呢。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've made more available inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Liana]
*Pout*
When's my daddy
coming home?!
I... I miss him so much~
*Cries*
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
*撅嘴*
爸爸什么时候回家呀？！
我...我好想他~
*哭泣*

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Oh, my mom said she's gonna cook me something good today.
I wonder what she's gonna make?
I hope it's pickled cabbage again!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
哦，妈妈说今天要给我做好吃的。
不知道她会做什么呢？
希望又是腌白菜！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Everyone says that daddy is the best blacksmith in the whole world! But now he lets his apprentices do
the work so he can go around the world to find a rare ore~ Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
大家都说爸爸是全世界最棒的铁匠！但现在他让学徒们干活，自己跑去世界各地寻找稀有矿石~ 是不是很厉害？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
My dad never broke anything
his customers gave him. And my uncle Hollgrehenn and Aragham wouldn't let anything like that
happen, would they?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
爸爸从来没有弄坏过顾客给他的东西。而且叔叔霍尔格雷恩和阿拉甘也不会让这种事发生的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Would you please bring my letter over to my dad? Heh heh, he'll be
so happy to hear from me!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
请帮我把这封信带给爸爸好吗？嘿嘿，他收到我的信一定会很开心的！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Yay~!
Thank you for bringing my letter to my dad. Here, here!
You have to share my treasure with me, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
耶~！
谢谢你帮我把信带给爸爸。给你，给你！
你要和我分享我的宝藏哦，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
I never saw my dad fail to upgrade a weapon or armor. Mmm? But maybe if he had something really really old and rare and special...
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
我从来没见爸爸升级武器或防具失败过。嗯？不过，如果是一件非常非常古老、稀有又特别的...

scripts.text: What are you drawing by the way?
scripts.translation: 你在画什么呀？

scripts.text: Apprentices?
scripts.translation: 学徒？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Oh, this?
It's a letter for my daddy.
Mom said that some {0} is gonna try to find my dad, so I'm making this so {1}he can take it him~
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
哦，这个？
这是给爸爸的信。
妈妈说有个{0}会去找爸爸，所以我写了这封信，让{1}他带过去~

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Yeah, Uncle Hollegrehenn and Aragham come to visit sometimes and we all play. But, it's more fun to see my dad, even though he's not back yet. ^333333*Pout*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
是的，叔叔霍尔格雷恩和阿拉甘有时会来拜访，我们一起玩。但是，还是见到爸爸更有趣，虽然他还没回来。^333333*撅嘴*^000000

scripts.text: Don't you miss your dad?
scripts.translation: 你想爸爸了吗？

scripts.text: He also misses you a lot.
scripts.translation: 爸爸也很想你。

scripts.text:
[Liana]
I miss him sooo much!
^333333*Cries*^000000 But Mom always
says that he's too busy.
^333333*Pouts*^000000

[Liana]
I hope so...
But I hate it when
he doesn't have enough
time to come home and
see me. Sooooooooo~
I wrote this letter!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
希望如此...
但是我不喜欢他没时间回家看我。所以...我写了这封信！

scripts.text: I'll bring this to him.
scripts.translation: 我会把它带给他的。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Liana~
This nice {0} is going to look for your dad. Why don't you ask {1} to take your letter to him for you?
scripts.translation:
[布伦达·霍华德]
莉安娜~
这位善良的{0}要去寻找你的爸爸。为什么不请{1}帮你把信带给他呢？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
You are...?
Really, really?
H-hooray!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
你是...？
真的吗，真的吗？
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Okay then, don't
forget to give this to
my dad, okay? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
那么，别忘了把这个交给爸爸，好吗？拉钩？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Mmmm...
But I don't know you!
Mom says I should never
ask for anything from strangers.
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
嗯...
但是我不认识你！
妈妈说，我不应该向陌生人索要任何东西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Just as I suspected...
I didn't bring enough of them.
Hmm, this is serious. What
am I going to do about this?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
果然如我所料...
我带的材料不够。
嗯，这很严重。我该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I hope you understand that
this forge isn't really open to the public. I'm doing some intensive training,so I'd appreciate it if you would just leave now.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
希望你能理解，这个铁匠铺并不对外开放。我正在接受高强度训练，所以请你们现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
It's been a long
time since I've seen
my family. I really should let them know how I'm doing sooner or later. Hmmm....
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^333333*叹气*^000000
我已经很久没见家人了。我迟早应该告诉他们我的近况。嗯....

scripts.text:
[Engel]
As I've told you before, I'm more likely to succeed in my work if I'm able to use a higher quality anvil. Let's me see what you've brought...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
正如我之前所说，如果我能使用更高质量的铁砧，我的成功率会更高。让我看看你带来了什么...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Are you back already?
Sorry, but I haven't quite finished yet. I won't be done for a while, so why don't you deliver that letter to my family?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
你这么快就回来了？
抱歉，我还没完成。我还需要一段时间，所以你能帮我把那封信带给我的家人吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Are you back already?
While you were gone, I managed to restore this Sobbing Starlight. Why don't you go ahead and take a look?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
你这么快就回来了？
趁你不在的时候，我修复了这块星泪石。你要不要先看看？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
You've returned?
Well, I don't know how to put this, but once you hear it, don't take it the wrong way...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
你回来了？
嗯，我不知道该怎么说，但听到后请不要误会...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh good, you're back.
I've got some bad news,
so please don't overreact~
Um, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
太好了，你回来了。
我有个坏消息，所以请不要反应过度~
嗯，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Didn't I tell you to bring me a Golden Anvil or an Emperium Anvil? Anything less isn't good enough to do any restoration work on this Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
我不是让你带黄金铁砧或华丽金属铁砧来吗？比这更差的铁砧，不足以对这块星泪石进行修复工作。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Good, good.
I see that you've brought a Golden Anvil. Now I can get started right away! Still, I'm a little about those monsters showing up again, so would you keep a lookout?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
很好，很好。
看来你带了黄金铁砧。我现在可以马上开始了！不过，我还是有点担心那些魔物再次出现，所以你能帮我警戒一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Excellent! You've brought an Emperium Anvil! Now, keep a lookout for monsters while I repair these ore fragments. We can't have those beasts ruin my work again, right? Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
太棒了！你带了华丽金属铁砧！现在，请帮我警戒魔物，我要修复这些矿石碎片。我们不能让那些野兽再次毁了我的工作，对吧？谢谢你。

scripts.text: [Engel]
scripts.translation: [恩格尔]

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哦，你还没准备好所有东西吗？慢慢来，只要没忘记需要带什么就行。你记得吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
还是没准备好吗？没关系，慢慢来。只要没忘记所有需要的东西就好。毕竟，你身上带着这么重要的矿石，怎么可能忘记呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
How have you been doing lately? Feel free to ask me if you ever think that you need my expertise, alright?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
最近过得怎么样？如果你觉得需要我的专业知识，随时可以来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
How have you been
doing lately? You seem
quite well. So is there anything
I can help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
最近过得怎么样？看起来气色不错。那么，今天有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
It's so...
Beautiful! I don't know
if I'll ever see anything
like this again in my life...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
真是...太美了！我不知道这辈子还能不能再看到这样的东西...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I haven't completed it yet, but please understand that I've got to be really careful when working with something so valuable. But don't worry, its inner power will be revealed when I'm finished.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
我还没修好，但请理解，处理这么珍贵的东西我必须非常小心。不过别担心，等我修好后，它内在的力量就会显现出来。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Sometimes, you can only
improve yourself by training in solitude. But don't ever forget about the ones who really care about you. It's those people who make everything worth it.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
有时候，你只能通过在孤独中修炼来提升自己。但永远不要忘记那些真正关心你的人。正是这些人让一切变得值得。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh great! I see that you're
carrying some Iron Ores with you. Would you be so kind as to lend me 1 Iron Ore? Please, I beg of you...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
太好了！我看你身上带着一些铁矿石。能借我一块铁矿石吗？拜托了，求你了...

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Thank you so much!
If it weren't for your help,
I'd be in big trouble. I really appreciate you stepping in and volunteering your materials like this.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
非常感谢！如果没有你的帮助，我就大难临头了。真的很感激你主动伸出援手，愿意提供材料。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I suppose I understand.
