However, you're lucky that I don't kick you out of my forge right here and right now~
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
我想我理解你的意思。
不过，你运气真好，我现在没把你赶出我的锻造炉~

scripts.text:
[Engel]
...?
Were you looking for me?
I'm sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. Please don't disturb me while I try to get my work done.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
...？
你在找我吗？
抱歉，我现在很忙。请别打扰我，让我专心工作。

scripts.text: I need your help.
scripts.translation: 我需要你的帮助。

scripts.text: Here is a letter for you.
scripts.translation: 这是给你的信。

scripts.text: I am leaving, leaving.
scripts.translation: 我要走了，再见。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Well, I'd like to help you,
but now isn't a good for me.
plenty of other good smiths out there who can help you with the work that you want done. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
嗯，我想帮你，但现在不是好时机。
外面有很多优秀的铁匠可以帮你完成你想做的活计。再见。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, are you serious?
Let me read it first.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哦，你是认真的吗？
让我先读一下。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Yes, yes.
...Hahaha!
It's so good to hear from
my darling daughter.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
是的，是的。
...哈哈！
收到我亲爱的女儿的信真好。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Thanks, I really appreciate that you've delivered this letter for me. Now, is there anything you'd like to ask of me? If it's not a big favor, I can probably help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
谢谢，真的很感激你帮我送这封信。那么，你有什么想让我帮忙的吗？如果不是太大的忙，我大概能帮上忙。

scripts.text: Please look at this.
scripts.translation: 请看看这个。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh?
Isn't this...?
I see, I see!
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哦？
这不是……？
原来如此，原来如此！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Long ago, my old master told me that there are these strange ores that have fallen from the sky. The most beautiful and mysterious is the one shines just like a star.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
很久以前，我的师父曾告诉我，有一种从天空坠落的奇异矿石。其中最美丽、最神秘的，是那种像星星一样闪耀的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Most people may know it as Sobbing Starlight, but my master used to call it God's Tear Drop.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
大多数人可能知道它叫星泪石，但我的师父以前叫它“神之泪滴”。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
However, this ore has been shattered into pieces. Judging from the smoothness of the edges, its inner power must have caused it to break apart. So you want me to put this back together, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
然而，这块矿石已经碎裂成了碎片。从边缘的光滑程度来看，一定是其内部的力量导致它破裂的。所以，你是想让我把它重新拼合起来，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This will be a good challenge
for me! However, I'll need some
special tools and materials to repair this kind of ore. Now, I want you to bring me the following things...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
这对我来说是个不错的挑战！不过，修复这种矿石需要一些特殊的工具和材料。现在，我想请你帮我收集以下物品……

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
Now keep in mind that ordinary anvils won't be good enough for
this kind of work.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^FF00005 携带用熔矿炉^000000、
^FF00002 神之金属锤子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品质的铁砧^000000。
请记住，普通的铁砧不足以胜任这项工作。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Now, an Emperium Anvil would be ideal for this job. I used to have one, but a while back I ended up giving it to someone. Anyway, I'll wait here for you while you gather everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
对于这项工作，华丽金属铁砧是最理想的。我以前有一个，但不久前把它送给了别人。总之，我会在这里等你，你去收集所需的一切吧。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Right. Let me guide you to a shortcut to the exit of these mines, just in case you don't know your way out of here. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
对了。让我指引你一条通往矿洞出口的捷径，以防你不知道怎么出去。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Alright, then.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
那么，就这样吧。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
...?
Do you have any business
me? I'm sorry, but right
now I'm very busy. Please leave
me alone to my research.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
……？
你有事找我吗？抱歉，我现在很忙。请让我专心研究。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
A...
Regular Anvil?
Alright, I guess I'll try it.
But I can't guarantee success.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
啊……
普通铁砧？
好吧，我想试试看。
但我不能保证成功。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Ah...
An Oridecon Avil.
This isn't too bad,
but there's a good risk
that this might not work.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
啊……
神之金属铁砧。
这还不错，
但很有可能无法成功。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Ah...
A Golden Anvil.
This just might be able to do the job. This might take a while, so I have something to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
啊……
黄金铁砧。
这个也许能胜任这项工作。这需要一些时间，所以我有一件事想拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh wow, an Emperium Anvil!
And this looks like one I might have actually made. Great, I should be able to do this so long as I don't make any critical mistakes~
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哇，华丽金属铁砧！
而且这看起来像是我亲手制作的。太好了，只要我不犯重大错误，应该就能修好~

scripts.text: [Engel]
scripts.translation: [恩格尔]

scripts.text:
[Engel]
While I'm working on this, would you deliver a letter to my family for me? I'm sorry, but please consider that I'm waiving the fee for restoring this Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
在我工作的时候，你能帮我给家人送一封信吗？抱歉，请把这视为我免除修复这块星泪石的费用。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Well then...
I wish you safety
in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
那么……
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哦，你还没准备好所有东西吗？慢慢来，只要没忘记需要带什么就行。你记得吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^FF00005 携带用熔矿炉^000000、
^FF00002 神之金属锤子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品质的铁砧^000000。
这些就够了！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
请记住，如果我拥有更高质量的铁砧，修复星泪石的成功率会更高。否则……

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
还是没准备好吗？没关系，慢慢来。只要没忘记所有需要的东西就好。毕竟，你身上带着这么重要的矿石，怎么可能忘记呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This was one of the most difficult jobs I've ever done. But look! It was beautiful when broken in fragments but now it's absolutely dazzling! This was really worth my effort.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
这是我做过的最难的工作之一。但看！它破碎时很美，但现在绝对光彩夺目！这真的值得我付出努力。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
In any case, I worked really hard to do a good job on this, so I hope you treasure this Sobbling Starlight, young adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
总之，我努力做好了这项工作，所以我希望你能珍惜这块星泪石，年轻的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^333333*Ahem*^000000
Just as I've warned you, this attempt to restore the Sobbling Starlight failed because the anvil you gave me wasn't up to the job. I'm sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^333333*咳*^000000
正如我之前警告过你的，这次修复星泪石失败了，因为你给我的铁砧质量不够。对此我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
However, I only
broke all of the tools
and the ore pieces are still intact. Now, if you bring me the tools one more time, I can try this again.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
不过，我只是弄坏了所有的工具，矿石碎片依然完好无损。现在，如果你再给我带一次工具，我可以再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Since I'm a bit more familiar with this material, I won't take so much time. Once again, let me tell you which things you need to bring...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
既然我对这种材料更熟悉了，这次不会花太多时间。让我再告诉你一次你需要带什么...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
And this time, bring
me a better anvil, huh?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^FF00005 携带用熔矿炉^000000、
^FF00002 神之金属锤子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品质的铁砧^000000。
这次，给我带个更好的铁砧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Although it'd be perfect if I had an Emperium Anvil, I'm pretty sure it'll be alright if we used a Golden Anvil.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
虽然如果有华丽金属铁砧就完美了，但我相信用黄金铁砧也没问题。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
While I was trying to restore the 
Sobbling Starlight, I was attacked 
by monsters all of a sudden. If only
I paid more attention to my
surroundings...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
在我试图修复星泪石的时候，突然被魔物袭击了。要是我当时多注意一下周围的情况就好了...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Please understand that I get very deeply engrossed in my smithing work. If you don't mind, I'll try this again you'll bring all the tools just like the last time.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
请理解，我在打铁时非常投入。如果你不介意的话，只要你像上次一样把所有工具都带过来，我就再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000 and
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000.
Don't forget the ^FF0000Golden Anvil^000000! But if you can get your hands on one, an ^FF0000Emperium Anvil^000000 would be better.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^FF00005 携带用熔矿炉^000000 和
^FF00002 神之金属锤子^000000。
别忘了 ^FF0000黄金铁砧^000000！但如果你能弄到 ^FF0000华丽金属铁砧^000000 就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Next time you come
here, bring a Golden or Emperium Anvil and make sure to leave all of your other anvils in Kafra Storage or something, okay?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
下次你来的时候，带上黄金铁砧或华丽金属铁砧，并确保把你其他的铁砧都放在卡普拉仓库里，好吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Cliiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000

^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink-Clink*
*Clink-Clink-Clink*
*Claaaaaaaaaaack*^000000

[Engel]
It's almost done.
Just be a bit more patient...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
快完成了。
请再耐心等一下...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Finally... Completed.
^333333*Phew!*^000000 That was one of the toughest jobs I've ever done, but this was well worth all of our efforts. Just look at the dazzling beauty of this Sobbing Starlight!
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
终于...完成了。
^333333*呼！*^000000 这是我做过的最难的工作之一，但这值得我们要付出的所有努力。看看这块星泪石那耀眼的美丽吧！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
We've both gone through a lot of trouble to make this, so I hope you treasure your Sobbing Starlight. Good luck on your adventures...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
我们都经历了很多麻烦才做成这个，所以我希望你能珍惜你的星泪石。祝你在冒险中好运...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
^FF00005 携带用熔矿炉^000000、
^FF00002 神之金属锤子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品质的铁砧^000000。
这些就够了！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
请记住，如果我拥有更高质量的铁砧，修复星泪石的成功率会更高。否则……

scripts.text: I need your help again.
scripts.translation: 我需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Haha, so what have
you brought me this time?
It must be fairly important if you've brought it all the way
down here.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哈哈，这次你带给我什么了？
既然你大老远带到这里，一定挺重要的吧。

scripts.text: Please look at this.
scripts.translation: 请看看这个。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Isn't this...?!
Amazing, just by looking at it,
I can feel its power! You really
are something! How do you come across all of this amazing stuff?
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
这不是...？！
太棒了，光是看着它，
我就能感受到它的力量！你真是个了不起的人！你是怎么找到这些神奇的东西的？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
You know, I consider myself
lucky to even see this kind of stuff. Most smiths might be able to see this kind of thing only once in their entire lives. And to be able to work on it...
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
你知道吗，我觉得自己很幸运能看到这种东西。大多数铁匠可能一辈子只能看到一次。而能亲手打造它...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Hmmm...
It's going to take quite
a while to work on this. Unfortunately, I can't even
give you a time estimate...
But I'll do my best for you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
嗯...
打造这个需要相当长的时间。不幸的是，我甚至无法给你一个时间估计...
但我会尽我所能为你做的。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you're back just in time.
Although it was one of my most difficult jobs, I believe you'll be pleased with my work. Only a few smiths are privileged enough to work with this, even just once.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
哦，你来得正是时候。
虽然这是我做过最困难的工作之一，但我相信你会对我的作品感到满意。只有少数铁匠才有幸能打造这种材料，哪怕只有一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This is now yours to keep.
Thank you for giving me the
honor of working on a worthy
smithing challenge.
scripts.translation:
[恩格尔]
现在它归你了。
谢谢你给我这个机会，让我能参与这项配得上铁匠的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Hmmm...
That can't be right...
What could possibly be
the answer I'm looking
for? ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
嗯...
这不对劲...
我到底在找什么答案呢？^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Wah~
Why the hell did he even go there...!
What are you doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
哇~
他到底为什么要去那里...！
你在这里干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
You're not even a Mage,
much less a Wizard, Sage, Warlock or a Sorcerer.
Why bother climbing this tower?
What are you doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
你甚至不是个魔法师，
更别提巫师、贤者、大魔导士或妖术师了。
为什么要爬这座塔？
你在这里干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
你刚才说你是来找梅茨·布莱德的？
是为了那个星泪石，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
是为了那个星泪石，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
你刚才说你是来找梅茨·布莱德的？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
...

[Dhota]
...
......
BWAAAAH~!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
...
......
BWAAAAH~!

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Right, he wants that guy
who's good at working with
gems and stuff. Eh, he's not
here right now. Went somewhere
near Comodo to investigate some
tribal people or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
对了，他想要那个擅长处理宝石之类东西的家伙。呃，他现在不在这里。去克魔岛附近调查什么部落的人了，之类的。

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Say what...?
I have no idea what
you're talking about!
If you've got nothing
to say, then leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
你说什么...？
我完全不知道你在说什么！
如果你没什么事，就让我一个人待着！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh, I wish I had
a Mr. Smile mask!
But where can I get
one of those? Well, I'd
be happy if I had some
Meat to eat, I guess!
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
哦，我希望我有一张笑脸面具！
但我在哪里能买到呢？嗯，如果我能吃点肉就好了，我想！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Mmm...?
A new guy in our village?
I think I know him! Yea, I do!
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
嗯...？
我们村来了个新面孔？
我想我认识他！是的，我认识！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
I love my Mr. Smile mask
soooo much! I'm gonna show
it to all my friends! Thank you
so much again! You're really
really nice, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
我太喜欢我的笑脸面具了！我要给所有朋友看看！再次非常感谢！你真的很好，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh my gosh!
You've got a Mr. Smile mask!
Would you give that to me?
Pretty please...?
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
天哪！
你有一张笑脸面具！
你能把它给我吗？
拜托了...？

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Waaaait.
I knooow~!
I know if you get
me a Mr. Smile, okay?
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
等等。
我知道~！
如果你给我一张笑脸面具，好吗？

scripts.text: Sure~
scripts.translation: 当然~

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Hooooray!
Thank you thank you
thank you thank you
soooooooooo much!
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
耶——！
谢谢谢谢
谢谢谢谢
太谢谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh right~!
The weird man in the funny clothes was in our village for a while, but ever since he went into that big tree, nobody's seen him!
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
对了~！
那个穿着奇怪衣服的怪人，之前在我们村子里待了一会儿，但自从他走进那棵大树后，就再也没人见过他了！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
I...
I was...
I just...
Waaaaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[老谭]
我...
我...
我只是...
哇啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Chuuuba?
Chu-chu-chu-chu-chaba?
Oom oom oom daba. Blip blip?
Sabaloo koombah Solo. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[??????]
楚巴？
楚-楚-楚-楚-巴？
噢姆 噢姆 噢姆 达巴。哔哔？
萨巴鲁 库姆巴 索罗。呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333*Giggle*^000000
So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!
scripts.translation:
^333333*轻笑*^000000
如果这样，然后那样，再然后...
噢，这些计算
简直完美无缺！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
什-什么？！
你是谁？
你-你怎么
进来的？我命令
你立刻离开，马上！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
^333333*Giggle*^000000
So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
^333333*轻笑*^000000
如果这样，然后那样，再然后...
噢，这些计算
简直完美无缺！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
什-什么？！
你是谁？
你-你怎么
进来的？我命令
你立刻离开，马上！

scripts.text: I'm here for Metz Brayde.
scripts.translation: 我是来找梅茨·布雷德的。

scripts.text: My apologies.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text: Would you look at this?
scripts.translation: 你看看这个？

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Huh? Brayde?
Do you expect me
to just trust you without
a single shred of proof that
he sent you? Get out now!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
嗯？布雷德？
你指望我
在没有丝毫证据证明
是他派你来的情况下
就相信你的话？
现在立刻滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
If you're so sorry,
then hurry up and get
out of here! Not just anyone
is allowed here! Leave!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
如果你这么抱歉，
那就赶紧滚出去！
不是谁都能进来的！
离开！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
What could be so
special about what
you've brought here?!
Fine, you've piqued my
scientific curiosity...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你带来的东西
有什么特别之处？！
好吧，你引起了我的
科学好奇心...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Sweet lord...
This is 'God's Tear Drop!'
The Sobbling Starlight!
He finally made it....
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
天哪...
这是“神之泪滴”！
星泪石！
他终于做到了....

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
^333333*Giggle*^000000
Well, since he's kept his promise, I suppose that I should keep mine
as well. Now, within this Sobbing Starlight are these tiny letters... ^FFFFFFcobo^000000
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
^333333*轻笑*^000000
既然他信守了承诺，我想我也应该信守我的承诺。现在，在这块星泪石里有一些微小的文字... ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
The text is so small that even Hunters skilled in Vulture's Eye are unable to read them. However, I've read that this Sobbing
Starlight will respond
to really old papers...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
文字太小了，即使是擅长苍鹰之眼的猎人也无法阅读。不过，我读到过这块星泪石会对非常古老的纸张产生反应...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Now, if we want to figure out
what's written in the Sobbing
Starlight, we'd need at least
10 ancient pieces of paper...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
现在，如果我们想弄清楚
星泪石里写了什么，
我们至少需要
10张古老的纸张...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Not listening, eh?
Fine, if you don't
understand words, then
I'll have to use force!
Get out here right now!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
不听吗？
好吧，如果你听不懂
人话，那我就只能用
武力了！
现在立刻给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
You've come back.
I hope you were able
to find some ancient
or really aged paper...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你回来了。
我希望你能找到
一些古老的
或者非常陈旧的纸张...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How did you find these
Worn Out Pages? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你是怎么找到这些
废弃杂志的？太好了，
我相信星泪石
会对这些产生反应！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Yes. Yes...
This should be enough.
Now give them to me
and wait here while
I try a few things...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
是的。是的...
这些应该足够了。
现在把它们给我，
然后在这里等着，
我要尝试一些事情...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Just as I thought!
The Sobbing Starlight is responding to these Worn Out Pages! Excellent! I've finally fulfilled my promise to Metz! Now he can leave
me alone!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
果然如此！
星泪石对这些破旧纸张有反应！太好了！我终于兑现了对梅茨的承诺！现在他可以别来烦我了！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How did you find these
^FF0000Worn Out Pages^000000? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你是怎么找到这些
^FF0000破旧纸张^000000的？太好了，
我相信星泪石
会对这些产生反应！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wait, we don't have enough
of them to make the Sobbing
Starlight respond. Find more
of these papers and bring
them all to me!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
等等，我们还没有足够的
纸张让星泪石产生反应。
去找更多这样的纸张，
然后全部带给我！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
You haven't found anything?
What kind of scientist are you?
Now go out and find some old and ancient papers so that we can learn what's written in the Sobbing Starlight! Go!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你什么都没找到？
你是什么科学家？
现在出去找一些古老陈旧的纸张，
这样我们才能知道星泪石上写了什么！快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
...?
Why are you still here?
Leave and do what I told
you to do, alright?! Don't
make me get violent...
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
...？
你为什么还在这里？
离开，去做我让你做的事，好吗？！
别逼我动手...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
My business with you is finished, so you go along on your way now. And tell Metz not to bother me anymore! I'm done doing favors!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
我和你的事结束了，所以你现在可以走了。告诉梅茨别再烦我了！我不想再帮这种忙了！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How dare you intrude
on my property?! Now,
get out now before I get
violent! Didn't you hear me?
GET OUT OF HERE!
scripts.translation:
[赛昂]
你竟敢闯入我的地盘？！
现在，在我动手之前
赶紧滚出去！你没听到吗？
给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在的物品栏太满了。
请腾出一些空间后再来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Frank]
My back~
It's so sore!
And my eyes are
hurting worse and worse.
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I'm getting old...
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
我的背...
好酸！
而且我的眼睛
越来越疼了。
^333333*叹气*^000000 我老了...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
My vision's getting
blurrier and I get headaches
when I read. I guess this old
man's got no choice but to get
some sort of seeing aid...
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
我的视力越来越模糊，
看书时还会头痛。我想这个老头
不得不找点助视工具了...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I've finally completed the translation. It was a challenge deciphering the meaning of some
of these words. Even translated in our own language, this contents of this text are fairly ambiguous.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
我终于完成了翻译。解读其中一些词的含义是个挑战。即使翻译成我们的语言，这段文字的内容也相当晦涩难懂。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I'm sorry, but I haven't finished translating this text. It's taking quite a long time since I don't have any reference material for this particular language. Why
don't you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
抱歉，我还没翻译完这段文字。由于我没有这种特定语言的参考资料，所以花了不少时间。
你稍后再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Frank]
There are many things out
there that defy our understanding of the world and are beyond our imagination. Many fear the unknown, but the truly brave will always seek out the truth.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
世界上有很多事物超出了我们的理解，甚至超出了我们的想象。许多人害怕未知，但真正的勇者总会去探寻真相。

scripts.text: Wait, I've got a pair of glasses...
scripts.translation: 等等，我有一副眼镜...

scripts.text: Pass on by.
scripts.translation: 路过而已

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Oh, you've brought me
these Glasses? Thanks
so much, youngster. Now that
I can see better, what can
I do for you in return?
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
哦，你带给我
这副眼镜？太感谢了，年轻人。现在我看清楚了，
我能为你做些什么作为回报呢？

scripts.text: About Geffen's Hidden Power
scripts.translation: 关于吉芬的隐藏力量

scripts.text: About Sobbing Starlight
scripts.translation: 关于星泪石

scripts.text: Interpret Ancient Document
scripts.translation: 解读古代文献

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Geffen's hidden power?
I don't know much about it, but I'm sure that Geffen Tower is more than just a simple building. I'm sure it was created to restrain or contain some powerful force.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
吉芬的隐藏力量？
我不太了解，但我确信吉芬中央塔不仅仅是一座普通的建筑。我相信它是为了束缚或容纳某种强大的力量而建造的。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
It's even possible that the fountain in front of Geffen Tower also plays the same role, but I've got no hard evidence. Since I'm not too interested in Geffen, I haven't really investigated...
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
吉芬中央塔前的喷泉也可能扮演着同样的角色，但我没有确凿的证据。因为我对吉芬不太感兴趣，所以并没有深入调查...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Still...
There's a strong possibility that some enormous power is being sealed beneath the Geffen Tower.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
不过...
吉芬中央塔下极有可能封印着某种巨大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
The Sobbing Starlight?
To the experts, it's known as God's Tear Drop. Now, some believe it was created from the voice of God.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
星泪石？
在行家眼中，它被称为“神之泪”。据说，它是用神的声音凝结而成的。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Of course, it probably isn't made from God's voice or tear drops, but who knows? In any case, it's said that something's written in the Sobbing Starlight. What ever it is, it must be something important...
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
当然，它可能并非由神的声音或泪水制成，但谁知道呢？总之，据说星泪石上记载着某些内容。无论那是什么，一定非常重要...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I don't believe it!
This is... I see. You want me to translate this ancient language. Ah, you're rather fortunate. I'm probably the only person in the world who can translate this.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
我不信！
这是...我明白了。你想让我解读这种古代语言。啊，你运气真好。我大概是世上唯一能解读这种语言的人了。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Hmm, as far as I can tell, this is a sophisticated language spoken by the ancient gods. It's complex and confusing, but I'll do my best for you. Come back to me later, and I'll what I've learned.
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
嗯，据我观察，这是古代神祇使用的一种复杂语言。虽然晦涩难懂，但我会尽力为你解读。稍后回来找我，我会告诉你我的发现。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Oooh~
How will I ever
be able to continue
my life's work? I'm
helpless if I can't read...
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
噢~
如果读不了书，
我该如何继续
我的毕生事业？
我简直无能为力...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Well, I've written down the best translation that I could for you. It's been a long time since I've had this kind of challenge. Thanks, youngster.
Ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[弗兰克]
好了，我为你写下了我能做到的最佳译文。很久没有遇到这么有挑战性的任务了。谢谢你，年轻人。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
^6B8E23It seems that
something in the
vicinity is reacting
with the Sobbing Starlight
in your possession. Perhaps
you can find it nearby...^000000
scripts.translation:
^6B8E23似乎附近有什么东西
正在与你持有的星泪石
产生反应。
也许你可以在附近找到它...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
What's happening?!

^3355FFFor some reason, in
this particular spot, the
Sobbing Starlight is reacting
with the Resin, Stone Hearts
and Coral Reefs that you're
holding. All the objects are
violently resonating...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不知为何，
在这个特定的地点，
星泪石正在与你持有的
树脂、石心和珊瑚
产生反应。所有物品
都在剧烈共鸣...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAll of a sudden these
objects emit a bright flash
of light that envelops your
entire body, then you gently
fall into unconsciousness...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF突然，
这些物品发出耀眼的强光，
笼罩了你的全身，
随后你缓缓陷入了昏迷...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing seems to
happen when you
approach this area now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF现在，
当你接近这个区域时，
似乎什么也没有发生。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Only the chosen
can enter this place.
I will not ask how you've
gained entrance, but I will
require you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
只有被选中的人
才能进入此地。
我不会询问你是如何获得进入资格的，
但我要求你离开。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Welcome, {0},
to this realm of holiness.
You have endured great difficulty and tested your courage to obtain the Sobbing Starlight, which will be the certificate for your test.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
欢迎，{0}，
来到这片神圣之地。
你历经重重艰难，考验了你的勇气，
获得了星泪石，
它将作为你通过考验的证明。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
I commend your ability
to survive in the realm
of the dead. I imagine it
must be very difficult for
a mortal to endure its cruelty.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
我赞赏你在亡者之域
生存下来的能力。
我想，对于凡人来说，
忍受那里的残酷一定非常困难。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Regrettably, I can't really
provide any answers for you.
You must overcome the ordeals
of the gods on your own. All I can do is offer my guidance and prayer. ^FFFFFFcobo^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
遗憾的是，我无法真正
为你解答。
你必须独自克服神祇的考验。
我能做的，只有提供指引和祈祷。 ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Welcome back.
Not only have you passed the trials that the gods have set for you, you have tested your courage in the realm of the dead and protected Midgard from attack.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
欢迎回来。
你不仅通过了神祇为你设置的考验，
还在亡者之域考验了你的勇气，
并保护了米德加尔特免受攻击。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods are watching
you. Prove your courage,
and at that moment, you
will earn the honor of being
selected by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
神祇正在注视着你。
证明你的勇气，
在那一刻，
你将获得被神祇选中的荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
You have yet to
fully prove your courage.
Once you do, you will be
summoned by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
你尚未完全
证明你的勇气。
一旦你做到了，
你将被神祇召唤。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods are disappointed
in what you have decided to
do. Unfortunately, you have
been banished from Valhalla
and this place as well.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
神祇对你所做出的决定感到失望。
不幸的是，你已被放逐出瓦尔哈拉，
以及此地。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Great warrior,
your time has not yet
come. Please focus on
your training until you
are summoned by the gods...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
伟大的战士，
你的时刻尚未到来。
请专注于训练，
直到被神祇召唤...

scripts.text: Test...?

[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods have decided that
you are worthy of undergoing
a special test that will judge
your merits. If you are a true
hero who is pure of heart,
you will certainly succeed...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
神祇已决定，你有资格接受一项特殊的考验，
以评判你的功绩。
如果你是一位心地纯洁的真正英雄，
你一定会成功...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Now, there is a critical
situation in the ^FF0000realm where
the fallen warriors dwell^000000. The
gods wish for you to restore the balance by quelling a specific
evil influence in that place.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
现在，^FF0000亡者之域^000000正处于危急状况。
神祇希望你能平息那里的特定邪恶影响，
以恢复平衡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
There will be many obstacles.
First, the fallen, who will target their anger and hatred towards
you. Where they have failed to
enter Valhalla, you have a rare
and wondrous opportunity...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
你将面临许多障碍。
首先，是那些未能进入瓦尔哈拉的亡者，
他们会将愤怒和仇恨指向你。
你拥有他们未曾拥有的罕见而奇妙的机会...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Secondly, and more
importantly, you must find
this evil influence on your
own. This will judge your
ability to discern good from evil. Do not trust appearances...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
其次，也是更重要的是，
你必须独自找到这股邪恶影响。
这将考验你辨别善恶的能力。
不要相信表象...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
This is your task.
I cannot tell you more.
It is now your duty to
travel there and ferret
out true darkness from
one of the hearts there...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
这就是你的任务。
我无法告诉你更多。
现在，你的职责是前往那里，
从那里某人的心中
揪出真正的黑暗...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Remember that the
demonstration of your belief,
rather than the decision to
blindly adhere to faith, is
what the gods want to see.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
请记住，神祇希望看到的是
你信仰的展现，
而非盲目坚守信仰的决定。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Always step forward
with wisdom and courage.
That is all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
永远带着智慧和勇气前进。
这就是我能告诉你的全部。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
I'm pleased to announce that the gods have been watching you and decided to invite you to Valhalla. However, Midgard still has great need of you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
我很高兴宣布，神祇一直在注视着你，
并决定邀请你进入瓦尔哈拉。
然而，米德加尔特仍然非常需要你。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
As a symbol of this promise to invite you to Valhalla, you shall be rewarded with 'The Sign' which will show all others that you are a great warrior whose courage was tested by the gods themselves.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
作为邀请你进入瓦尔哈拉的承诺象征，
你将获得“标示”，
它将向所有人展示，
你是一位勇气经受过神祇考验的伟大战士。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Congratulations,
{0}. Verily,
you are an honorable
hero worthy of praise!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
恭喜你，
{0}。
诚然，
你是一位值得赞扬的
荣誉英雄！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Although you have failed,
I hope that you find your
another way to win back
the favor of the gods...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里 桑德拉]
虽然你失败了，
但我希望你能找到另一种方式，
重新赢得神祇的青睐...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
....?

[Serin]
As its magic power grows,
the Magic Circle is nearing completion. The symbol which I've asked you for is the last material needed for summoning Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
随着魔力的增长，
魔法阵即将完成。
我向你索要的那个符号，
是召唤暗黑之王所需的最后材料。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However, the power of that
symbol can be used to complete
the Magic Circle or destroy it.
Would you hand it over to me?
I choose to destroy this...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
然而，那个符号的力量
既可以用来完成魔法阵，
也可以用来摧毁它。
你愿意把它交给我吗？
我选择摧毁它...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Please...
Let me have the symbol.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
请...
把符号给我。

scripts.text: Give Serin the symbol.
scripts.translation: 把符号交给赛琳

scripts.text:
[Serin]
This could be
pretty dangerous
so please step back...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
这可能会很危险，
请退后...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry.
But I have to do this
to summon Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
对不起。
但我必须这样做，
才能召唤出暗黑之王。

scripts.text: But why...?
scripts.translation: 但为什么...？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
It was never the witch
that wanted Dark Lord summoned,
but me. I've always wanted to return to my human form. I'm sick and tired of being bound here in Niflheim!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
想要召唤暗黑之王的
从来都不是那个女巫，
而是我。我一直都想变回人类。
我受够了被束缚在尼弗尔海姆！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Unfortunately, the symbol
which Lady Hell gave you is
limited to a one time use. Its
power wasn't enough to bring me
back, so summoning Dark Lord is
my last chance.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
不幸的是，地狱夫人
给你的那个符号
只能使用一次。它的力量
不足以让我复活，
所以召唤暗黑之王
是我最后的机会。

scripts.text: But if Dark Lord comes to Midgard...
scripts.translation: 但如果暗黑之王来到米德加尔特...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh, I'm pretty sure of
what will happen if Dark Lord
enters the realm of the living. He'll destroy Midgard and bring death to thousands and thousands of people.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
哦，我很清楚
如果暗黑之王进入生者的世界
会发生什么。他会摧毁米德加尔特，
让成千上万的人死亡。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
So if I came back to life
and everyone else were dead,
However, by summoning Dark Lord,
you might be thinking it'd be pretty pointless for me to come back. But you know what? I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
如果我复活了，
而其他人全都死了，
不过，通过召唤暗黑之王，
你可能觉得我回来也没什么意义。但你知道吗？我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The living don't appreciate
what they have, so they ought
to be punished. They can all go to Niflheim while I enjoy the warmth of the sun and the fresh outside air.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
活着的人不懂得珍惜
他们拥有的东西，
所以他们应该受到惩罚。
让他们都去尼弗尔海姆吧，
而我要享受阳光的温暖和
清新的空气。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Maybe you might not
pity my situation since you've
never been bound to Niflheim,
but I'm begging you. Don't get
in my way.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
也许你并不同情我的处境，
因为你从未被束缚在尼弗尔海姆，
但我求求你。别挡我的路。

scripts.text: Alright. I'll let you go.
scripts.translation: 好吧。我让你走。

scripts.text: No, you have to be stopped.
scripts.translation: 不，你必须被阻止。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Are you really willing
to throw so much away for
my sake? You do understand
that you'll be failing the ordeals set before you by the gods...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你真的愿意
为了我放弃这么多吗？
你知道这会违背
众神为你设定的试炼...

scripts.text: I changed my mind for Midgard.
scripts.translation: 为了米德加尔特，我改变主意了。

scripts.text: I do, and it's alright...
scripts.translation: 我知道，没关系...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
I really don't want to fight you,
but I've come too far to give up now. If you insist on interfering, then you leave me no choice...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
...
我真的不想和你战斗，
但我已经走到这一步了，
不能放弃。如果你坚持要干涉，
那就别怪我不客气了...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Insolent mortal!
Do you really think
you have a chance of
stopping me? Hmpf.
Every fool must learn.
Prepare to die!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033无礼的凡人！
你真以为
你有机会
阻止我吗？哼。
每个傻瓜都必须付出代价。
准备受死吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The least I can
do is send you back
to Midgard and
ask the Dark Lord to spare
you. Thank you so much...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我至少能做的
就是把你送回米德加尔特，
并请求暗黑之王
放过你。非常感谢...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
I really don't want to fight you,
but I've come too far to give up now. If you insist on interfering, then you leave me no choice...
scripts.translation:

...
我真的不想和你战斗，

scripts.text:

你有机会

[Serin]
I see now.
Soon, I'll lose my memories
and remain dead in Niflheim.
Just like all the others. Still,
may I ask you one question?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我明白了。
很快，我就会失去记忆，
永远死在尼弗尔海姆。
就像其他人一样。不过，
我能问你一个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
With that symbol, you
could order the dead to do
whatever you want. Why didn't
you use it to command me to quit?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
用那个符号，
你可以命令死者
做任何你想做的事。为什么你
不用它来命令我放弃呢？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I see it now.
The kindness in your eyes
tells me everything. You wanted to give me another chance. But in the end, I managed to destroy the
chance you had given me.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我现在明白了。
你眼中的善意告诉我了一切。你想再给我一次机会。但最终，是我亲手毁掉了你给我的这份机会。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though I'm nothing but
a spirit now, it was an honor
for me to meet somebody like you. Although I'll lose my memories, I'll try not to forget you.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
即使我现在只是一缕残魂，能遇到你这样的人，也是我的荣幸。虽然我会失去记忆，但我会努力记住你的。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
My memories of your
courage and kindness
are more precious to
me than life itself.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我对你的勇气和善意留下的记忆，比生命本身更珍贵。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Farewell, now.
And good luck on
your travels, my friend...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
再见了。
愿你在旅途中一切顺利，我的朋友...

^3355FFYou helped the
unconscious Serin

送她回家的承诺。

you gave them nothing

scripts.translation:

是的...
通过试图帮助他们，
你只给他们带来了痛苦，

现在我有足够的绝望

but I can't let you stop me.

Dark Lord to become a living
human again so I can't give up
now! We'll have to battle!

所以我不能放弃！
我们不得不战斗！

Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你还没
放弃吗？
请别
试图阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though you tried
to stop me, I still don't wish
to take your life. I understand
that you've merely trying to
protect your Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
尽管你试图阻止我，但我仍无意夺走你的性命。我明白，你只是在试图保护你的米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However...
I do not think you
have the courage to
overcome the ordeals 
of the gods. Please don't
come here anymore...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
但是...
我不认为你有勇气
克服诸神的试炼。请不要再
来这里了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSerin took
1 Witch's Tonic
from you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF赛琳从你这里
拿走了1瓶魔女药水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
your Witch's Tonic
to help me summon
Dark Lord. Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
对不起...
但我要拿走你的魔女药水
来帮助我召唤暗黑之王。
再见...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Haven't you
given up yet?
Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你还没
放弃吗？
请别
试图阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Let me guide
you to where
you belong.
.......
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
让我指引你
去往你该去的地方。
.......

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry,
but you're not
the person I'm
looking for. No...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
对不起，
你不是我在找的人。
不...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Kind adventurer...
You're the one I'm looking
for, the one who's been on
a long journey to prove
his courage.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
善良的冒险者...
你就是我在找的人，
那个为了证明勇气
而踏上漫长旅程的人。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Kind adventurer...
You're the one I'm looking
for, the one who's been on
a long journey to prove
her courage.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
善良的冒险者...
你就是我在找的人，
那个为了证明勇气
而踏上漫长旅程的人。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even in the darkness of
Niflheim, I can recognize
you. You shine out to me like
a star! I beg of you, please
listen to my story...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
即使在尼弗尔海姆的黑暗中，
我也能认出你。
你像星星一样向我闪耀！
我恳求你，请听我
讲讲我的故事...

scripts.text: I'm busy, sorry.
scripts.translation: 我很忙，抱歉。

scripts.text: Sure, go ahead.
scripts.translation: 好的，请说。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I can't stop
you from pursing your
path to glory. But if you
should change your mind...!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我知道我无法阻止你
追求荣耀的道路。
但如果你改变主意...！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you...
Now, if you've heard
from the others and as
you can tell by my appearance,
I clearly don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
谢谢你...
如果你从其他人那里听说过，
而且从我这副模样也能看出来，
我显然不属于这里。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I might not have
the luck to be selected
by Valkyrie, but I need
your help to get out of
here as soon as I can~
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我可能没有运气被瓦尔基里选中，
但我需要你的帮助，
让我尽快离开这里~

scripts.text: Er, I'm busy, now that I think about it.
scripts.translation: 呃，我现在很忙，仔细想想。

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我们来做吧。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I can't stop
you from pursing your
path to glory. But if you
should change your mind...!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我知道我无法阻止你
追求荣耀的道路。
但如果你改变主意...！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I'm asking too much
of you, but if you'd also help
the other unfortunate souls in
this place, I'd be truly grateful. Somehow, I think solving their problems will help me get back.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我知道我要求太多了，
但如果你也能帮助
这里其他不幸的灵魂，
我会非常感激。
不知为何，我觉得解决他们的问题
会帮助我回去。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text: Why should I help them?
scripts.translation: 我为什么要帮他们？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I knew you'd understand!
You really are a kind person.
Now, in order to help the other
misfortunate in Niflheim, you've got to remember to gain their trust first and get close to them, okay?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我就知道你会理解的！
你真是个善良的人。
那么，为了帮助尼弗尔海姆
其他不幸的人，
你必须先记住赢得他们的信任，
并接近他们，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I... I understand.
Although I asked too much in asking you to help the other people here, I was hoping you'd realize that
would be the best way to learn clues for a way to escape for now.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我...我理解。
虽然我要求你帮助这里其他人
可能要求太多了，
但我希望你能意识到，
这是目前寻找逃脱线索的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
You don't know which
people you need to help
here in Niflheim? Mmm,
let me think about it...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯...？
你不知道在尼弗尔海姆
需要帮助哪些人吗？
嗯，让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In this doomed place,
there isn't too much trust
amongst some of the people
here, but some will share their
problems if you ^3355FFapproach them
closely^000000, ^3355FFface to face^000000. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
在这个注定毁灭的地方，
这里有些人之间缺乏信任，
但如果你^3355FF接近他们^000000，^3355FF面对面^000000，
有些人会分享他们的问题。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In this way, if they talk
to you first, they might
be more willing to accept
help or tell you what you
really need to know.
I hope this helps...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
这样，如果他们先和你说话，
他们可能更愿意接受帮助，
或者告诉你真正需要知道的事情。
希望这能帮到你...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you so much for
your help. This is all I have,
and it means a lot to me, but
I want you to have this ring. It's the only way I can properly express my gratitude for your aid so far.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
非常感谢你的帮助。
这是我所有的一切，
对我来说意义重大，
但我想把这个戒指给你。
这是我唯一能恰当表达
对你迄今为止帮助感激之情的方式。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
To the dead,
living people
are either good
prey or good marks.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
对于死者来说，
活人要么是好的猎物，
要么是好的目标。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hello, adventurer.
How have you been doing?
I'm surprised to still see you
around this dangerous town.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你好，冒险者。
你过得怎么样？
我很惊讶还能在这个危险的城镇
见到你。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you wander around
Niflheim, you'll find that
some of the deceased here are
different than most of the others in this town. Please talk to them and see if you can be of any help.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
如果你在尼弗尔海姆四处游荡，
你会发现这里的一些死者
与镇上大多数其他人不同。
请和他们谈谈，看看你能否帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There's a Bard in
Niflheim with a very
sweet, yet melancholy voice.
He sings for strangers just
like you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
尼弗尔海姆有一位诗人，
他的声音非常甜美，
却又带着忧郁。
他为你这样的陌生人歌唱，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I think he might know
some useful information,
so it might be a good
idea to speak with him.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我想他可能知道一些有用的信息，
所以和他对话可能是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hello, {0},
I'm surprised that
you've managed to survive
here all this time. It's no small feat for a mortal to be able to remain alive in Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你好，{0}，
我很惊讶你能在这里
生存这么久。
对于凡人来说，
能在尼弗尔海姆保持活着
绝非易事...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, {0}~
How is everything?
Once again, I want to
thank you for helping the
poor souls in this place.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
啊，{0}~
一切都好吗？
再次感谢你帮助
这个地方的可怜灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
What's with that
look on your face?
Do you have something
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯...？
你脸上那是什么表情？
你有什么想问我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, {0}~
How is everything?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
啊，{0}~
一切都好吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
What's with that
look on your face?
Do you have something
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯...？
你脸上那是什么表情？
你有什么想问我的吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: About the Queen of the Dead...
scripts.translation: 关于亡灵女王...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, if you ever
need my help, please
don't hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，如果你需要我的帮助，
请尽管开口，不要客气。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The Queen of the Dead?
Why, she's the ruler of Niflheim.
As Loki and Angrboda's last child, she was given complete control of this realm by Odin.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
亡灵女王？
她是尼弗尔海姆的统治者。
作为洛基和安格尔伯达的最后一个孩子，
奥丁赋予了她对这个领域的完全控制权。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
She usually rules from her
castle, Hell, but sometimes she goes out to tour Niflheim. That's all I really know about her.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
她通常在她的城堡“地狱”中统治，
但有时也会外出巡视尼弗尔海姆。
关于她，我就只知道这些了。

scripts.text: About the Symbol of Nine Realms
scripts.translation: 关于九重世界的权威

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh that...?
Sometimes it's called
the Voucher of the Dead.
Odin gave it to the Queen
of the Dead to signify her
authority over Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
哦，那个...？
它有时也被称为亡者的凭证。
奥丁将它交给亡灵女王，
以象征她对尼弗尔海姆的权威。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There are many rumors
floating around about that
symbol and its abilities, but
all we know for sure is that it can be used to command the dead...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
关于那个符号及其能力，
流传着许多谣言，
但我们确切知道的只有，
它可以用来命令亡灵...

scripts.text: About Angrboda
scripts.translation: 关于安格尔伯达

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Angrboda...?
She's the mother of the
Queen of Hell, as well as
some of the most powerful
monsters in this universe.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
安格尔伯达...？
她是地狱女王的母亲，
也是这个宇宙中最强大的魔物之一的母亲。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The gods feared her monstrous
children so much that they bound
them and sealed Angrboda away.
Nothing has been heard
of her since...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
众神非常害怕她那些怪异的孩子们，
于是束缚了它们，并将安格尔伯达封印起来。
从那以后，就再也没人听说过她的消息...

scripts.text: I was told by the Witch that you're...
scripts.translation: 女巫告诉我，你是...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh, the Witch was
talking about me? I'm
aware that she doesn't
think very highly of me.
Then again, it's not like
I can trust her either.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
哦，女巫在说我吗？
我知道她对我评价不高。
不过话说回来，我也并不信任她。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, it can't be helped.
At least we both agree that
somehow I don't really belong
here in Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，没办法。
至少我们都同意，
我似乎并不属于尼弗尔海姆这里。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry that I sort of
rambled on and on that last
time we spoke. Now that I think
about it, I didn't really give you any information that might have been very useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
很抱歉上次我们谈话时，
我有点喋喋不休。
现在回想起来，
我并没有给你提供任何可能对你很有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
But lately I've heard that the
Queen of the Dead is seeking her
mother, Angrboda. It's strange that even the queen, with all of her
power, is unable to find her.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
但最近我听说，
亡灵女王正在寻找她的母亲安格尔伯达。
奇怪的是，即使拥有如此力量的女王，
也无法找到她。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I have no idea how,
but it seems like Angrboda
has been sealed away in the
world of Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我不知道是怎么做到的，
但似乎安格尔伯达被封印在了
米德加尔特...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I've told you
everything I know.
But if you want to learn more
about Angrboda, you probably need to talk to someone who actually communicates with the gods.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我已经把我知道的都告诉你了。
但如果你想了解更多关于安格尔伯达的事，
你可能需要去和那些真正能与神交流的人谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Perhaps Valkyrie
or someone who actually
lived in Asgard may know
more about where Angrboda
is sealed away.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
也许瓦尔基里，
或者那些真正生活在阿斯加德的人，
会知道更多关于安格尔伯达
被封印在何处的信息。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Also, why would you want
the Symbol of the Nine Realms?
It's a very dangerous object that could cause a lot of trouble if it fell into the wrong hands...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
还有，你为什么想要
九重世界的权威？
那是一件非常危险的东西，
如果落入错误的人手中，可能会引起很多麻烦...

scripts.text: What do you mean??
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text: Don't worry, it won't.
scripts.translation: 别担心，不会的。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There are plenty of dead
people in Niflheim that are
driven by regret and despair.
The rage of being dead may result in some of them performing horrific deeds if they had the symbol.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
尼弗尔海姆有很多亡灵，
他们被悔恨和绝望所驱使。
死亡的愤怒可能会让他们
在拥有该符号时做出可怕的举动。

scripts.text: Then what should I do?
scripts.translation: 那我该怎么办？

scripts.text: Thanks for the concern, but I'm not worried.
scripts.translation: 谢谢关心，但我并不担心。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I really think that you
should bring that symbol
to me before you show it to anybody else. Then, I want you to know why I really need its power.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我真的认为，
在你把它展示给其他人之前，
应该先把它交给我。
然后，我想让你知道
我为什么真正需要它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I can't explain myself
now, but I want to use the
power of the symbol to do
something really helpful
for you. You'll just need
to trust me on this.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我现在无法解释，
但我想用符号的力量
为你做一件真正有帮助的事。
你只需要相信我这一点。

scripts.text: I'll think about it.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Then I will
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
那么我会
在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Alright...
It's your decision.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
好吧...
这是你的决定。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah...
Alright, I suppose
that if you're worthy
of obtaining the symbol,
you should also be able
to protect it from abuse.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
啊...
好吧，我想
如果你配得上获得这个符号，
你也应该能够保护它不被滥用。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you obtain the
Symbol of Nine Realms,
please bring it to me
right away, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
如果你获得了
九重世界的符号，
请立即把它交给我，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Yes...
This is the Symbol of the
Nine Realms. It only has enough
power for one use, but it's still not easy to get this. Now, what were you planning to use this for?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
是的...
这就是九重世界的符号。
它的力量只够使用一次，
但获得它并不容易。那么，
你打算用它做什么？

scripts.text: Tell her your story.
scripts.translation: 告诉她你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, so you're here
in Niflheim to overcome
the ordeals of the gods and
prove your courage to Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
啊，原来你是来到尼弗尔海姆，
为了克服诸神的试炼，
并向瓦尔基里证明你的勇气。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
So wait...
You've obtained that symbol
just for that witch? This may
seem rude, but I want to tell
you exactly how I feel about her.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
等等...
你只是为了那个女巫
才获得那个符号的吗？
这也许有点无礼，
但我想告诉你我对她的真实感受。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Isn't it suspicious that she
hasn't explained her intentions to you? The Symbol of Nine Realms
is one of the most powerful objects in Niflheim. Whatever she's planning has to be large scale.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
她没有向你解释她的意图，
这难道不可疑吗？
九重世界的符号是尼弗尔海姆
最强大的物品之一。
无论她在策划什么，规模一定很大。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Then, there's that Metz Brayde.
Do you really believe that after he completes his research, he'll just give it back to you? You can't just trust someone to hold an object of enormous power and give it back!
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
还有那个梅茨·布雷德。
你真的相信他在完成研究后，
就会把它还给你吗？
你不能把拥有巨大力量的物品
交给别人保管并指望他们归还！

scripts.text: W-what should I do?
scripts.translation: 我...我该怎么办？

scripts.text: I can't believe this!
scripts.translation: 我无法相信这件事！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, I can't really tell
you what to do, but I don't think it's a good idea to let that witch have the Symbol of Nine Realms. There's no telling what she'll
use its power for.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，我其实不能告诉你该怎么做，
但我不认为让那个女巫
拥有九重世界的符号是个好主意。
没人知道她会用它做什么。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Actually...
There is this rumor
going around, but I don't
know if you want to hear it...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
其实...
最近有个传闻，
但我不确定您是否想听...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry if you were offended.
I know I can't really convince you to believe anything, but please understand that I just don't want anyone to take advantage of you. Forgive my rudeness.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
如果您感到被冒犯了，我很抱歉。
我知道我很难让您相信我的话，
但请理解，我只是不想让您被人利用。
请原谅我的失礼。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is only
a lingering trace
of Serin, a manifestation
of her definitive memory.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是赛琳残留的痕迹，
是她最终记忆的显现。^000000

scripts.text: Give Serin her ring.
scripts.translation: 把戒指还给赛琳

scripts.text: Keep the ring.
scripts.translation: 保留戒指

scripts.text:
[Serin]
....{0}.....
I don't want to forget you.
I can forget my obsession with
life and all my other memories,
But if I can keep just one memory, I want it to be of your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
....{0}.....
我不想忘记你。
我可以忘记我对生命的执念，
也可以忘记其他所有记忆，
但如果只能保留一段记忆，我希望那是你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even now, you're still
so very kind to me. Thank
you for giving back my ring,
my most precious possession.
Thank you, thank you...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
即使现在，你依然对我如此温柔。
谢谢你把戒指还给我，
那是我最珍贵的东西。
谢谢你，谢谢你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe sound of Serin's voice
softened and when it grew silent, her eyes blankly stared ahead as
if she were in a trance. It looks like she has already forgotten
everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF赛琳的声音渐渐柔和下来，
当声音归于寂静时，她的眼神空洞地凝视着前方，
仿佛陷入了恍惚。看起来她已经忘记了所有事情...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBut Serin has also been able
to forget her sadness. The tears streaked across her cheeks and
the faint smile on her lips tell you that her memories of you
will always remain in her heart.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF但赛琳也忘记了她的悲伤。
泪水划过她的脸颊，
嘴角那抹淡淡的微笑告诉你，
对你的记忆将永远留在她的心中。^000000

scripts.text: Tell me the rumors about the witch.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于女巫的传闻

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, I've heard that the witch has been hiding deep in Niflheim and will only speak to those who pass her test. Apparently, she's been preparing some sort of ritual
to gain more power...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，我听说女巫躲在尼弗尔海姆的深处，
她只会与通过她考验的人对话。
显然，她正在准备某种仪式
来获取更多的力量...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
It's almost too horrible
to believe, but I think that
she's preparing the ritual to
summon Dark Lord, ruler of
the Realm of Fiends.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
这几乎令人难以置信，
但我认为她正在准备仪式，
召唤暗黑之王，
魔界的主宰。

scripts.text: Dark Lord...?
scripts.translation: 暗黑之王...？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, most people don't
know this, but Dark Lord
comes from the Realm of Fiends.
In his own domain, he's so powerful that even the gods fear his might.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，大多数人不知道，
但暗黑之王来自魔界。
在他的领域里，他强大到
连众神都畏惧他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Now, sometimes Dark Lord can
enter the world of Midgard, but only in a manifestation that represents just a small portion
of his full power.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
现在，有时暗黑之王可以
进入米德加尔特，
但只能以显现的形式，
那只代表了他全部力量的一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
You see, it takes too much energy to travel from the Realm of Fiends to Midgard. And since the life force in Midgard conflicts with his powers, Dark Lord can't reach your world directly.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
你看，从魔界前往米德加尔特
需要消耗大量的能量。
而且由于米德加尔特中的生命力
与他的力量相冲突，
暗黑之王无法直接到达你的世界。

scripts.text: Wouldn't Lady Hell stop him?
scripts.translation: 地狱夫人不会阻止他吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, Dark Lord only wants
Midgard, so the Queen of the Dead doesn't feel threatened about her control of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
既然暗黑之王只想要米德加尔特，
亡者女王就不会感到威胁，
因为她对尼弗尔海姆的掌控依然稳固。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In fact, I'm sure she's aware
that Dark Lord will cause thousands of deaths in Midgard, meaning that there would be thousands more souls for her to rule over. So it's not to her advantage to stop him.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
事实上，我相信她很清楚，
暗黑之王在米德加尔特会造成成千上万人的死亡，
这意味着将有更多的灵魂供她统治。
所以，阻止他并不符合她的利益。

scripts.text: Then what should we do...?
scripts.translation: 那我们该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
No matter what the cost,
we've got to stop her from
summoning Dark Lord in order
to protect Midgard from
total annihiliation.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
无论付出什么代价，
我们都必须阻止她召唤暗黑之王，
以保护米德加尔特免于彻底毁灭。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I used to be a pretty
skilled Wizard, so I know
that she needs to draw a really huge magic circle in Niflheim if she wants to summon Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我曾经是一名相当出色的巫师，
所以我知道，如果她想召唤暗黑之王，
她需要在尼弗尔海姆画一个巨大的魔法阵。

scripts.text: Can you tell me where?
scripts.translation: 你能告诉我地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, there are certain rules
and conditions to perform the summoning. There aren't any spaces wide enough in the Valley of Gyoll, and Niflheim's entrance is watched by too many people...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
嗯，进行召唤需要满足特定的规则和条件。
鬼之峡谷没有足够宽敞的空间，
而尼弗尔海姆的入口又有太多人监视...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Now, if I were to summon
Dark Lord, I would probably
do it somewhere inside town
to avoid attention. Hmmm...
I'll send you there once I figure out where the circle might be.
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
现在，如果是我来召唤暗黑之王，
我可能会选择城镇内部的某个地方，
以避免引起注意。嗯...
等我确定魔法阵可能的位置后，我会把你传送过去。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I need to finish
my preparations to send
you to the magic circle,
so I need a little more time...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我需要完成将你传送到魔法阵的准备，
所以我还需要一点时间...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Alright...
So are you
ready to leave?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
好了...
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 还没

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Okay~
Let's go...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
好的~
我们走吧...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
My preparations
are taking longer
than I thought. Would
you wait a little while?
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
我的准备时间比预想的要长。
你能稍等一下吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is just a lingering
trace of Serin, an impression
of her soul and memories that
you can still sense somehow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是赛琳残留的痕迹，
是她灵魂和记忆的印记，
不知为何你依然能感知到它。^000000

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追踪痕迹

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
......
W-who...
Who are you?

^3355FFThis is just a lingering
trace of Serin, an impression
of her soul and memories that
you can still sense somehow.
What could have happened to her?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是赛琳残留的痕迹，
是她灵魂和记忆的印记，
不知为何你依然能感知到它。
她究竟遭遇了什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^33555FFSuddenly, Serin's
gold ring sparkled
with a soft glow and
faded away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^33555F突然，赛琳的金戒指
闪烁着柔和的光芒，
然后渐渐消失了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[赛琳]
谢谢你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou returned
Serin's gold ring.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你归还了赛琳的金戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That Witch's Medal...
You must be here to
help your friend take
care of Serin. Are you
ready to go, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那枚魔女之证...
你一定是来帮你的朋友
处理赛琳的事的。{0}，
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That bastard stole
two spell books from me.
You've brought one of them
back, but the other book
is still missing.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那个混蛋从我这里偷走了两本法术书。
你找回了其中一本，
但另一本仍然下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Some bastard stole
two of my spell books.
I'd be grateful if you can
find him in Niflheim and
bring my books back to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
有个混蛋偷走了我的两本法术书。
如果你能在尼弗海姆找到他，
并把我的书带回来，
我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once that fool stole my spell
books, he was cursed after he
cast those spells without my
permission. I'm so relieved to
finally hold these in my
hands again.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那个蠢货偷了我的法术书后，
因为未经我允许就施放了法术，
结果受到了诅咒。
终于又能亲手握住它们了，
真是松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm...?
Why haven't you
brought my books
back to me yet?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
嗯...？
你为什么还没有
把我的书带回来？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If you need to learn more
about Angrboda, why don't you
just ask around? I'm sure that
everyone is aware that the queen
is searching for her mother.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
如果你需要了解更多关于安格尔伯达的信息，
为什么不四处问问呢？
我相信大家都知道，
女王正在寻找她的母亲。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I almost hate
suggesting it, but
I think Serin might
have some information
on Angrboda's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我几乎不想建议这样做，
但我觉得赛琳可能
知道安格尔伯达的下落。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
It may be almost
impossible to obtain
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
Still, you and I both need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
获得九界之印
可能几乎是不可能的。
不过，你和我都需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The Symbol of Nine Realms?
How were you able to get that?!
Ah, you must have found the Queen of the Dead's mother, Angrboda, right? Great work~
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
九界之印？
你是怎么拿到它的？！
啊，你一定找到了亡灵女王
的母亲安格尔伯达，对吧？
干得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This is Serin's gold ring?
Excellent, this has been
strongly infused with her
vibes. It's really tough to find something like this that resonates so strongly with its owner.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这是赛琳的金戒指？
太好了，它强烈地
蕴含着她的气息。
要找到能与主人如此
强烈共鸣的物品真的很难。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm, you don't have
anything related to Serin.
This isn't good. She's hid
herself already and it might
be too late to find any trace of her. I'll have to do something...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
嗯，你身上没有
任何与赛琳相关的东西。
这不好。她已经藏起来了，
可能已经太迟了，
找不到她的踪迹了。
我得做点什么...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now that the potion I'm
making is being processed,
I can finally tell you what
I've been trying to do with
the objects I've asked you
to get for me.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
既然我正在制作的药水
已经处理好了，
我终于可以告诉你，
我让你去收集那些物品
是为了做什么。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The potion is finally
completed. Now, take this
and command Serin to drink it.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
药水终于完成了。
现在，拿着这个，
命令赛琳喝下去。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please wait
a bit. I'm still
trying to finish
these preparations...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
请稍等。
我还在努力
完成这些准备工作...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You're finally
back. We might not
have enough time to
stop her, but we have
to try. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你终于回来了。
我们可能没有足够的时间
阻止她，但我们必须尝试。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
We've got to
stop Serin before
she does something
truly horrible. Are
you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我们必须在赛琳做出
真正可怕的事情之前
阻止她。
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmmm...?
Where are all the
vouchers I've lent to you?
Please retrieve them all
before coming back to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
嗯...？
我借给你的那些凭证
都在哪里？
请把它们全部取回，
然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你做得很好。
没有了前世的记忆，
赛琳可以平静地
留在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm so relieved that
my expectations about
you weren't wrong.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
很高兴我对你的
期望没有落空。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
How could you fail when
the stakes are so high?
Serin almost summoned
the Dark Lord, but luckily,
somebody else stopped
her in the nick of time.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
在如此重大的关头，
你怎么能失败呢？
赛琳差点召唤出了暗黑之王，
幸好，有人在千钧一发之际
阻止了她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmpf.
I don't really
want to talk to
you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
哼。
我真的不想
再和你说话了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've got to hurry
and stop Serin!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
快一点，
去阻止赛琳！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hm? Still exploring
Niflheim? Although you're
strong enough to survive,
I still think you're risking
your life by remaining here
when you don't have to.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
嗯？还在探索尼弗海姆？
虽然你有足够的实力生存，
但我觉得你没必要留在这里，
这样是在拿生命冒险。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 还没...

scripts.text: Go directly to Serin
scripts.translation: 直接去找赛琳

scripts.text: Path Towards Serin
scripts.translation: 前往赛琳的路

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Thank you
for your help.
Serin's threat may
be too much for just
one adventurer alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
谢谢你的帮助。
赛琳的威胁可能
对单个冒险者来说
太过沉重了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Thank you
for your help.
Serin's threat may
be too much for just
one adventurer alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
谢谢你的帮助。
赛琳的威胁可能
对单个冒险者来说
太过沉重了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please hurry...
Time is of the essence...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
请快点...
时间紧迫...

scripts.text:
That bastard stole
two spell books from me.
You've brought one of them
back, but the other book
is still missing.
scripts.translation:
那个混蛋偷走了
我的两本法术书。
你找回了其中一本，
但另一本
还是下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Would you please
retrieve my other
spell book for me,
adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
冒险者，
请帮我找回
另一本法术书，好吗？

scripts.text:
Some bastard stole
two of my spell books.
I'd be grateful if you can
find him in Niflheim and
bring my books back to me.
scripts.translation:
有个混蛋偷走了
我的两本法术书。
如果你能在尼弗海姆
找到他，并把书还给我，
我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
Once that fool stole my spell
books, he was cursed after he
cast those spells without my
permission. I'm so relieved to
finally hold these in my
hands again.
scripts.translation:
那个蠢货偷了我的法术书，
他在未经我允许的情况下
施放了那些法术，结果受到了诅咒。
我很庆幸终于
能再次把它们握在手中。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now mortal...
Why is it that
you've come to see me?
I'm sure that there must
be something you want.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
凡人...
你为何前来见我？
我相信你一定
有什么想要的东西。

scripts.text: He asked me to see you for....
scripts.translation: 他让我来找你，为了....

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
As I expected,
there is something behind
all of this. Now, you may
know where you are, but
do you understand why
the dead are here?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
果然，
这一切背后另有隐情。
现在，你可能知道
自己身在何处，
但你知道死者为何
会在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This realm is a place
for warriors that have failed
to prove their courage. Keep in
mind that it's not too late for
you to join their ranks.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这片领域是
那些未能证明勇气的
战士的归宿。请记住，
你现在加入他们的行列
还来得及。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The realm of Niflheim
is ruled by the Queen of the
Dead. Sometimes she appears
in her shining armor and makes the rounds. Everyone who sees her is stunned by the image of authority.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
尼弗海姆由
亡者女王统治。
有时她会身着
闪亮的盔甲巡视。
所有看到她的人
都会被那威严的形象
所震慑。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now...
What I need you to do is
ask the Queen of the Dead
for the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在...
我需要你做的是
向亡者女王
索要“九界之证”。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The symbol acts as
a voucher of the queen's
authority and represents her
undeniable right to rule over
the dead. But right now, I can't
explain why I need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这个符号是
女王权威的凭证，
代表着她统治死者
无可置疑的权利。
但现在，我无法解释
为什么需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'll tell you why I need
it once you bring me the
queen's symbol. Now, please
keep this secret and tell no one that I asked you to bring the symbol to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
等你把女王的符号
带给我之后，
我会告诉你为什么需要它。
现在，请保守这个秘密，
不要告诉任何人
是我让你带符号来的。

scripts.text: How am I supposed to get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么拿到那个符号？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
强行夺取符号
是绝对不可能的。
即使是神明
也不会考虑
与亡者女王开战。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你需要获得女王的青睐，
才有机会得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，有传闻说
亡者女王正在寻找
她失散的母亲安格尔伯达。
如果你能找到
安格尔伯达被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Why haven't you
brought my books
back to me yet?
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你为什么还没
把我的书还给我？

scripts.text:
If you need to learn more
about Angrboda, why don't you
just ask around? I'm sure that
everyone is aware that the queen
is searching for her mother.
scripts.translation:
如果你需要了解更多
关于安格尔伯达的信息，
为什么不四处打听一下呢？
我相信大家都知道
女王正在寻找她的母亲。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, don't let
anyone know that I've asked
you to bring me the Symbol of
the Nine Realms. I especially
don't want Serin to find out.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
再次强调，不要让任何人知道
是我让你带九界之符给我的。
我特别不希望赛琳知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If I can help it,
I won't tolerate
Serin's presense here
in Niflheim. If I could
banish her, I'd do it!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
如果可以的话，
我绝不容忍赛琳
出现在尼弗尔海姆。
如果能将她放逐，
我会毫不犹豫地这么做！

scripts.text:
I almost hate
suggesting it, but
I think Serin might
have some information
on Angrboda's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
我几乎不想建议这样做，
但我觉得赛琳可能
掌握着安格尔伯达
下落的一些信息。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
But remember to be
careful around her.
Something about that
Serin isn't quite right...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
但记得在她身边
要小心。
那个赛琳身上
有些不对劲...

scripts.text:
It may be almost
impossible to obtain
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
Still, you and I both need it.
scripts.translation:
获得九界之符
可能几乎是不可能的。
尽管如此，
你和我都需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I hope you understand
that the symbol is more
than just a mere voucher.
It actually contains
enormous power...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我希望你能理解，
这个符号不仅仅是一张凭证。
它实际上蕴含着
巨大的力量...

scripts.text:
The Symbol of Nine Realms?
How were you able to get that?!
Ah, you must have found the Queen of the Dead's mother, Angrboda, right? Great work~
scripts.translation:
九界之符？
你是怎么拿到它的？！
啊，你一定找到了
亡者女王的母亲安格尔伯达，对吧？
干得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if you'll just
hand me the symbol, I'll tell
you what we need to do next.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，只要你把符号交给我，
我就告诉你接下来
我们需要做什么。

scripts.text: Give the symbol.
scripts.translation: 交出符号

scripts.text: Don't give the symbol.
scripts.translation: 不交出符号

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Listen carefully.
Since you were actually
able to get the symbol, I believe that you're the only person capable of performing this next task.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
仔细听着。
既然你真的拿到了符号，
我相信你是唯一有能力
完成下一个任务的人。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
We're going to use this
symbol to create something,
but we need one last item.
I need you to find something
imbued with Serin's vibes.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我们要用这个符号
制造某样东西，
但我们还需要最后一件物品。
我需要你找到一件
带有赛琳气息的东西。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Serin's already hid herself
deep within Niflheim, but I'm
sure you can find something
if you can find any remaining
trace of her.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
赛琳已经深深藏匿在
尼弗尔海姆之中，
但如果你能找到她留下的
任何痕迹，
我相信你能找到那件东西。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Huh...?
Don't tell me that
you've taken that wench's
side! Well, I won't take the
symbol against your will, but
you better think this over...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
哈...？
难道你站到了
那个女人的那边！
好吧，我不会违背你的意愿
强行拿走符号，
但你最好好好想想...

scripts.text:
This is Serin's gold ring?
Excellent, this has been
strongly infused with her
vibes. It's really tough to find something like this that resonates so strongly with its owner.
scripts.translation:
这是赛琳的金戒指？
太好了，这件物品
强烈地浸染着她的气息。
很难找到像这样
与主人如此共鸣的物品。

scripts.text:
Hmm, you don't have
anything related to Serin.
This isn't good. She's hid
herself already and it might
be too late to find any trace of her. I'll have to do something...
scripts.translation:
嗯，你身上没有
任何与赛琳相关的东西。
这不好。她已经藏起来了，
可能已经太迟了，
找不到她的痕迹了。
我得想想办法...

scripts.text:
Now that the potion I'm
making is being processed,
I can finally tell you what
I've been trying to do with
the objects I've asked you
to get for me.
scripts.translation:
现在，我正在制作的药水
已经进入了处理阶段，
我终于可以告诉你，
我让你收集那些东西
究竟是为了做什么。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I didn't explain the
reason I wanted the Symbol
of Nine Realms to prevent Serin
from getting suspicious and forcing you to reveal my plans. You see, Serin isn't fit for Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我之所以没有解释
想要九重世界的权威
的原因，是为了防止赛琳
起疑心，逼你透露我的计划。
你看，赛琳并不适合尼弗尔海姆。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she's in the
world of the dead, Serin
has never accepted death and
has desired to return to life. Of course, that's the natural response for everyone that comes here...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
虽然她身处死者的世界，
但赛琳从未接受死亡，
一直渴望重返人间。
当然，对于所有来到这里的人来说，
这都是很自然的反应...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
However, unlike the others
who have despaired, lost
hope and accepted their fate,
Serin has never given up her hope to return to life. With her hope, she retains her beauty and light.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
然而，与其他那些
陷入绝望、失去希望
并接受命运的人不同，
赛琳从未放弃重返人间的希望。
凭借这份希望，
她保留了自己的美丽与光辉。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
But she's only denying
the fate she deserves.
What she's trying to do
is wrong and we need to
stop her before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
但她只是在否认
她应得的命运。
她想要做的事情是错误的，
我们需要在一切为时已晚之前
阻止她。

scripts.text: What does she want?
scripts.translation: 她想要什么？

scripts.text: What is she going to do?
scripts.translation: 她打算做什么？

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我该做什么？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Make no mistake:
Serin wants the Symbol
of the Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
不要搞错了：
赛琳想要的是
九重世界的权威。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if she could use it
multiple times, she could just
command the guards of Niflheim
to just let her pass and re-enter the world of the living. But your symbol can be used just once...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，如果她能多次使用它，
她就可以命令尼弗尔海姆的卫兵
放行，让她重新进入生者的世界。
但你的符号只能使用一次...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I believe Serin is going to
summon the Dark Lord. Since
she used to be a great wizard,
it's entirely possible. However, she might need the Symbol of the Nine Realms in order to do it.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我相信赛琳打算
召唤暗黑之王。
由于她曾是一位伟大的巫师，
这完全有可能。
不过，她可能需要九重世界的权威
才能做到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, you may believe that
Dark Lord can be defeated by
humans, but what you might not
know is that the manifestation of Dark Lord in your world is limited to a fraction of his true power.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，你可能认为
暗黑之王可以被人类击败，
但你可能不知道的是，
暗黑之王在你们世界的显现
仅限于他真正力量的一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Sometimes Dark Lord can
cross over into Midgard,
but traveling from his world into
ours takes vast amounts of energy. Also the life force in your world conflicts with his dark powers.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
有时，暗黑之王可以
跨越到米德加尔特，
但从他的世界来到我们的世界
需要消耗大量的能量。
此外，你们世界的生命力
与他的黑暗灵魂之力相冲突。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if Dark Lord were
summoned into Niflheim,
he would have easy access
to Midgard and the use
of all of his destructive power.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，如果暗黑之王
被召唤到尼弗尔海姆，
他将能够轻松进入米德加尔特，
并动用他所有的破坏力。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Serin plans to strike
a deal with Dark Lord:
In exchange for summoning
him to Niflheim, Serin will
be brought back to life.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
赛琳计划与暗黑之王
达成交易：
作为将他召唤到尼弗尔海姆的交换，
赛琳将被复活。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although you've found
favor with Lady Hell, she
will probably not stop Dark
Lord's approach. Dark Lord
only wants Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
虽然你获得了地狱夫人的青睐，
但她可能不会阻止
暗黑之王的到来。
暗黑之王只想要米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now that I think about
it, massive death would
actually increase Lady Hell's
sphere of influence. I don't think she'll help Dark Lord, but she
also won't get in his way.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在仔细想想，
大规模的死亡实际上
会增加地狱夫人的势力范围。
我不认为她会帮助暗黑之王，
但她也不会阻碍他。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I need you to take
this tonic and have
Serin drink it. This
special potion will erase
most of her memories.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我需要你带上
这瓶药剂，让赛琳喝下去。
这种特殊的药水
会抹去她的大部分记忆。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Without her memories,
Serin should also lose
her twisted ambitions.
Now, with the Symbol of Nine Realms, Serin cannot refuse drinking this potion.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
没有了记忆，
赛琳应该也会失去
她那扭曲的野心。
现在，凭借九重世界的权威，
赛琳无法拒绝喝下这瓶药水。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That's why having the
symbol is so crucial.
Serin is clever enough
to avoid drinking this
for quite a while now...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这就是为什么拥有
这个符号如此关键。
赛琳足够聪明，
已经设法避免喝下它
相当长一段时间了...

scripts.text:
The potion is finally
completed. Now, take this
and command Serin to drink it.
scripts.translation:
药水终于
制作完成了。
现在，带上它，
命令赛琳喝下去。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Luckily, I was able to
use Serin's gold ring to
trace her location. I'm going
to send you there, so please
do whatever it takes to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
幸好，我能够利用施琳的金戒指追踪到她的位置。我会把你传送过去，请务必不惜一切代价阻止她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm not exactly sure
where Serin is hiding,
but I'll send you to her
general location. Do
everything in your
power to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我不太确定赛琳具体藏在哪里，但我会把你传送到她的大致位置。请竭尽全力阻止她。

scripts.text: [Kirkena]
scripts.translation: [柯尔凯娜]

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please take these with you
as they'll probably be useful
when you deal with her. As for
these vouchers, give them to your allies. They'll send them straight to where Serin is located.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
请带上这些，它们在对付她时可能会有用。至于这些凭证，请交给你的盟友。我会直接把他们传送到赛琳所在的位置。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you're finished
dealing with Serin, don't
forget to bring back all
of the vouchers I've
given you, alright?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
等你处理完赛琳的事情后，别忘了把我给你的所有凭证都带回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, I'm lending you
these Witch's Medals. You
may lend these to your allies
to help you deal with Serin.
Remember, if they carry more
than one, they won't work.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，我把这些魔女之证借给你。你可以把它们借给你的盟友，协助你应对赛琳。记住，如果一个人身上携带超过一枚，它们将不会生效。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Let your allies know
that they have to take
the secret passge through
the right side of the portrait
on the castle's second floor.
Then, I can send them to Serin.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
告诉你的盟友，他们必须穿过城堡二楼右侧肖像画后的秘密通道。这样，我就可以把他们传送到赛琳那里。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you're finished
dealing with Serin, don't
forget to bring back all of
the Witch's Medals that
I've lent to you, alright?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
等你处理完赛琳的事情后，别忘了把我借给你的所有魔女之证都带回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
Please wait
a bit. I'm still
trying to finish
these preparations...
scripts.translation:
请稍等。
我还在努力完成
这些准备工作...

scripts.text:
You're finally
back. We might not
have enough time to
stop her, but we have
to try. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
你终于回来了。
我们可能没有足够的时间
阻止她，但我们必须试一试。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hurry up, then!
There's no time
to waste!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那就快点！
没有时间浪费了！

scripts.text:
We've got to
stop Serin before
she does something
truly horrible. Are
you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
我们必须阻止赛琳，
以免她做出真正可怕的事情。
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Okay then.
Good luck,
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那么，就这样吧。
祝你好运，
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hurry up, then!
There's no time
to waste!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
那就快点！
没有时间浪费了！

scripts.text:
Hmmm...?
Where are all the
vouchers I've lent to you?
Please retrieve them all
before coming back to me.
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
我借给你的那些凭证呢？
请在回来找我之前
把它们全部取回。

scripts.text:
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
你做得很好。
没有了前世记忆的赛琳，
可以平静地留在尼弗尔海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she failed to return to life, I'm sure she is glad to have met you. I think she's also started to learn that life's meaning is not in living alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
虽然她没能重返人间，但我相信她很高兴能遇见你。我想她也开始明白，生命的意义不仅仅在于活着...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason, {0}...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
再次非常感谢你的帮助。等你在这里办完事，请去拜访我们的女王，地狱夫人。我相信她因为某种原因想见你，{0}...

scripts.text:

Please retrieve them all
before coming back to me.
scripts.translation:

我借给你的那些凭证呢？
请在回来找我之前
把它们全部取回。

scripts.translation:
