scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
虽然她没能重返人间，但我相信她很高兴能遇见你。我想她也开始明白，生命的意义不仅仅在于活着...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
再次非常感谢你的帮助。等你在这里办完事，请去拜访我们的女王，地狱夫人。我相信她因为某种原因想见你...

scripts.text:
I'm so relieved that
my expectations about
you weren't wrong.
scripts.translation:
我对你的期望没有落空，
这让我松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你做得很好。
没有了前世的记忆，
赛琳可以平静地
留在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she failed to return to life, I'm sure she is glad to have met you. I think she's also started to learn that life's meaning is not in living alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
虽然她没能重返人间，但我相信她很高兴能遇见你。我想她也开始明白，生命的意义不仅仅在于活着...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
再次非常感谢你的帮助。等你在这里办完事，请去拜访我们的女王，地狱夫人。我相信她因为某种原因想见你...

scripts.text:
How could you fail when
the stakes are so high?
Serin almost summoned
the Dark Lord, but luckily,
somebody else stopped
her in the nick of time.
scripts.translation:
在如此紧要关头，
你怎么能失败呢？
赛琳差点就召唤出了暗黑之王，
幸好，有人在千钧一发之际
阻止了她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Fortunately, there are many people who are coming to Niflheim as part of the ordeals set before them by the gods. It looks like you just failed that ordeal, and Valkyrie will choose someone else.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
幸运的是，有许多人为了完成众神赋予的试炼而来到尼弗海姆。看来你刚刚失败了，瓦尔基里会另选他人。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
It's over. You failed.
Still, consider yourself
lucky. Your soul could have
been bound to Niflheim if it
weren't for Serin's wish for
you to remain free.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
结束了。你失败了。
不过，你还算幸运。如果不是赛琳希望你保持自由，你的灵魂可能已经被束缚在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You really should thank
her for that. Though, it's
ironic that you failed your
ordeals for her sake...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你确实应该为此感谢她。虽然讽刺的是，你为了她而失败了试炼...

scripts.text:
Hmpf.
I don't really
want to talk to
you anymore.
scripts.translation:
哼。
我不想再和你
说话了。

scripts.text:
You've got to hurry
and stop Serin!
scripts.translation:
你必须赶紧
阻止赛琳！

scripts.text:
Hm? Still exploring
Niflheim? Although you're
strong enough to survive,
I still think you're risking
your life by remaining here
when you don't have to.
scripts.translation:
嗯？还在探索
尼弗海姆？虽然你强得
足以生存，但我认为
在没有必要时留在这里
还是在拿命冒险。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
W-what's this?
Why is it that
you have one of
my lost spell books?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这...这是什么？
为什么你会有
我遗失的一本
魔法书？

scripts.text: From a cursed soul...
scripts.translation: 来自一个被诅咒的灵魂...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Oh. That bastard must have
stolen my spell books and got cursed when he cast the spells without my permission. Still, it's a relief to have my spells back.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
哦。那个混蛋一定是偷了我的魔法书，然后在我没允许的情况下施法被诅咒了。不过，能找回我的法术还是松了口气。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
So mortal...
You must be here for
some reason. Speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
凡人...
你一定是因为
某种原因才在这里的。
有话直说。

scripts.text: Send me back to my world.
scripts.translation: 送我回我的世界。

scripts.text: There's a lost child here that I want to help...
scripts.translation: 这里有个迷路的孩子，我想帮帮他...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Understood.
Let me send
you back to the
realm of the living
where you belong...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
明白了。
让我送你回
你所属的
生者世界...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
There's a living child?
Here in Niflheim? That's
most peculiar. Well, let me
give you this. It will send
a living human back to one
of the towns in your realm.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
有个活着的
孩子？
在尼弗海姆？这太
奇怪了。好吧，给你
这个。它能把一个
活人送回你世界
的某个城镇。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
A mortal? What are you doing
here? I'm not sure how more
of you are able to get here,
or your reasons for coming,
but this place is dangerous
for the living.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
凡人？你在这里
做什么？我不确定
为什么还有更多
人能来到这里，
或者你们来的原因，
但这里对活人
来说很危险。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm sending you back
to the realm of the living.
If you can help it, you should
probably avoid coming back
to Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我要送你回
生者世界。
如果可以的话，
你最好避免
再回到尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You lost the wing?
Here, let me give you
my last one. Now, hurry
up and save that lost child!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你弄丢了翅膀？
给你，这是我
最后的一只。现在，
快去救那个迷路的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I just gave you
that wing, right?
Hurry and save that
poor child stuck in
Niflheim!
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我刚刚才给你
那只翅膀，对吧？
快去救那个
被困在尼弗海姆的
可怜孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm...
If you don't have
anything important to
accomplish in Niflheim,
you should probably return
to the realm of the living...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
嗯...
如果你在尼弗海姆
没有重要的事情
要做，你应该
回到生者世界...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
So did you already
use the wing to save
that poor, lost child?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
所以，你已经
用翅膀救了
那个可怜、迷路的孩子吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
What...?!
It didn't work?
That's impossible!
Wait, give me a moment to
think. What could be wrong?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
什...？！
没有效果？
这不可能！
等等，让我想想。
到底哪里出了问题？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Alright.
Now I understand
why the wing didn't
work for that poor girl...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
好了。
我现在明白
为什么翅膀
对那个可怜的女孩
没有用了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
She's so young that
she doesn't even know
that she's dead. It's tragic,
but there's no way for her
to get out of here...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
她还太小，
甚至不知道自己
已经死了。这很悲惨，
但她没有
离开这里的方法...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When people don't fully
know the situation that
they're in, they become more
willing to take their chances.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
当人们
不完全了解
自己所处的
处境时，他们
更愿意去冒险。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When people don't fully
know the situation that
they're in, they become more
willing to take their chances.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
当人们
不完全了解
自己所处的
处境时，他们
更愿意去冒险。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
As I expected,
there is something behind
all of this. Now, you may
know where you are, but
do you understand why
the dead are here?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
果然，
这一切背后另有隐情。
现在，你可能知道
自己身在何处，
但你知道死者为何
会在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This realm is a place
for warriors that have failed
to prove their courage. Keep in
mind that it's not too late for
you to join their ranks.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这片领域是
那些未能证明勇气的
战士的归宿。请记住，
你现在加入他们的行列
还来得及。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The realm of Niflheim
is ruled by the Queen of the
Dead. Sometimes she appears
in her shining armor and makes the rounds. Everyone who sees her is stunned by the image of authority.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
尼弗海姆由
亡者女王统治。
有时她会身着
闪亮的盔甲巡视。
所有看到她的人
都会被那威严的形象
所震慑。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now...
What I need you to do is
ask the Queen of the Dead
for the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在...
我需要你做的是
向亡者女王
索要“九界之证”。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The symbol acts as
a voucher of the queen's
authority and represents her
undeniable right to rule over
the dead. But right now, I can't
explain why I need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
这个符号是
女王权威的凭证，
代表着她统治死者
无可置疑的权利。
但现在，我无法解释
为什么需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'll tell you why I need
it once you bring me the
queen's symbol. Now, please
keep this secret and tell no one that I asked you to bring the symbol to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
等你把女王的符号
带给我之后，
我会告诉你为什么需要它。
现在，请保守这个秘密，
不要告诉任何人
是我让你带符号来的。

scripts.text: Alright, I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了。

scripts.text: How am I supposed to get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么拿到那个符号？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
强行夺取符号
是绝对不可能的。
即使是神明
也不会考虑
与亡者女王开战。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你需要获得女王的青睐，
才有机会得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，有传闻说
亡者女王正在寻找
她失散的母亲安格尔伯达。
如果你能找到
安格尔伯达被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you need to meet
me from now on, go ahead
and take the ^FF0000secret passage
through the right side of the
portrait on the second floor^000000
of this castle, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
以后你要见我，
请走^FF0000城堡二楼
画像右侧的
秘密通道^000000，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If you use that piano
to find me, I'll probably
mistake you for one of the
humans that need guidance
out of Niflheim. So don't
forget to use that passage.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
如果你用那架钢琴
来找我，我可能会
把你当成
需要指引离开
尼弗海姆的凡人。
所以别忘了走那条通道。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Did you need my help?
I know that I'm one of the few in Niflheim that are sympathetic with mortals, I've got a problem of my own that I need to deal with...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你需要我的帮助吗？
我知道我是尼弗海姆
少数同情凡人的存在，
但我自己也有
需要处理的问题...

scripts.text: Never mind, sorry!
scripts.translation: 算了，抱歉！

scripts.text: What happened...?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了...？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
...
Hrrmmmpf...

[Kirkena]
Recently, I've found that
two of my spell books are
missing. They contain some
pretty potent spells that
could cause disaster in
incompetent hands...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
最近，我发现
我的两本魔法书
不见了。里面记载着
威力强大的咒语，
落入不称职的人手中
可能会造成灾难...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm pretty sure they
were stolen, so if you'd
retrieve them for me from
the thief, I'd be truly grateful. Then, I'd have my hands free
to give the help you came for.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
我确信它们
是被偷了，如果你能
从盗贼那里
把它们取回来，
我会非常感激。那样，
我就能腾出手来
帮你解决你来的目的了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Oh, and next time you come
to see me, go ahead and use
the passage to the right of the portrait on the second floor
of the castle.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
哦，下次你来见我，
请走城堡二楼
画像右侧的通道。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
...Hm?
Is there
something that
you need to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
...嗯？
你有
什么需要
问我的吗？

scripts.text: How can I get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我怎样才能获得那个符号？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
强行夺取符号
是绝对不可能的。
即使是神明
也不会考虑
与亡者女王开战。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
你需要获得女王的青睐，
才有机会得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
现在，有传闻说
亡者女王正在寻找
她失散的母亲安格尔伯达。
如果你能找到
安格尔伯达被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you need to
meet me from now on,
go ahead and take passage
through the right side of the
portrait on the second
floor of this castle.
scripts.translation:
[柯尔凯娜]
以后你要见我，
请走城堡二楼
画像右侧的通道。

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717You wish to have
an audience with the
Queen of the Dead without
invitation? Insolent mortal!
Go back to where you belong!^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717你想在没有
邀请的情况下
觐见亡灵女王？
无礼的凡人！
回到你该去的地方！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I have been told
by Ganglati that you
are the mortal that has
guided Mother's soul to me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717冈拉蒂告诉我，
你就是那个
将母亲的灵魂
引导到我这里的凡人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Greetings, mortal.
Make sure that you
use the power of the
symbol wisely. You will
be responsible for the
consequences...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717你好，凡人。
务必要明智地
使用那个符号的力量。
你要为后果
负责...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Ah.
You are the
mortal called
{0}, are you not?
Yes, you are known to me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717啊。
你就是那个
名叫{0}的凡人，
对吧？
是的，我认识你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717As queen of this realm,
I am unaccustomed to labor.
But give me a moment to finish
my work on this priceless
artifact, mortal.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717身为这一界的女王，
我不习惯从事劳作。
不过，凡人，
请给我一点时间，
让我完成这件
无价之宝的修复工作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Greetings, mortal.
Is the realm of the living
that boring and tedious?
Ha ha ha! Well, there shall
always be a place for you
here in Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717你好，凡人。
生者的世界
就那么枯燥乏味吗？
哈哈！
不过，在尼弗尔海姆，
永远都会有你的容身之处。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Do not fear me,
hero of Midgard.
You have won the favor
of the Queen of the Dead
and may ask me of any
reward if I deem it fair.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717不要害怕我，
米德加尔特英雄。
你已赢得亡灵女王的青睐，
若我认定合理，
你可以向我索取任何奖励。^000000

scripts.text: The Symbol of the Nine Realms...
scripts.translation: 九重世界的权威

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717The true Symbol of the
Nine Realms cannot be freely
given or lent. However, I sense
your purpose and will give you
a symbol imbued with enough
power to be used only once.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717真正的九重世界的权威
不能随意赠予或出借。
不过，我感知到了你的目的，
我会给你一枚蕴含足够力量、
仅能使用一次的权威。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717With the symbol I give you,
you can command the dead to
carry out your will without
question. However, keep in
mind that after one use,
its power will be consumed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717凭借我给你的这枚权威，
你可以命令死者
无条件地执行你的意志。
但请记住，
使用一次后，
它的力量就会耗尽。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I have also decided
to reward you with one
more special permission.
You may now freely draw
water from the fountain
in my mansion, brave hero.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717我还决定
额外奖励你一项特殊权限。
勇敢的英雄，
你现在可以自由地
从我府邸的喷泉中取水了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
Symbol of the Nine Realms.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了九重世界的权威。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I've wanted to see you
as I've sensed that you
carry something which feels
very familiar to me. Do you
have something extraordinarily
special in your possession?^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717我一直想见你，
因为我感觉到你身上
带着某种让我
非常熟悉的东西。
你身上是否带着
什么特别非凡的物品？^000000

scripts.text: The Sign
scripts.translation: 标示

scripts.text: Sobbing Starlight
scripts.translation: 星泪石

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717The Sign...?
Hmm, no, that's not
what I sensed. It's actually
something quite different...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717标示...？
嗯，不，
那不是我所感知的东西。
实际上是
完全不同的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Yes, that's it!
I never expected a mortal
to have such an interesting
artifact in {0} possession.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717没错，就是它！
我从未想过凡人
竟会持有如此有趣的
物品，{0}。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717As queen of Niflheim,
I command you to lend the
Sobbing Starlight to me! Fear
not, I shall quickly return it. For a mortal, it must have
taken great pains to obtain this...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717作为尼弗尔海姆的女王，
我命令你将星泪石借给我！
别怕，我会很快还给你的。
对于凡人来说，
获得这件物品一定
费了不少力气...^000000

scripts.text: Please take it...
scripts.translation: 请拿去吧...

scripts.text: N-no! Don't take it!
scripts.translation: 不！别拿走！

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Thank you mortal.
Now, I shall show
you something truly
interesting...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717谢谢你，凡人。
现在，我要向你展示
一些真正有趣的东西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Ha ha ha!
You amuse me,
mortal! To think,
you even have courage
to refuse the queen of
Niflheim! Ha ha ha!^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717哈哈！
你逗乐我了，凡人！
没想到，
你竟然有勇气
拒绝尼弗尔海姆的女王！
哈哈！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Mercy is not a quality
that I am known for, but
since you are my favored
mortal, I shall not kill you.
Still, it would be unwise
to displease me~^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717仁慈并非
我所擅长的品质，
但既然你是我的宠幸凡人，
我就不会杀了你。
不过，惹怒我
可是很不明智的~^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717It is done.
This is the true
form of the object
you humans call the
Sobbing Starlight.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717完成了。
这就是你们人类
称为星泪石之物的
真正形态。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Although you may also know
this object as God's Tear Drop, keep in mind that history, as you humans know it, may actually be different than the truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717虽然你们可能也将此物称为“神之泪滴”，但请记住，你们人类所知的历史，可能与真相大相径庭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717In other words, there
are some older tales about
the gods and their enemies that
may have been confused and twisted as they were handed down from generation to generation.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717换句话说，关于众神及其敌人的古老传说，在代代相传的过程中，可能已经被混淆和扭曲了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717That is all I can tell
you for now, mortal. It will
be your job to discover the
truth of the legends...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地狱夫人]
^8C1717目前我只能告诉你这些，凡人。去发掘传说的真相，是你的任务...^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
Leave me be,
ruffian! I'm disinclined
towards conversation
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[????]
别烦我，无赖！
我现在没心情
跟你说话。

scripts.text:
[????]
Don't go judging
people based on just
how they look. Try to look
inside and find the truth
within their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[????]
不要仅凭外表
去评判一个人。
试着去窥探内心，
寻找他们心中的真相。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You lookin' for
something? Crayu
must have sent you.
Alright then, let's get
straight to the point.
scripts.translation:
[根]
你在找什么？
肯定是克拉尤派你来的。
好吧，那我们
直奔主题。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
So, why is it that you
wanna become one
of Valkyrie's chosen?
scripts.translation:
[根]
那么，为什么你
想成为瓦尔基里
的选中者？

scripts.text: To prove my courage
scripts.translation: 为了证明我的勇气

scripts.text: For honor
scripts.translation: 为了荣誉

scripts.text: To help people
scripts.translation: 为了帮助他人

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Alright...
Now, did Crayu
tell you why I'm here?
scripts.translation:
[根]
好的...
那么，克拉尤
有没有告诉你
我为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Good, then you
already know what
you need to do. Now go
see the witch of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[根]
很好，看来你
已经知道该做什么了。
现在去见见
尼弗尔海姆的女巫吧。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
And, off the record,
I think you should be
really careful if you find
yourself dealing with Serin...
scripts.translation:
[根]
还有，私下说，
如果你要和赛琳打交道，
一定要非常小心...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You know, I was an
adventurer myself. In fact,
I even came here to Niflheim
for the ordeals set by the gods. However, I failed and ended up being bound to this realm...
scripts.translation:
[根]
你知道吗，我
曾经也是一名冒险者。
事实上，我也曾来到尼弗尔海姆，
为了完成众神设定的试炼。然而我失败了，最终被束缚在这个领域...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I just wanted to warn you.
Be careful and don't justify
your greed for any sort of reward using the excuse that you're just gonna prove your courage.
That's what I did...
scripts.translation:
[根]
我只是想警告你。
小心行事，不要以“证明勇气”为借口，
来合理化你对任何奖励的贪婪。
我就是这么做的...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Anyway, I've already talked
too much. First, go and see
the witch and ask her to
help you out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[根]
总之，我已经
说得够多了。首先，
去见见女巫，
请求她的帮助，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
One last thing. Off the
record, I think you should
be really careful if you find
yourself dealing with Serin.
She seems nice enough, but
something's weird about her.
scripts.translation:
[根]
最后一件事。
私下说，如果你要和赛琳打交道，
一定要非常小心。
她看起来人还不错，
但总觉得哪里不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
She's awfully persuasive,
and the fact that she used
to be a great wizard when she
was alive bothers me. She's a lot different than the rest of the guys stuck in Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[根]
她极具说服力，
而且她生前曾是一名伟大的巫师，
这让我很不安。她和尼弗尔海姆里其他被困的人很不一样...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Are you here
to prove your
courage to the gods?
scripts.translation:
[根]
你是来这里
向众神证明
你的勇气的吗？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You know, I was an
adventurer myself. In fact,
I even came here to Niflheim
for the ordeals set by the gods. However, I failed and ended up being bound to this realm...
scripts.translation:
[根]
你知道吗，我
曾经也是一名冒险者。
事实上，我也曾来到尼弗尔海姆，
为了完成众神设定的试炼。然而我失败了，最终被束缚在这个领域...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I just wanted to warn you.
Be careful and don't justify
your greed for any sort of reward using the excuse that you're just gonna prove your courage.
That's what I did...
scripts.translation:
[根]
我只是想警告你。
小心行事，不要以“证明勇气”为借口，
来合理化你对任何奖励的贪婪。
我就是这么做的...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Anyway, I've already talked
too much. First, go and see
the witch and ask her to
help you out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[根]
总之，我已经
说得够多了。首先，
去见见女巫，
请求她的帮助，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Huh... I hear you're
looking for something
pretty important. It's going
to be a dangerous search.
scripts.translation:
[根]
嗯...听说你
在寻找一件
非常重要的东西。
这将是一次危险的搜寻。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
They are plenty of
other parties that are
interested in the thing
which you're seeking...
scripts.translation:
[根]
还有很多其他队伍
也对您寻找的东西
很感兴趣...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must be a very
resourceful mortal.
Not even Lady Hell, with
all her power, could find
the soul of her mother
for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[根]
您一定是一位
非常有能力的凡人。
就连拥有强大力量
的地狱夫人，
也花了很长时间
才找到她母亲的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
There's no need
for me to hide my
true identity any longer.
My real name is Ganglati,
servant of Lady Hell, the
ruler of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我不再需要
隐藏我的真实身份了。
我的真名是甘拉提，
是尼弗尔海姆统治者、
地狱夫人的仆人。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Her highness would
have words with you.
Shall I send you to her
mansion, Eljudnir,
right now?
scripts.translation:
[根]
殿下有话
想对您说。
我现在就送您去
她的宅邸，
埃尔朱德尼尔，
好吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Remember to be
careful and especially
polite when you speak to
Lady Hell. Otherwise, the
consequences will be severe...
scripts.translation:
[根]
记得在与地狱夫人
对话时要格外小心
并保持礼貌。
否则，后果将非常严重...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I understand.
Meeting with a deity is
no small matter. However,
I advise you to make haste
as her highness is eager
to see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我明白了。
与神明会面
绝非小事。不过，
我建议您尽快行动，
因为殿下很急切
地想见到您。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must be most favored
to receive the Symbol of the
Nine Realms. Of course, it
can be used only once, but
it is still a great honor.
scripts.translation:
[根]
您一定深受眷顾，
才能获得九界之符。
当然，它只能使用一次，
但这依然是一份
莫大的荣誉。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Once again, I ask that
you be on guard against
Serin. She may already be
aware of what you plan to
do with this symbol...
scripts.translation:
[根]
再次提醒您，
要提防赛琳。
她可能已经察觉
到您打算
用这个符号做什么了...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must hurry and
stop the summoning
before your world in
cast into immense peril!
scripts.translation:
[根]
您必须赶快
阻止召唤仪式，
否则您的世界
将陷入巨大的危机！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Although Lady Hell
is being rather blase
about this matter, I beseech
you to do what you can for
the realm of the living!
scripts.translation:
[根]
虽然地狱夫人
对此事表现得
相当漫不经心，
但我恳请您
为活人的世界
尽您所能！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I should have
known you couldn't
stop her. Still, I had
a little hope that you'd
be able to do it.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我早该知道
您无法阻止她。
不过，我曾抱有一丝希望，
以为您能做到。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Perhaps I expected
far too much of you.
Goodbye for now, mortal.
scripts.translation:
[根]
也许我对您
期望过高了。
再见了，凡人。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You've done a great
job of stopping Serin.
Excellent! Such great
service on behalf of
the realm of the living!
scripts.translation:
[根]
您成功阻止了赛琳，
干得漂亮！
太出色了！
这是对活人世界
巨大的贡献！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I'm pleased to inform
you that you've been
invited to Lady Hell's
mansion once again.
Are you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[根]
我很高兴地通知您，
您再次收到了
地狱夫人宅邸的邀请。
您准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I see.
Well then, come
back to me when you
feel fully prepared.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我明白了。
那么，当您
完全准备好时，
再回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Good, good.
Don't forget to
speak to her highness
with the utmost respect!
scripts.translation:
[根]
很好，很好。
别忘了对殿下
保持最高的敬意！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What? I look familiar to you?
Eh, you know what they say.
Everyone has a lookalike in the
world somewhere. Am I right
or am I right?
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
什么？我看起来
很面熟吗？
呃，你知道人们怎么说的。
世界上总有
长得像的人。
我说得对吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Niflheim ain't such a bad
place to live. Sure, Asgard's
all pretty and stuff, but there's too many rules. In this place, you
can enjoy a lot more freedom. After you get used to all the stink.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
尼弗尔海姆
并不是个坏地方。
没错，阿斯加德
确实很漂亮，
但规矩太多了。
在这里，你可以
享受更多的自由。
只要你习惯了
这里的臭味。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Angrboda...?
Yeah, yeah!
I remember hearing something
about her when I usedta hang
with the gods up in Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
安格尔伯达...？
对，对！
我记得以前在阿斯加德
和众神混在一起时，
听说过关于她的事。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Oh yeah, about those
directions I gave you
last time? They work, but
you gotta know what I mean
by 'big' or 'small' whatever
o' clock means. That's right...
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
哦对了，关于我上次
给你的那些指示？
它们管用，但你得
明白我说的
“大”或“小”
以及“点钟”是什么意思。
没错...

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Oh yeah. Uh, I forgot to tell
you that Angrboda's soul pieces are sealed with the power of the gods. You can't just smash them open.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
哦对了。呃，我忘了告诉你，安格尔伯达的灵魂碎片是被众神的力量封印的。你没法直接把它们砸开。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Dude, Niflheim rocks.
It's like, a million times
better than that boring
old Asgard. Hell yeah!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
哥们，尼弗尔海姆太棒了。
比那个无聊的阿斯加德
好上一百万倍。
没错！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Whoa...
.................
My freakin' head hurts.

[Laichin]
Did I say 'stink?'
I meant... 'fragrance.'
Alright, so the gods expelled
me, but I really oughtta thank
'em for sending me here!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
我说“臭味”了吗？
我是说...“香气”。
好吧，虽然众神把我赶出来了，
但我真该感谢他们把我送到这里！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What's that look for...?
What, you can't believe
that someone like me used
to live in Valhalla? Me neither! They really made a mistake when they put me up to live in Asgard!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
你那个眼神是什么意思...？
什么，你不相信像我这样的人
以前住在瓦尔哈拉？我自己也不信！
他们当初让我住在阿斯加德，
真是犯了一个大错误！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Yeah, those guys were pretty
gangster about it. I mean, they took her soul, broke it in four pieces and stashed them in the deepest hole in Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
是啊，那帮家伙干得挺狠。
我是说，他们夺走了她的灵魂，
把它碎成四块，
然后藏在了米德加尔特的
最深处的洞里！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Sure, she was a giant, but
they were pretty scared of her.
All her children ended up to be legendary monsters! Well, I'm
not sure if Lady Hell counts.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
没错，她是个巨人，
但他们还是很怕她。
她的孩子们全都成了
传说中的魔物！
嗯，我不确定地狱夫人算不算。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
That's pretty harsh.
I mean, even if you die,
your soul has no place to
rest. Angrboda's soul is
all cut up and stuff!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
这太残酷了。
我是说，即使你死了，
你的灵魂也没有安息之地。
安格尔伯达的灵魂
全被切碎了！

scripts.text: So where are the soul pieces again?
scripts.translation: 灵魂碎片在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What...? I just said,
the deepest underground
place in Midgard.
It's a dangerous joint
protected by gangs
of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
什么...？我刚才说了，
米德加尔特最底下的地方。
那是个危险的地方，
由一群魔物把守。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Wait, you tellin' me
that you're gonna find
all of Angrboda's soul?!
You're crazy! If they end up
missing, the gods'll know I was
the one who tipped you off!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
等等，你是说
你要找到安格尔伯达
所有的灵魂碎片？！
你疯了吧！如果它们丢了，
众神就会知道
是我给你透露消息的！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
If I was gonna risk my soul,
I'd wanna enjoy the rest of my
afterlife as my much as I could
before the gods offed me. Man,
I'd need at least 40,000 Zeny to even have a decent time...
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
如果我打算冒这个险，
我想在众神干掉我之前，
尽可能享受剩下的来世。
天哪，我至少需要40,000 Zeny
才能过得像样点...

scripts.text: Pay Laichin 40,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 付给莱金 40,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't pay Laichin.
scripts.translation: 不付钱给莱金。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Hey...
This is sooo
not enough money
for me to enjoy myself
if my soul ends up getting
busted by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
嘿...
这点钱根本不够我
在灵魂被众神
搞砸之前好好享受的。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Now we're talkin'!
You're a true hero!
Right, you gotta go to the
lowest part of Glast Heim to
find Angrboda's soul pieces.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
这才像话！
你真是个英雄！
没错，你得去格拉斯特海姆
最底下的地方
寻找安格尔伯达的灵魂碎片。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 1 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 7 o' clock and
the small 6 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
去检查
大1点钟，
大5点钟，
大7点钟
和小6点钟。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
去检查
大4点钟，
大10点钟，
小6点钟
和极小11点钟。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 5 o' clock,
small 11 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
去检查
大5点钟，
小11点钟，
小6点钟
和极小11点钟。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock and
the small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
去检查
大4点钟，
大5点钟，
大10点钟
和小11点钟。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Her soul pieces are really
well hidden, so you gotta look around, even if you know the general location. And don't
tell anyone else about these locations or there'll be trouble.
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
她的灵魂碎片藏得很隐蔽，
所以即使你知道大概位置，
也得四处找找。
而且别把这些位置告诉别人，
不然会有麻烦的。

scripts.text: I promise.
scripts.translation: 我保证。

scripts.text: What do you mean by big and small?
scripts.translation: 你说的大和小是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, kid.
Have fun!
[Laichin]
Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
好了，小家伙。
玩得开心！
[莱金]
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, kid.
Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
好了，小家伙。
玩得开心！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What do I mean by
big and small? Hey man,
the answer to that is worth
at least... 20,000 Zeny.
If you wanna know,
cough up the cash!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
大和小是什么意思？嘿，伙计，
这个问题的答案至少值...
20,000 Zeny。
想知道的话，
就把钱交出来！

scripts.text: Don't pay him.
scripts.translation: 不给他钱。

scripts.text: Pay him.
scripts.translation: 给他钱。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Fine, fine.
Just don't come
crawling back when
you can't figure out
where the soul pieces are!
[Laichin]
Hehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
行吧，行吧。
要是找不到灵魂碎片的位置，
可别哭着回来找我！
[莱金]
嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Fine, fine.
Just don't come
crawling back when
you can't figure out
where the soul pieces are!
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
行吧，行吧。
要是找不到灵魂碎片的位置，
可别哭着回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What is this?
You tryin to welch
me or somethin'?
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
这是怎么回事？
你想赖账吗？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, listen up.
Big, small and very small
mean the distances from the
center of the map. So for big,
I mean look near the border of
the map. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[莱金]
听着。
大、小和极小
指的是距离地图中心的远近。
所以“大”的意思
是去地图边缘附近找。
很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.

dead, but it's also the
resting place of warriors
who failed to enter Valhalla.

尼弗尔海姆通常被称为亡者之城，

战士们的安息之地。

of Niflheim as the tragic end,

your point of view.

[克拉尤]
有些英雄可能会认为尼弗尔海姆是悲剧的终结，

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe water in this
fountain looks clean
enough to drink...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这口喷泉里的水看起来很清澈，
似乎可以直接饮用...^000000

scripts.text: Drink.
scripts.translation: 饮用

scripts.text: Don't Drink.
scripts.translation: 不饮用

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe water in this
fountain looks clean
enough to be bottled...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这口喷泉里的水看起来很清澈，
似乎可以装瓶带走...^000000

scripts.text: Bottle the water.
scripts.translation: 装瓶取水

scripts.text: Don't bottle the water.
scripts.translation: 不装瓶取水

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, it
looks like you don't
have enough inventory
space to carry any more items...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，
看来你的背包空间不足，
无法再携带更多物品了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, it
looks like you don't
have any Empty Bottles
to carry any of this water... ^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遗憾，
看来你没有空瓶，
无法装取这些水... ^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you approach the fountain,
a strange light begins to emit from the Lucifer's Lament in your pocket and from something deep within
the fountain's water.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你走近喷泉时，
你口袋里的魔王之眼泪开始散发出奇异的光芒，
喷泉深处也隐隐透出光芒。^000000

scripts.text: Throw Lucifer's Lament into the fountain.
scripts.translation: 将魔王之眼泪投入喷泉

scripts.text: Ignore the light.
scripts.translation: 无视光芒

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce the Lucifer's Lament
splashes into the water, the
light reveals a peculiar warp
in front of the fountain...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当魔王之眼泪溅入水中，
光芒照亮了喷泉前一个奇特的扭曲空间...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the
Geffen Fountain.^000000

^3355FFSome sort of
strange force
is blocking you
from entering.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF某种奇怪的力量
正在阻挡你进入。^000000
